fdroid:art.tessell.editor.name: Tessella
fdroid:art.tessell.editor.summary: Create and explore polygon tessellations of the plane
fdroid:art.tessell.editor.description:
Tessella is an editor for polygon tessellations of the plane: interactively create, view and manipulate tilings made of simple (regular and irregular) polygons.
Features:
* Add polygons from a palette, or by clicking any boundary edge, with automatic validation that keeps a proper edge-to-edge finite tessellation.
* Editing tools: eraser (vertices, edges, polygons), interior insertion, and "Add Copy" to grow a tiling by welding on a copy of itself under a plane isometry (translate, rotate, reflect, glide reflect), snapping to exact anchors.
* Selection and styling: select by click, colour or shape; recolour with a built-in colour picker.
* Pan, zoom and rotate the canvas; export to SVG and DOT.
The app is a thin WebView wrapper around the same client-side editor that is published on the web and as a PWA. Everything runs on-device: no network access, no accounts, no trackers.

VaultX is a fully offline, privacy-first password and identity manager that keeps your credentials secure on your device. Your data never leaves your phone and never touches the cloud.

• 100% Offline - Zero cloud dependencies, no remote servers

PRIVACY & SECURITY:

• No cloud storage or syncing

VaultX is designed for users who prioritize privacy and want total sovereignty over their credentials. All encryption and decryption operations happen strictly on-device.
Minimal permissions required:
• Biometric hardware for secure unlock
• Vibration for feedback

No internet or overlay permissions required.

fdroid:de.godisch.potillus.summary: Privacy-friendly alcohol tracker: limits, BAC estimate, PDF reports.
fdroid:de.godisch.potillus.description:
Libellus Potionis is a privacy-first, open-source, free and ad-free alcohol consumption tracker designed to help users monitor, pace, and manage their drinking habits entirely offline. It requires no invasive device permissions—no camera, microphone, or location access—and operates completely without network connectivity.
KEY FEATURES
• Logging: Predefine your own beverages or pick from internationally common presets. Log drinks instantly or retroactively with timestamp corrections.
• Concurrent limits: Set three boundaries at once — a daily limit (grams of pure alcohol), a rolling 7-day weekly limit (grams), and a maximum number of drinking days per week. Each has its own progress bar.
• Blood alcohol concentration (BAC): Enter your body weight to get a live estimate from the Widmark formula.
• Counseling reports: Generate a two-page PDF report of your consumption for consultations and counseling appointments.
• Data portability: Export your dataset as a CSV file for external processing (e.g. in LibreOffice Calc), or create JSON backups to move data between devices.
• Adjustments: Set your own “day start” time, so that late-night drinks count toward the preceding evening, and an evaluation start date for a clean restart, e.g. on New Year’s Eve.
A User’s Guide is available inside the app.
PRIVACY & SECURITY
The app stores only what you enter. It holds no network permission, so it is incapable of network access and your data cannot leave the device by itself. Your data stays in the app’s private storage, protected at rest by Android’s device storage encryption and the app sandbox. An optional biometric fingerprint lock guards against unauthorized physical access. There is no tracking, no analytics and no cloud synchronization.
COMPATIBILITY
The app runs on Android 11 (API 30) and newer and is also available for iOS 17 and newer.
OPEN SOURCE
Libellus Potionis is free software released under the GNU General Public License v3 (or later). The source code is available at the project homepage.

fdroid:io.cardijey.schulrechner.name: Schulrechner
fdroid:io.cardijey.schulrechner.summary: The calculator you know from school
fdroid:io.cardijey.schulrechner.description:
This is a very early version in development.
Unlabeled buttons will be implemented in the future, and bugs may be frequent. If you experience issues or have feature requests, please file an issue (link below). 
Frustrated by the lack of free, open-source scientific calculators that feel like the ones I am used to, I decided to reverse-engineer my old calculator from school.
With features like:
- input of complex equations,
- output as fractions as well as decimals,
- result storage and reuse,
- selection and editing of equations from input history,
- and support for implicit multiplication (like 5π instead of 5*π),
this calculator produces math that looks like the math on your paper. That makes it much more suitable for higher-level math in school and university—especially if you've grown accustomed to this kind of interface from a young age and just forgot your calculator at home.
Some additional features include:
- A well-established open-source math.js library as the math engine—so you’re not relying on some sketchy, hand-rolled math logic (just my sketchy hand-rolled input method 😛)
- A familiar, intuitive design
- 100% offline usability and fully open source
- Written entirely in HTML, JS, and CSS, which means:
 + inherently cross-platform and also available as a website and Flatpak
 + easy for other web developers to contribute
 + admittedly a bit heavy for a calculator. If you're interested in helping make a lighter version (Flutter, Kotlin, etc.), you're very welcome!

fdroid:io.github.anka1981.weckmich.name: Wake Me
fdroid:io.github.anka1981.weckmich.summary: Alarm clock for alternating weeks, timetables and rules like every 1st Tuesday
fdroid:io.github.anka1981.weckmich.description:
An alarm clock that follows your rhythm – even when it changes from week to week. 
 Alternating A/B weeks at school, early and late shifts, a uni timetable that differs every other week: with Wake Me you set each alarm once with a flexible rule and it simply goes off on the right days. No more switching alarms on and off every Sunday evening.
 Rules the built-in clock app can't do 
 Every n weeks on chosen weekdays – e.g. every other week on Monday and Thursday; the start date decides which week counts
 Monthly on a weekday – e.g. the 1st Tuesday, the 1st and 3rd Thursday or the last Friday of the month
 Monthly on a day – e.g. on the 15th or on the last day of the month
 Every n days, yearly or once – each with a start date and an optional end date
 A preview shows the next occurrences, so you can see at a glance whether the rule is right.
 Pause instead of deleting 
Going on holiday? Pause repeating alarms for days, weeks or months, for a number of occurrences or up to a date. The app lists which occurrences are skipped and resumes by itself afterwards.
 Waking up 
 Turn the phone face down to snooze
 Snooze length and gradually increasing volume per alarm or as a default
 Device alarm sounds, ringtones or your own audio file
 Rings reliably in Doze, battery saver and Do Not Disturb, and after a restart even before the first unlock
 Checks permissions, alarm volume and Do Not Disturb and warns you about anything that would stop the alarm
 “Missed alarm” notice if the device was off or the alarm stopped without a response
 Test alarm in 1 minute
 Privacy 
No internet permission, no ads, no tracking. Your alarms stay on your device.
 Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch; the app follows the system language.

fdroid:io.github.jayxt.resticdroid.name: ResticDroid
fdroid:io.github.jayxt.resticdroid.description:
ResticDroid backs your phone up with restic, the open-source backup program, to
storage you control: Backblaze B2, S3-compatible object storage, a REST server,
or a folder on an SD card. Everything is encrypted and deduplicated on
the device before it is sent, so the storage provider only ever holds
ciphertext.
The restic binary is compiled from source as part of the F-Droid build and runs
as a child process. The snapshots it writes are ordinary restic snapshots: you
can open them with restic on a desktop, and nothing about them depends on this
app. If ResticDroid disappears tomorrow, your backups do not become unreadable.
 Backup profiles 
A profile says what to back up, where to send it, and when. Start from one of
the ready-made sets — photos and media, documents and downloads, installed apps,
or all of shared storage — and adjust it.
 Conditions for scheduled runs 
Only while charging. Only on an unmetered network. Only on Wi-Fi networks you
name. Only above a battery level you choose. These become system constraints, so
the phone is not woken up to discover it cannot run.
 Repositories 
Backblaze B2, S3 and S3-compatible services, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud
Storage, OpenStack Swift, a restic REST server, or a local folder. Create a new
repository from the app, or point it at one that already exists.
SFTP and rclone are not offered: restic implements those by running the "ssh"
and "rclone" programs, which Android does not have. Use a REST server or an
S3-compatible gateway instead.
 Security 
Repository passwords and API keys live in the Android keystore, hardware-backed
on devices that have a secure element, and never appear in the configuration
files. Backups and restores that you start yourself can be gated behind your
fingerprint, or the repository password. Scheduled runs are not prompted, because a backup
that waits for a fingerprint at 3am is a backup that does not happen.
 Configuration you can read 
Everything you configure is plain text under /storage/emulated/0/ResticDroid -
one file per profile, one per repository. Edit it in any text editor, over USB
or on the phone, and the app picks the change up immediately. There is no
database, and nothing to import or export.
 No recursive backups 
A repository stored on the device is excluded from every backup automatically,
whether or not it is the one being written to. You do not have to remember to
write that rule yourself.
 What it does not do 
App data cannot be backed up without root, and ResticDroid does not use root or
pretend otherwise. It backs up the APKs of apps you installed, so a new phone
can be rebuilt, but their data stays where it is.
 Privacy 
No analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising identifiers, no Google Play
services. The app connects to nothing except the repositories you configure.

flathub:org.gnome.gitlab.cheywood.Pulp.name: Pulp
flathub:org.gnome.gitlab.cheywood.Pulp.description:
Pulp provides a workflow focused on reading through an excessive number of articles via RSS each day with the goal of regularly marking all read, resting in a state akin to an empty inbox.
 Contributing to that efficient skimming:
 Marking read while scrolling
 Ensuring full article titles and longer excerpts are visible in the article list
 A large mobile-friendly "mash roughly here" button to mark the list read and continue
 Minimising everything else, in both UI clutter and functionality
 Along with direct feed access Pulp can synchronise to FreshRSS and Nextcloud News.
 Complimenting Pulp being a bucket that you're aiming to keep empty are the abilities to share (via Mastodon, Telegram, Reddit and mail) and save (to Wallabag, Nextcloud Bookmarks, Nextcloud Notes and Iotas).
 The goal here isn't to be a typical RSS reader, please see the README (via the website link) for more about what Pulp is trying to do and what's currently possible. There will be some bugs, reporting those (via the Report an Issue link) is greatly appreciated 🙏

flathub:org.tuxfamily.StuntRally.description:
Stunt Rally is a racing game with rally style of driving, mostly on gravel.
 It features a rich variety of 202 tracks in 37 sceneries also on other planets.
 Track difficulty ranges from short and easy to very difficult stunt tracks
 including jumps, skewed loops, pipes winding in 3D, obstacles or all at once.
 There are 11 regular and 6 extreme cars to choose, 2 motorbikes,
 an 8 wheeled bus, 1 old truck, 3 hovering spaceships and 1 bouncing sphere.
 The latter provide a fast and easier gameplay on flat tracks.
 Game modes include:
 Single Race, Tutorials, Championships, Challenges, Multiplayer and Split Screen.
 Also Replays and Ghost drive are present.
 The Track Editor allows creating and modifying tracks. It uses a 3D spline generated road.

It works in conjunction with rocprofiler-sdk to support profiling methods such as performance counters (PMC) and SQ thread trace (SQTT). AQLprofile provides the foundational mechanisms for constructing AQL packets and managing profiling operations across multiple AMD GPU architecture families.

fedora-packages:aubio/aubio-lib.name: aubio-lib
fedora-packages:aubio/aubio-lib.description: aubio is a tool and library for audio labeling. Its features include segmenting a sound file before each of its attacks, performing pitch detection, tapping the beat and producing midi streams from live audio. The name aubio comes from 'audio' with a typo: several transcription errors are likely to be found in the results too. The aim of this project is to provide these automatic labeling features to other audio software. Functions can be used offline in sound editors and software samplers, or online in audio effects and virtual instruments. This package contains the aubio library.

FTGL uses the Freetype (www.freetype.org) font library to open and 'decode' the fonts. It then takes that output and stores it in a format most efficient for OpenGL rendering.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-graphbacktrackin.summary: Implementation of a graph backtracking algorithm for GAP
fedora-packages:gap-pkg-graphbacktrackin.description: This package provides an implementation of the graph backtracking algorithm, as described in the paper "Computing canonical images in permutation groups with Graph Backtracking" [1] by Christopher Jefferson, Rebecca Waldecker, and Wilf A. Wilson. It extends the BacktrackKit package to support graph backtracking. This algorithm can be used to perform calculations in permutation groups, such as: * Group and coset intersection * Finding canonical images of combinatorial structures in any permutation group This package is intended for learning and exploring the graph backtracking algorithm. The performance is **extremely poor**. For a modern, high-performance version of this algorithm, please see the vole [2] package. [1] https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.02534 [2] https://github.com/peal/vole

firefox-addons:3032068.name: AdFree - Ad Blocker & Pop-up Blocker
firefox-addons:3032068.summary: Blocks ads, pop-ups, and trackers on YouTube, Twitch, and every site - for a clean, fast, private web.
firefox-addons:3032068.description:
AdFree - Ad Blocker & Pop-up Blocker for Firefox
AdFree blocks ads, pop-ups, pop-unders and trackers in Firefox before they load. Pages open faster, articles stay readable, and one switch turns it all on. The popup shows how many ads were blocked today.
WHERE FIREFOX'S OWN PROTECTION STOPS
Enhanced Tracking Protection is good at trackers, but it is not an ad blocker: plenty of ads still load. Firefox's pop-up blocker stops windows that open with no click at all, yet lets through pop-unders that ride along on a click you did make, and scripts that fake a click on a hidden link. AdFree closes both gaps and works alongside Firefox's protection instead of replacing it. Sign-in windows, payment pop-ups and links you open in a new tab keep working.
WHAT IT BLOCKS
• Banner, display and video ads on everyday sites
• YouTube ads - most are removed before they start, and one that slips through is skipped
• Ads on Twitch and TikTok
• Known pop-under ad networks, stopped at the network level
• Trackers and session-recording scripts
YOUR CONTROLS
• Six blocklists you can switch on or off under "Blocklists": general ads & trackers, community rules, tracking & telemetry, Russian ad networks, Japanese sites, and rules built from user reports
• YouTube, Twitch, TikTok and pop-under protection stays on whenever AdFree is on
• A site switch that allows just the site you're on, for the sites you want to support
• "Report an ad on this page" for anything that gets through
• The popup speaks your language: 57 languages, following Firefox's language
PRIVACY
Blocking runs inside Firefox on the browser's built-in blocking engine. AdFree keeps no history, builds no profile and sends nothing in the background; its settings, allowlist and counter stay in local storage. Only two things can ever leave your browser, and only when you act: the address of a page you report (scheme, host and path - no query string), and your answer on the optional feedback page that opens if you uninstall.
Free, no account.

firefox-addons:2974091.name: Easy Video Sharpener
firefox-addons:2974091.summary: Real-time video sharpening using lightweight and GPU-friendly CSS SVG 'unsharp mask' filters for HTML5 video. Helps getting sharp videos on large screens and TVs. It's really helping my old eyes! 👀
firefox-addons:2974091.description:
Easy Video Sharpener adds Real-time video sharpening using lightweight & GPU-friendly CSS SVG 'unsharp mask' filters for HTML5 video. Helps getting sharp videos on large screens and TVs. It's really helping my old eyes! 👀
**New version! Fixed in v1.5.0
 SVG gradient ID collision - Each overlay now gets a unique vs-icon-grad-{n} ID via overlayIdCounter, so multiple video overlays render their icons correctly
 Slider max mismatch - Overlay strength slider max changed 10 → 7, blur max 5 → 2, step 0.01 → 0.05 to match popup values exactly
 processedVideoCount desync - Removed the manual counter entirely, getStatus now returns trackedVideos.size
 Dead Code Removed
 SVG filter creation - Extracted createUnsharpFilterElement() and createFilterSVG() helpers, eliminating ~120 lines of duplicated SVG construction
 Settings apply logic - Extracted applyOrRemoveSharpening() and handleSettingsChange(), used by both storage.onChanged and runtime.onMessage listeners
 findVideosInCustomElements - Uses Set for O(1) dedup instead of Array.includes
scanForVideos - Also uses Set for merging custom element videos
 Reddit scanning - Reduced from 5 sequential scans (0/500/1000/2000/3500ms) to 3 (0/800/2000ms), with better debouncing (300ms instead of 200ms)
Memory leak fix - scanForVideos now cleans up disconnected videos from trackedVideos on each scan
 Popup and overlay upgraded from generic system font stack to Segoe UI Variable / SF Pro with fallbacks
 Monospace values use Cascadia Code / Fira Code / JetBrains Mono
 Slightly refined color palette (deeper backgrounds, softer accents)
 Features 
 Fast SVG sharpening filter — avoids performance issues
 Works on most sites — YouTube, streaming sites, and any HTML5 video
 In-player mini UI — control sharpening without leaving the video
 Toolbar popup — quick access from the browser toolbar
 Custom mode — fine-tune Strength and Blur parameters manually
 Lock sliders — preserve your custom values when changing preset levels
 How to Use 
 In-player UI (recommended): 
 Hold Shift and move your mouse onto the video to show the control panel
 Release Shift, then use the toggle and sliders to adjust sharpening
 Move your mouse off the panel to hide it (hides after ~1 second)
 Preset Levels (1–10): 
Quick sharpening presets from subtle (1) to aggressive (10). The slider automatically calculates optimal Strength and Blur values.
 Custom Mode: 
Enable the Custom toggle to access manual controls:
 Strength (0.00 – 7.00): Sharpening intensity — higher values mean sharper edges
 Blur (0.00 – 2.00): Blur radius for the unsharp mask — affects halo size around edges
 Lock Buttons: 
Click the padlock icon next to Strength or Blur to lock that value. Locked sliders won't change when you adjust the preset level slider. This lets you find your perfect Blur, then experiment with different Strength values (or vice versa).
 Privacy 
This extension does not collect or transmit any user data. All settings are stored locally in your browser.
 Permissions 
 storage — Saves your settings locally (enabled state, level, custom values, lock states)
 Technical Details 
The sharpening uses an unsharp mask algorithm implemented as an SVG filter:
 Apply Gaussian blur to source
 Subtract blurred image from original
 Result enhances edges while preserving smooth areas
GPU-accelerated for smooth performance.
 Support 
If you find this addon useful, consider buying me a coffee ☕

firefox-addons:305079.summary: Instantly test your website availability or server response time, ping response, MX, NS records and much more.
firefox-addons:305079.description:
The WebSitePulse Test Tools Firefox Extension gives you a complete set of free web monitoring tools to support your website. Instantly test your website availability or server response time, ping response, MX, NS records and much more with a single click on your Firefox browser!
 Tests Description 
 Website Test 
The Website test verifies the server status, downloads the full HTML content and measures the response time of the test website. The test results display the times for DNS lookup, connect, download the first byte and download the complete HTML of the tested website.
 Web Page Test 
The Web page test verifies the URL availability, downloads the complete HTML content, the images and all the other internal web page objects and measures the download speed of each of the components. The test results display DNS time, connect time, first and last byte times for each of the web page objects. This test is limited to the initial 30 page objects.
 HTTP Headers test 
The HTTP Headers test requests the entered URL, retrieves the HTTP response headers, verifies the HTTP status codes and displays the received response headers. Find out more about the different HTTP status codes
 Website Test behind the Great Firewall of China 
'Website Test behind the Great Firewall of China' will test whether your web-site is visible from China. The monitoring agent resolves the domain name from selected location in China, connects to the test website and downloads the complete HTML content. The test results display DNS lookup time, time to connect, time to download the first byte and time to download the complete HTML of the tested web site.
 HostName Test 
The HostName test performs DNS lookup and provides information about how a domain or hostname ( www.yourdomain.com ) is resolved to an IP address (69.147.114.210). Common use of the HostName test is to verify that the DNS records are correct and specific domain points to the correct IP address.
 MX lookup 
The MX lookup test performs an MX record (Mail exchanger record) lookup for a specific e-mail address, which returns a list with servers responsible for delivering e-mail to that address and their priority relative to each other. The test results display the hostnames and IP addresses of the Mail Exchange Servers.
 NS records lookup 
The NS lookup test performs an NS record (Name Servers record) lookup for a specific domain name, which returns the Name Servers responsible for the domain name records. The test results display the hostnames and IP addresses of the Name Servers.
 SPF lookup 
The SPF (Sender Policy Framework) lookup test does a query for the DNS records and returns any available SPF records for a given domain name. For more information on SPF, check the SPF web site.
 Reverse DNS 
The Reverse DNS test performs a reverse DNS lookup for a specific IP address and returns the hostname associated with that IP address.
 Blacklist Check 
The Blacklist check queries the major DNS Blacklists - Sorbs, Spamhaus, NJABL, DSBL, CBL and PSBL for specific IP address and returns whether it is listed for sending spam, as an open proxy relay or for other possibly malicious activities.
 Server Test 
The Server test verifies the availability and measures the response time of any TCP/UDP based web service connected to the Internet. Server tests include HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SMTP, POP3, IMAP, SSH, Telnet, DNS and Custom services.
 Email Validation test 
The Email Validation test validates the syntax of the entered email address, performs a DNS query for the domain and checks all SMTP servers listed in the MX (Mail Exchanger) records.
 PING Test 
The PING test checks if a web host or IP address is reachable across the Internet by sending multiple ICMP packets and listening for the replies. The PING test measures the time it takes the packets to go from the selected testing monitoring location to the host tested. The test results display the shortest, the average and the maximum round-trip times and packet loss rate between hosts.
 Traceroute 
The Traceroute test (a.k.a. trace route, tracert) will trace the route that test packets take from one web destination to another. The test results provide a list of hosts or IP addresses showing the route taken by the test packets starting from the selected monitoring location to the destination Domain or IP.
 WHOIS 
The WHOIS query determines the owner and/or the administrator of a domain name and provides contact details. The WHOIS system originated as a method that system administrators could use to look up information to contact other IP address or domain name administrators, almost like "white pages".
 IP / Network Lookup 
The IP / Network Lookup does a WHOIS query to determine the owner and/or the administrator of an IP address or network and to provide contact details.
 MTR - traceroute & ping 
The MTR test is based on the linux program MTR, which combines the functionality of the "traceroute" and "ping" programs in a single network diagnostic tool. See the MTR official page for more info on MTR.

firefox-addons:2631094.name: Classroom Tools
firefox-addons:2631094.summary: A presentation tool for masking and unveiling, basic text editing, and hiding sections of a webpage.
firefox-addons:2631094.description:
A browser tool to help focus attention spans and create novel learning experiences.
These tools build upon the masking features of interactive whiteboard software, giving you more choice in how you show the web during your teaching and tutoring.
The three features allow you to:
1. Create adjustable masks on top of a web page to hide and reveal content on the page. 
2. Remove unwanted elements on a web page such as distractions, advertisements, superfluous text and images.
3. Live edit text on a web page. 
Whether adding to the content on a page or taking it away, hiding distractions or revealing secrets, we wanted to create a versatile tool for presenting the web.
You could:
 • Hide marketing images and remove irrelevant information from a page
 • Add you own facts, information, teachings to a web page on the fly
 • Misspell words or change grammar and play a game of spot the mistakes
 • Unclutter a web page before taking a screenshot
 • Slowly reveal information on a page as and when you need it
 • Use the window mask as a spotlight on images
 • Combine all three tools to edit and present a page the way you want to
We hope you’ll find many uses for it, finding fun in creative ways we haven’t thought of!
Please Note:
The changes this teaching tool makes to a web page are local to your browser and can be reset by refreshing the page. Also, this extension currently doesn’t work well with PDFs and videos due to the way browsers display them. 
Using Classroom Tools to Block Sensitive Content
We advise against using the extension as a tool to block and hide sensitive content from children such as on a news site with disturbing images or headlines. Theoretically it’s possible for a web page to refresh itself thus unmasking or resetting the page. Consequently, we suggest testing the features on websites first to make sure it behaves as intended.
We know certain sites are avoided/blocked in schools but make a note here for those that may not have these protections in place or be used to this sort of consideration with children and the web.

firefox-addons:932215.name: Tab Control
firefox-addons:932215.summary: A very simplistic add-on to position new tabs to the right of the current tab and activate the tab to the left when closing the current tab.
firefox-addons:932215.description:
Easy to use, no need to configure anything.
No permissions required.
Inspired by the old Tab Control add-on by Angly Cat that is not supported by Firefox anymore.
 Why does a wrong tab activate for a brief moment before the correct one does? 
This seems to be a limitation of WebExtensions technology (or at least its implementation by Mozilla). The browser first opens a tab at its default position and only then it lets extensions know a new tab has opened and gives them a chance to do something. Same thing when a tab is closed. If anyone knows of a workaround to this issue, please let me know on Github !
 Other known issues 
 The add-on conflicts with the built-in Switch to tab feature 
 Solved! Sometimes there could be a wrong tabs order when a lot are being open at the same time (eg by restoring a session or opening many tabs from bookmarks). Still having this one? Please let me know!
 Are there any alternative add-ons? 
Yes, there are:
 Tab Open/Close Control by F. Kolbe, that includes a lot of options, but sadly activating tab to the left on close was not working properly and the author hasn't released any updates for several months, which has prompted me to write this add-on.
 Open Tabs Next to Current by Sebastian Blask, that does exactly what it says in its name. Shame I haven't discovered his add-on before I went to lengths to implement my own.
 Focus On Left Tab After Closing by e10s, that I have not tested yet, but it could work in conjunction with the previous add-on.

firefox-addons:3020458.name: Gloam — Dark Theme for Claude Design
firefox-addons:3020458.summary: A native-looking dark theme for the Claude Design tool — leaves the design preview you're working on untouched. Toggle from the toolbar.
firefox-addons:3020458.description:
Gloam gives the Claude Design tool ( claude.ai/design ) a dark theme that matches Claude's own warm-charcoal palette — while leaving the design preview you're working on pixel-for-pixel untouched .
What it does:
 Darkens only the interface — chat, header, tabs, cards and toolbars. The cross-origin design preview is never modified.
 Value-based, not selector-based — it remaps the page's own colors, so it keeps working across Claude's frequent UI updates.
 One-click toggle from the toolbar. Turn it off and the page is left exactly as it was.
 Privacy: the only permission requested is "storage", used solely to remember the on/off state. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
Open, unminified source: github.com/justskiv/gloam-claude-design 
 Unofficial — not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" is a trademark of Anthropic.

bluejetty:00170376:ios.description:
WTrack – Weight Loss Tracker & BMI
Reach your goal weight with WTrack, the smart, beautifully simple weight tracker that turns every weigh-in into real progress. Whether you want to lose weight, gain muscle, or maintain, WTrack helps you stay motivated with clear charts, smart trends, and personalized insights.
TRACK YOUR WEIGHT, YOUR WAY 
• Log weight in seconds with date, time, notes, and mood 
• Choose kg, lbs, or jin (斤) — switch anytime 
• Set your goal weight and pick your pace: Easy, Balanced, Challenging, or Fast Track 
• See how much you've lost and how much is left to your goal 
• Get an estimated finish date based on your progress 
• Build a weigh-in streak and stay consistent
POWERFUL CHARTS & TRENDS 
• Beautiful line and bar charts (Week, Month, Year, All-time) 
• Smart trend engine filters out daily noise from water and meals, so you see true progress 
• Goal line overlay and trend sparklines 
• Instantly know if you're losing, gaining, or holding steady
BMI & BODY MEASUREMENTS 
• Full BMI calculator with categories and WHO-based guidance 
• Track body measurements: waist, hip, chest, arms, thighs, neck, and more 
• Log body fat % and muscle mass
• Create custom measurements with your own units
PROGRESS PHOTOS 
• Attach photos to any entry 
• Before/after comparison to see your transformation 
• Zoomable photo gallery and timeline
APPLE HEALTH SYNC 
• Two-way sync with Apple Health 
• Auto-import weigh-ins and keep everything in one place
SMART REMINDERS 
• Set custom weigh-in reminders for each day of the week 
• Never miss a check-in
WIDGETS & APPLE WATCH
 • Home Screen widgets (Small, Medium, Large) with current weight, goal, and a mini chart 
• Apple Watch app to view your history and progress on your wrist
ICLOUD SYNC 
• Automatic iCloud sync across all your devices 
MADE FOR YOU 
• Light, Dark, and System themes 
• Multiple accent colors 
• Clean, rounded design that's a joy to use 
• Face ID app lock to keep your data private 
• Export your history as a PDF
Start today. Track your weight, understand your trends, and reach your goal with WTrack.

bluejetty:00116225:ios.description:
What evil lurks in the twisted world of the dark fairies? Will the detective be able to free imprisoned souls and restore balance, risking danger and treacherous challenges in this mystic world? Embark on the thrilling quest of Icebound Secrets, finding hidden items and uncovering the truth about the kidnapped innocents!
Icebound Secrets 2: Soul Hunter is a new free hidden object adventure game in the mystical thriller genre with elements of fantasy and magic. This thrilling experience combines puzzle solving games with numerous mini-games and logic riddles, offering an unforgettable puzzle adventure for players who enjoy f2p hidden object games. If you love exploring and finding hidden objects, don't wait - head into this world of dark fairies, rescue souls trapped by the Ice King, and solve mysteries that will keep you in suspense.
In a warped dimension of dark fairies, the souls of victims who were kidnapped by the Ice King have been stolen. The sinister Three-Eyed Faun rules these lost lands and thwarts your attempts to find the hidden items and free the imprisoned souls. Among frozen towers and cursed forests, you will encounter a sinister city world of lurking dangers. Trust your mentor's guidance, but beware - some rescued spirits may have hidden agendas as you make your way to restore balance in this puzzle adventure.
KEY FEATURES
- Find hidden objects in every scene, and complete various quests for free!
- Release imprisoned souls in this puzzle solving games experience while unveiling the horrors of the world of the dark fairies!
- Test yourself in a mystical world - stay alert as dark twists and turns and the threat of kidnapping await you!
- Meet enigmatic characters and forge alliances—they may reward you with magical artifacts vital to your success!
- Solve logic puzzles to discover more about the Ice King’s vengeance and the cunning Three-Eyed Faunus!
- Explore locations, uncover the secrets of Icebound Secrets, and glimpse the darkest truths hidden within!
- Zoom in on scenes to search for hidden objects more accurately, and use hints if you lose your way.
- Hidden object game is optimized for tablets and phones!
Icebound Secrets 2: Soul Hunter is one of those puzzle adventure games where you have to act as both a detective and a savior. Journey across eerie forests and frozen fortresses to locate hidden objects and vital clues and artifacts. But beware - some of the souls you free can turn into fearsome creatures, and the Three - Eyed Faun will not hesitate to test your courage with his deadly trials!
Journey through a dark world, rescue trapped souls, and discover the fate of the Ice King. Each stage of this hidden object game contains distinctive locations teeming with hidden items, challenging puzzles and shocking twists of fate. Test yourself and see if you can complete all three challenges, confront the Three-Eyed Faunus and save your soul?
Expect even more free hidden objects and puzzle adventure games from Elephant Games!

bluejetty:00137679:ios.description:
About ReefBay
Dive into the vibrant world of saltwater aquariums with ReefBay, the premier app designed exclusively for the marine hobbyist community. Whether you're a seasoned aquarist or just starting out, ReefBay offers an unparalleled platform to explore, compare, and immerse yourself in the mesmerizing realm of corals, fish, and much more. With ReefBay, managing your reef tank is easier than ever.
Key Features
- Local Marketplace: Connect with fellow reef enthusiasts to share insights, discover unique products, and buy or sell within your local community.
- Explore Coral/Fish: Search through thousands of coral and fish to compare prices and find the perfect piece to enhance your saltwater aquarium.
- Personalized Tank Profiles: Craft personalized profiles for each of your aquariums, meticulously logging diverse inhabitants and precise water parameters. This streamlined aquarium log showcases your aquatic havens and provides valuable insights to others in the community.
- Parameter Tracking: Monitor your reef tank's water parameters effortlessly. Visualize your data in intuitive charts to maintain a thriving saltwater ecosystem.
- Community and Support: Join a vibrant community of saltwater enthusiasts and reef tank hobbyists. Share insights, seek advice, and discover the latest trends in the marine aquarium world.
- Task Reminders: Stay on top of your aquarium maintenance with automatic reminders for tasks like water changes and equipment checks, making you a more efficient aquarium manager.
- Guides and Resources: Access valuable aquarium guides to help you maintain and grow your reef tank, from coral selection to water chemistry management.
Why ReefBay?
At ReefBay, we understand the passion and dedication it takes to maintain a thriving saltwater aquarium. That’s why we’ve created an app that simplifies aquarium management while connecting you to a global community. Whether you're tracking parameters, organizing your aquarium log, or seeking coral care tips, ReefBay is the perfect aquarium manager in your pocket. The ocean's wonder is just a tap away!
*Creating unlimited tank profiles and using DeepDive features requires a subscription.
TERMS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
For information or inquires contact us at info@reefbay.com

bluejetty:00024633:ios.description:
Roam the unknown with the Tread® app. 
It lets you track up to 20 friends on the map of your smartphone and Tread® powersport navigator by using the Group Ride Mobile feature and syncs waypoints, tracks, routes and collections across devices. Easily plan routes on your smartphone with the same maps, vehicle profiles and route preferences you have on your Tread device. Users can import and export GPX files and get access to smart notifications and live weather. 
• Track up to 20 friends on the map of your smartphone and Tread® device by using the Group Ride Mobile1 feature
• Wirelessly sync waypoints, tracks, routes and collections across your compatible smartphone and Tread® powersport navigator
• Easily calculate faster time or adventurous routes on your smartphone with the same maps, vehicle profiles and route preferences you have on your Tread device 
• Import and export GPX files to try out new routes or revisit favorite rides
• Keep your phone safely stowed away, and still get important messages and alerts via smart notifications2 on your Tread® device display when it’s paired with the Tread® app
• Use the app to access live weather updates, viewable on your Tread® navigator’s display

bluejetty:00027552:ios.summary:
This app lets you control your hearing aids from your mobile device. It comes with an app for Apple Watch helping you discreetly change programs and adjust volume (when within Bluetooth range).
Note: some features may be available dependin
bluejetty:00027552:ios.description:
This app lets you control your hearing aids from your mobile device. It comes with an app for Apple Watch helping you discreetly change programs and adjust volume (when within Bluetooth range).
Note: some features may be available depending on your hearing aid model. Check below for details.
• Adjust sound volume for each hearing aid together or separately
• Mute surroundings for better focus
• Switch between programs set by your hearing care professional
• Check battery level
• Stream calls, music, and podcasts directly to your hearing aids (availability may vary depending on your phone model)
• Find your hearing aids if lost (requires location services always turned on)
• Access app support and troubleshooting solutions
• Meet your hearing care professional for an online visit (by appointment)
• Adjust streaming sounds with streaming equalizer (available for all hearing aid models except Philips HearLink 00) 
• Adjust sounds around you with sound equalizer (available for Philips HearLink 60, 50 and 40 models)
• Track your progress with Philips Journal feature (available for Philips HearLink 60, 50 and 40 models)
• Handle wireless accessories paired with your hearing aids such as TV Adapters and AudioClip
• Connect to and adjust an Auracast™ broadcast (available for Philips HearLink 60 and 50 models)
• Get reminders to replace your wax filters to maintain sound quality (available for Philips HearLink 60 and 50 models)
• Reduce background noise while streaming with Streaming Balance (available for Philips HearLink 60)
First use:
You need to pair your hearing aids with this app to use it to control your hearing aids. 
App availability:
We recommend regular hearing aid updates during your routine check-up with your hearing care professional.
For optimal performance, we recommend updating your device to iOS 18 or later. To check the latest list of compatible devices, please visit: hearingsolutions.philips.com/compatibility

bluejetty:00149659:ios.summary:

High-quality, affordable medical care is available on-demand with Carilion Now.
From home or on-the-go, the Carilion Now app allows you to talk to a board-certified health care provider in minutes about a diagn
bluejetty:00149659:ios.description:
24/7 Online Care in Minutes
High-quality, affordable medical care is available on-demand with Carilion Now.
From home or on-the-go, the Carilion Now app allows you to talk to a board-certified health care provider in minutes about a diagnosis and care plan. Simply use your smartphone or tablet to connect. If needed, prescriptions can be sent directly to your pharmacy.
If you use Apple Health you can choose to share your health information with the provider during your video visit, such as heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature, blood glucose levels, weight, nutritional information and respiratory rate.
Your Carilion Now connection is secure and HIPAA compliant. You must be over the age of 18 to use Carilion Now for yourself or a minor 2 years or older.
Feel better faster. To get started, simply download the free app, select the visit type and choose your provider.
Common Conditions
Allergies, cold/flu, respiratory issues, urinary tract infections, sprains/strains, eye irritation, vomiting, diarrhea
Affordable
Health care services are offered at a flat payment rate, no insurance is required to participate. Carilion Now also provides an option for patients using Medicare Part B.
Insurance
Original Medicare (Part B) covers many telehealth services. You pay a portion of the Medicare-approved amount for your care, and the Part B deductible applies. For most telehealth services, you'll pay the same amount that you would if you had received services in person.
And for Carilion employees using Carilion Now, coverage is available under Carilion’s sponsored health plan. Subject to applicable copays and deductibles.

bluejetty:00039971:ios.description:
Put your word building skills to the test with Wordability. Enter a multiplayer word game where you must find the secret five letter word in the least amount of guesses. Measure your vocab knowledge with up to four friends as you play a set number of rounds and try to come out on top. You can even look for an online match and compete against other Wordability players from all over in the ultimate test of your linguistic wit.
Go at it against other players or alone in single-player. Wordability lets you play your way in a newspaper games themed word builder. Guess the mystery word, earn points, and climb to the top of leaderboards in different game modes. In multiplayer, hop into Classic for a casual experience, Race for a fast-paced word guessing challenge, or Stages for a unique multiplayer word game clash. In single player, choose from a variety of challenges or the all-new Newsroom story mode, with progressively harder levels each with their own twist. 
Wordability is your portal to fun and challenging word games. Test your vocabulary skills and download today.
Wordability Features
What’s the Word?
- Test your vocab mastery as you try and guess the hidden word
- Find the secret five letter word to win the round and rack up points
- Will you end up on top or does your vocabulary need some polishing up?
Word Game Modes for Everyone
- The Daily Word: Challenge your friends, playing one word a day in a weekly showdown.
- Newsroom: Solve unique puzzles in the campaign mode that gets increasingly more challenging and diverse.
- Classic: Enjoy a relaxed word guessing experience where the player with the least amount of guesses wins the round.
- Race: Find the word as fast as possible. The first player to guess the word wins the round.
- Stages: Players have one guess per 30 seconds, playing together in their own word grid. First person to guess the word wins.
- Countdown: Play rounds and beat the clock as you guess words.
- Lightning: Play until you lose, with one minute per round.
Challenge Other Players
- Think you have the sharpest vocab? Put it to the test against other players
- Take on up to four friends in private games where only the best comes out on top
- Play against others online to see if you’re the ultimate word master
Prove yourself as the next semantic expert against friends and others looking to take the top spot in Wordability. Download now!
Terms of Use: https://www.playwordability.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.playwordability.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00089637:ios.summary:
Welcome to Communia — the social self-care network building a better digital world for women and non-binary-folx.
We’re tired of the internet revolving around the male gaze and often making our IRL experience worse - so we built a safe spa
bluejetty:00089637:ios.description:
Welcome to Communia — the social self-care network building a better digital world for women and non-binary-folx.
We’re tired of the internet revolving around the male gaze and often making our IRL experience worse - so we built a safe space for you to express yourself, create meaningful connections, access community support, + grow with tools designed to elevate life’s best moments and provide a roadmap during the worst.
Be your unedited self on Communia. All users are verified by human moderators, which means no trolls, no bots and no fake accounts. Share your experience, your wisdom and your opinions. Crowdsource advice from hundreds of thousands of women+ who really get it, and support others on their journeys too.
Our app features both social and self reflective tools to help create healthy connection.
Connect with your inner self:
- - DAILY JOURNAL PROMPTS: Because free journaling can be intimidating. Ideas for self discovery.
CUSTOMIZABLE, MULTIMEDIA JOURNALS: Personalise your journal aesthetic to fit your vibe & bring joy.
- SECRET & COLLABORATIVE JOURNALS: Journal privately, with friends, or publicly depending on your mood. Collaborative journaling can encourage your friend group and help hold each other accountable, while public journals invite insights & motivation from a community of people who have been there too.
- GUIDED JOURNALS: Extra support on topics like creativity, gratitude, self-compassion, anxiety, and mindful dating.
- MOOD BOARD: Our newest feature helps you understand your emotions over time, and what’s causing them. See what percent of our community is feeling the same way you are, and know you're not alone.
- GOAL TRACKING: Empowering you to build healthy habits and routines! Create your own goals or try one of our suggestions. Integrated with our built-in calendar, with streaks and progress reports to help you fully visualise your success!
- DISCOVER: Read journals by hundreds of thousands of like-minded women+ and follow/save what impacts you most.
Connect with others:
- A NEWSFEED YOU CONTROL: Only engage with the content that you want to see. Follow the topics you're comfortable with and easily switch it up depending on how you feel. Curate your space, and build an authentic digital world that works for you. 
- IDENTITY PROTECTION: Our anonymous posting tool helps you open discussions you're intimidated by, and we don't have a web app specifically so your content doesn't show up on search engines.
- OPEN DISCUSSIONS: No topic is off limits. Our most popular ones include dating and relationships, mental health, #MeToo, work and more - this is your safe space for it all.
- DO SOMETHING KIND: It's easy to help others here. Trade in doom scrolling for giving another woman advice on something you've experienced too.
From our community:
“Finally, no creepy guys invading my DMs!” — Lizzie
“Whenever I'm struggling and I don't know where to go, I know I can use this app, and that's so comforting.” — Amy
“The identity verification process is worth it for such an authentic community, we're empowered to be vulnerable because of it.” — Tasha
We've made a commitment not to sell user data or allow advertisements on the app. Instead, we generate revenue through our premium wellness subscription. Don't worry, the entire social experience will always remain free. Private journaling and daily journal prompts are free too! Past journal prompts (a library of thousands), 7 guided journals, + mood and goal tracking makeup the premium subscription. These added value features help you take action on the topics you discuss with us, and the financial support allows us to continue improving your app experience and pay our small team of women fairly (no billionaires were involved in the making of this app!). We are so happy you're here and are forever appreciative of your support.
Questions? care@ourcommunia.com Privacy Policy: https://ourcommunia.com/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://web.restlessnetwork.com/terms

bluejetty:00093815:ios.description:
Ever wonder what your dog is thinking or how healthy they really are?
Meet PupScan – the AI dog translator and health scanner that helps every pet parent understand, care for, and protect their pup.
With one quick photo, PupScan analyzes your dog’s face, posture, coat, and even poop to deliver instant insights you can trust. No more guessing or endless Googling — PupScan makes dog care simple, fun, and actionable.
How it works:
1) Snap a photo of your dog.
2) Scan the photo as our AI analyses posture, eyes, coat, stool or context.
3) Get instant insights, practical tips and when-to-see-the-vet alerts.
4) Add important documents from vet visits, vaccine cards, travel certification, service dog tags, and more. 
5) Store your memories forever! 
Key Features
Dog Translator
Instantly translate your dog’s barks, expressions, and emotions.
Fun “thought bubbles” with relaxation vs. stress scores.
Health Scan
Check eyes, coat, weight clues, and posture.
Spot early red flags before they become serious.
Poop Analyzer
Snap a photo of your dog’s stool.
Compare color, shape, and coating to vet reference charts.
Know when it’s normal and when to call the vet.
Aura Scan
Get a daily “aura reading” for your pup.
Fun extras: celebrity look-alike, mood check, shareable cards.
Dog Passport
Store vaccines, medical records, and travel docs.
Keep everything safe in one place, accessible anytime.
Why PupScan?
No Guessing: Skip random internet searches.
Actionable Tips: Every scan includes at-home care advice.
Peace of Mind: Clear red-flag alerts when vet attention is needed.
Shareable: Create instant memes and story cards for TikTok & Instagram.
Support & Legal
PupScan provides educational insights, not medical advice. Always consult a licensed veterinarian for health decisions.
Apple standard EULA applies: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00166246:ios.description:
AI Reads Law is an AI legal assistant that reads your contracts, leases, tickets and letters, and explains them in plain language, showing the passages it relies on.
Review contracts before you sign
• Spot risky clauses, hidden fees, automatic renewals and missing protections
• Read a plain-language summary and the questions to ask
Dispute a ticket
• Understand a parking ticket, traffic ticket or other fine
• Draft a dispute letter that sets out the facts that matter
Draft agreements and letters
• Draft NDAs, rental agreements, demand letters and replies to a landlord or employer
• Edit the draft, then download it as Word or PDF
Know your rights as a tenant or employee
• Security deposits, eviction notices, rent increases and repairs
• Wrongful termination, unpaid wages and non-compete clauses
How it works
1. Upload a PDF, Word file or photo, or scan a document with your phone
2. Choose the country whose law applies and ask your question
3. Read the answer, the main risks and practical next steps
Ask in more than 25 languages, by typing or by voice, and listen to answers read aloud. Read documents saved on this device offline. Edits wait to sync until you reconnect. AI answers and new exports require an internet connection.
Choose Fast, Pro or Research for your answers. Pro and Research require a subscription and work through questions in greater depth; Research runs more source checks. AI answers can contain mistakes; check important information before you act.
To answer you, we send your questions and any documents you attach to AI service providers.
Privacy policy: https://aireadslaw.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Important: AI Reads Law is not a law firm and does not provide legal representation. Answers are general legal information, not a substitute for advice from a licensed attorney. * Latest question bank including more than 210 individual different questions with ANSWERS

* Testing tips take care of you from every aspect
* Most importantly - it is FREE
- To whom wants to pass Australian Citizenship test:
* Practise as mush as you can before you book the Australian citizenship test
* Do Test Simulation and watch out the time
* Review those questions you answered incorrectly, out app can help you with it automatically
* Be confident, the citizenship test is not that hard, what you need to do is getting yourself familiarised with those questions by Practise
- Words from the Author
I created this app as myself was taking the Australian Citizenship Test at Aug 2019 and get passed with the score 100 out of 100.
In order to pass the test, I have done more than 500 questions in total, some of them are from online, some from the book (Australian Citizenship Our Common Bond) and some from friends. When I was preparing the test, I found out some of the questions are wrong and outdated, most of them are duplicated. So I keep those valid and latest questions and answers and made this Australia Citizenship Test app to save your time and efforts. It is like a booklet you can put in your mobile and your pocket. Hope this app can help anyone who is going to have the test and pass it!
Good luck for your citizenship test and Australian citizenship application, mate!

bluejetty:00031190:ios.description:
It is a time of monsters!
Join the Titan Chasers - elite explorers, mercenaries and thrill-seekers - and step onto the shores of the Siren Isles, an untamed new ecosystem forged by the Rise of the Titans. Battle for survival and control on the edge of civilisation.
Unlock legendary Titans like Godzilla, Kong, and Shimo and harness their fury in epic Titan vs Titan combat! Take on smaller prey in the Campaign, where you can fight as a squad or either Titan Chasers or monsters! Or venture onto the multiplayer map where you will face iconic monsters like the Mother Longlegs, Rock Critters and the deadly Skullcrawlers - as well as rival Titan Chasers all seeking to control this world of monsters!
The Monsterverse comes to life in Godzilla x Kong: Titan Chasers; a 4X MMO strategy game where you will take your place among legends!
EPIC TITAN VS TITAN BATTLES
Unleash the legends in Titan Clash - a colossal 1v1 combat mode where you play the Titans themselves. Unlock deadly Titan-Clash superspecies like the Warbat and Skullcrawler, and battle your way up the ranks of different factions to unlock the mighty Godzilla, Kong, and Shimo themselves. 
A BRAVE NEW WORLD
Explore a stunning 3D map featuring multiple biomes. Defeat classic and brand new superspecies, rescue survivors, and seek out the resources you need to survive against the forces of nature - and rival Chaser factions. 
BUILD YOUR SQUAD
Recruit elite Chasers to lead your forces, each offering their own set of unique skills to turn the tide of battle. 
CAPTURE SUPERSPECIES
Use powerful Monarch tech to hunt, capture and study the Superspecies of the Sirens. Rank up and learn how to unleash their ferocity in battle!
TACTICAL RPG COMBAT
Embark on thrilling expeditions and test the mettle of your squads in strategic, turn-based RPG combat. Delve into the dark secrets of the Sirens in the main story campaign, or fight as your favourite Superspecies in the monster vs monster campaign!
TEAM UP & FIGHT
Forge powerful alliances, expand your territory, and secure critical landmarks with your friends. Bring your forces together to join the fight against monster swarms and gigantic beasts.
DEFEND YOUR OUTPOST
Turn an abandoned, overgrown outpost into a formidable stronghold. Build up your forces and level up your tech to become a power player within this new frontier.
Titan Chasers, get ready to stand face-to-toe with Godzilla, Kong, and your favourite creatures of the Monsterverse in 2024!

bluejetty:00095630:ios.name: Smurfs Playhouse Village
bluejetty:00095630:ios.summary:
Step into the Magical World of the Smurfs!
Get ready for a Smurftastic adventure! With Smurfs Playhouse, kids aged 3,4,5,6,7 can explore, imagine, and create their own stories alongside their favorite blue friends - Smurfette, Papa Smurf,
bluejetty:00095630:ios.description:
Step into the Magical World of the Smurfs!
Get ready for a Smurftastic adventure! With Smurfs Playhouse, kids aged 3,4,5,6,7 can explore, imagine, and create their own stories alongside their favorite blue friends - Smurfette, Papa Smurf, Clumsy, Handy, and even Gargamel.
Developed in collaboration between SKIDOS and the official Smurfs brand, this interactive playhouse brings together the charm of the Smurfs with activities designed to spark creativity, build life skills, and keep kids engaged in safe, independent play.
What makes it special?
Smurfs Playhouse is like a digital dollhouse, packed with five magical scenes to explore - Playroom, Bathroom, Kitchen, Playground, and Camping. Each scene is full of interactive characters, music, and fun little surprises that encourage children to explore at their own pace.
Kids can:
-Start a dance party in the Playroom with Smurfette
-Help Clumsy learn hygiene in the Bathroom 
-Cook and clean with Papa Smurf in the Kitchen 
-Play on the slides, swings, and basketball hoop in the Playground 
-Go camping, build a fire, and spot butterflies in the great outdoors 
Every Smurf reacts with lively animations and voiceovers, making the play feel real and exciting. With no scores, timers, or pressure, kids are free to explore, imagine, and tell their own stories.
Perfect for little learners
Whether your toddler is just starting out or your preschooler loves exploring, Smurfs Playhouse offers simple tap-and-drag controls, so no reading is needed. It’s designed for safe, worry-free screen time that works offline too, perfect for car rides, flights, or just relaxing at home.
Highlights at a glance:
-5 beautifully designed Smurf-themed scenes
-Great for kids aged 3-7
-Encourages creativity, daily routines, and emotional growth
-Fun characters, music, and sound effects
-100% kid-safe and COPPA-compliant
-Works offline for learning anywhere
Subscription Info
-Choose from monthly or annual auto-renewable plans
-Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation
-Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the billing cycle
-Manage or cancel anytime in your device settings
Links:
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com
Download Smurfs Playhouse today and give your child a safe, fun, and magical way to play with the Smurfs!

bluejetty:00187223:ios.name: SIGNL4 - Mobile Alerting
bluejetty:00187223:ios.summary:
In case of critical incidents in areas like workers safety, 24/7 IT operations, manufacturing continuity or disaster response, SIGNL4 is your tool for instant mobile alerting.
It is designed to effectively alert and notify incident respons
bluejetty:00187223:ios.description:
In case of critical incidents in areas like workers safety, 24/7 IT operations, manufacturing continuity or disaster response, SIGNL4 is your tool for instant mobile alerting.
It is designed to effectively alert and notify incident response teams like firefighters, emergency teams, IT Ops or Security Ops staff, field service technicians and maintenance engineers.
SIGNL4 adds critical mobile alerting to your services and systems in no time. It bridges the ‘last mile’ from IT and IoT systems, machines and sensors to engineers, IT staff and workers ‘in the field’ and accelerates response up to 10x.
SIGNL4 notifies staff on duty through targeted and persistent mobile push, text messages and voice calls with acknowledgement, tracking and escalation. 
It provides for convenient on-call duty and shift scheduling to reliably delivers the right information to the right people at the right time – anywhere.
SIGNL4 enables mission-critical systems in IT, IoT, on the shop floor and in hundred other areas to automatically notify the right people when response time matters.
SIGNL4 provides simple and convenient interfaces like email and webhooks to quickly connect systems like IT monitoring, IT service management, IoT devices, SCADA systems, security cameras and more. We have verified 150+ integrations with 3rd party tools.
SIGNL4 enables to:
* Reliably and persistently dispatch critical alerts and work items to field staff, maintenance engineers and mobile workforce
* Automate alerting/escalation processes by linking machines, IT or any other critical infrastructure application to the right person at the right time
* Accelerate and ensure response by providing persistent notifications, response tracking and escalations
* Manage timely availability of operations teams (on-call duties, shifts) to route alerts automatically
* Link any system directly to staff in charge. Consolidate events and alerts from multiple sources. Create a single pane of glass for critical information
SIGNL4 provides:
* A new visual experience for critical alerts
* Persistent and trackable alert notifications by mobile push, voice calls and text
* Automated escalations based on target response times
* Scheduled and ad-hoc on-call duty and shift management
* Shared annotations to alerts and audit trails
* Raising of alerts from the mobile app
* Integrated mobile chat
* Alert notifications to your entire team or team members on duty
* Custom sounds for your critical alerts
* One-touch connect with your team members
* Monitors, tracks and reports your hours spend on duty (CSV download)
* Complete audit trails of all notifications and response (CSV download)
* Comprehensive API for 3rd party integrations
How can you trigger alerts and notifications?
* Send an email or call our webhook (REST API)
* From IT Monitoring systems like PRTG, Zabbix, CheckMK, SCOM, Solarwinds, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, Icinga, Nagios, BMC, Netapp, New Relic, Splunk
* From ITSM systems like ConnectWise, ServiceNow, Freshdesk, Freshservice, SMAX, Topdesk, Remedy
* From IT Security systems like Azure Sentinel, Azure Security, Sophos
* From automation platforms like Zapier, Microsoft PowerAutomate, Node-Red, UIPath
* From IoT and OT like Wonderware, Siemens, zenon, IXON, Telekom IoT Service Button and many other SCADA and MES
* From any systems capable of sending email or calling a webhook
* Using Amazon Alexa (voice recognition)
* In-app 1-click alert trigger with automated geo-location
* Use your web browser to send alerts to your team
Note: You need a SIGNL4 account to use this app and some features depend on your SIGNL4 plan.

bluejetty:00121150:ios.summary:
MODERN STORYTELLING FOR TODAY'S KIDS!

bluejetty:00121150:ios.description:
MODERN STORYTELLING FOR TODAY'S KIDS!
The epic story of David vs. Goliath from the Bible! Help David go from shepherd to hero with tons of slinging, lion fighting, and lyre practice along the way! Can you help him as he prepares to face Goliath? And, with God's timing and ways versus everyone else's?
You've read the story! Now tap, tilt and swipe through it with David in this interactive story combined with mini-games! Dozens of immersive story chapters including over 100 achievements and 7 mini-games along the way. Spend hours unlocking and mastering all the challenges! 
Walk with David as he demonstrates how to combine courage and preparation with God's destiny for our lives to overcome all odds - even when no one believes in us! Well, no one except your sheep!
A new app combining great fun and Bible values in a modern way that both parents and kids will love! 
MINI-GAMES
• Practice Needed! --Help David learn to use his sling!
• Lion Chase! -- Chase down that sheep-stealing Lion!
• Lion Fight! -- Fight the Lion to rescue your sheep!
• Let's Get Lyre-ical! -- Learn to play songs on David's Lyre!
• Dressing For Battle! -- Help David dress in the King's armor!
• Five Smooth Stones! -- Help David find stones for his sling!
• Giant Fight! -- Can you defeat Goliath in battle?
• Sling Practice Pro! -- Test your slinging accuracy! Compete with your friends using Game Center!
Each game includes an EASY and a HARD mode for just the right level of challenge for all ages!
FEATURES
• Beautiful animation
• Superb voice acting
• Original music
• Game Center
CHARACTERS
• David!
• Spike the sheep (who thinks he's a dog)!
• David's zany dad and jealous brothers!
• Samuel the prophet (and his wife who shouldn't cook)!
• Goliath and his over-empowered shield bearer!
• King Saul and his spunky daughter, Merab!
• Scared Israelites!
• Mean Philistines!
• Sneaky lion!
• Talented sheep!
• Dancing mice!
Connect with Righteous Tales here:
Website: http://righteoustales.com
Facebook: http://facebook.com/righteoustales
Twitter: http://twitter.com/righteoustales
Email: talktous@righteoustales.com

Why is Anime Radio+ the best? 
1. More Stations YOU Want To Hear

FAQs 
Q: Where can I find these stations online? 
A: Each of the stations are run independently and have their own online presence. There are several online directories where you can find the stations featured in the app.
Q: Why does the music occasionally skip?
A: When songs are skipping, it is often because 1) that station's server has recently been reset or 2) the internet isn't filling the audio buffer fast enough. Usually these issues are resolved with faster internet, changing to a new station, or they resolve on their own after the server resets.
Q: Why are some stations blank at times? 
A: Some of these stations are controlled by real DJs and if they aren't playing anything at the time or their site is down no music will play. Fortunately we have over 20 Channels so you will always have a lot to choose from. 
For more information, including Terms of Service & Privacy Policy, visit myindieapp.com. Thanks for listening!
Enjoy! 
Nick 
MyIndieApp.com

bluejetty:00186156:ios.description:
Welcome to Baby Panda's Town! Go and experience the life in Little Panda's Town, play various roles and experience different professions!
COOK FOOD
Make snacks from all over the world, such as cookies, jelly and chocolate. Look, the town's food carnival has begun! Serve up treats to your hungry customers!
PERFORM TASKS
There are different kinds of tasks in the town! Become a little police by finding clues and catching the bad guy! Take on the role of a bus driver and drive the bus to transport passengers safely to their destinations! Can these missions be completed? It's up to you!
USE CREATIVITY
Use your imagination and design the town as you like! Upgrade the courtyard, build a new kids playground and swimming pool. Open a clothing store and design fashionable princess dresses. Run a pet salon, groom, apply makeup and give a manicure for puppies and cats!
EXPLORE THE WORLD
Let's go explore the wonderful world together! Transform into an archaeologist and discover the secrets of the ancient world. Get on a space rocket and explore the wonders of space. Set sail on a ship and feel the vastness of the sea!
New professions like bus driver and pilot are added to the game regularly! Are you ready to come and live in Baby Panda's Town? Baby Panda is waiting for you here!
FEATURES:
- Play 20+ different roles such as police officer, doctor, and bus driver;
- Go on adventures, explore, create, and experience different professional lives;
- Roam through rich scenes;
- Realistic career simulation;
- Hundreds of items to use;
- Work hard and save money to furnish your house!
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own.
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 400 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have released over 200 children's educational apps, over 2500 episodes of nursery rhymes and animations of various themes spanning the Health, Language, Society, Science, Art and other fields.
—————
Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

* Community: Groups, messaging, meetups, leaderboards & badges.
Apple Watch

bluejetty:00017434:ios.description:
What is the sample in this song?
Who covered my favorite artists?
What remixes were made for this track?
WhoSampled knows!
Discover the DNA of the music you love. Scan the music playing around you, or your Spotify or Apple Music library, to uncover samples, covers, and remixes - and explore WhoSampled's vast universe of musical knowledge.
Awards include:
- Selected by Apple as APP STORE BEST OF YEAR
- The Telegraph - BEST MUSIC APP OF THE YEAR
- Music Ally Digital Music Awards - BEST MUSIC APP
- Named one of the world's best apps by The Next Web, The Sunday Times, The Independent, and more
Explore the Music Behind the Music
WhoSampled is the music DNA discovery app that reveals how songs are connected. Explore the world's largest database of sample-based music, cover songs and remixes, and discover how your favorite artists influence, and are influenced by, others.
Whether you're into Hip-Hop, Electronic/Dance, Rock, Pop, Jazz, Funk, Soul, Reggae, Classical, or beyond, WhoSampled is an essential music discovery experience.
Key Features
- Discover music through your own collection. Scan your Spotify or Apple Music library to uncover amazing connections for the songs you love.
- Identify music playing around you and instantly see its samples, covers and remixes.
- Access the world’s largest and richest database of music DNA, with over 1,280,000 tracks, 398,000 artists, and continuous daily additions. Search for any artist or track even if it's not in your music library.
- Beautiful, ad-free, clean interface. Simple and intuitive navigation makes exploration effortless.
- Compare songs side-by-side and listen to full‐length tracks via YouTube (where available), Spotify (Premium required), or Apple Music (subscription required). Note: your iPhone must not be on silent/vibrate mode for audio playback.
- "Now Playing" feature – switch from Spotify or Apple Music to the WhoSampled app to instantly see the musical DNA of the song you’re listening to.
- Highly detailed information on any sample (sample timing, sample type, part sampled) lets you pinpoint exactly where and how samples were used.
- Share your discoveries with your Facebook friends and X followers.
- Deep and unique music charts that show you trending and top-rated music as well as the all-time most influential artists and tracks.
- A host of other features and functionality including the ability to save favorites and contextual recommendations from every sample, cover and remix.
Dig deeper into the music you love. Dig into the WhoSampled app!
In-App Subscription Terms
Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.whosampled.com/html/terms_of_use.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.whosampled.com/html/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00070319:ios.description:
* Featured as “New and Noteworthy” by Apple *
Cluster makes it possible to create private groups where you share moments through photos and videos with the people you care about. Create a group with family, a group of friends, coworkers, people from your home town, or anyone else!
Great for:
• New Moms! Share photos of a new baby with close friends and family without spamming everyone on other social networks
• College Students! Share memories with friends not appropriate for Facebook
• Families! Keep in touch even if you’re not in the same place.
Tons of people already trust Cluster. Here’s why:
• Private & secure: Only invited members of the group can see what you post.
• An app for everyone: Access Cluster through gorgeous mobile apps and the web.
• Relevant notifications: Know when people you invited post new things to the group.
How it works:
1. Create a group.
2. Add the people you care about.
3. Share photos, videos and notes together.
People LOVE Cluster:
• “The app is fantastic! Me and my sister were so happy to find it. We made a group of the whole family and its great. My big brother is living in Europe, my sister traveling for the next 4 months and the rest of the family lives in Chile. They upload pictures and we can see how and what they are doing. Its very simple to use (even our grandmother is in the group!).”
• “I downloaded 10 different photo sharing apps, not including your Cluster app. I needed an app that allowed the creation of multiple albums, other users could join from anywhere, was password protected and SIMPLE. I deleted every app except your Cluster app. All the other apps were either too difficult to explain...to someone 8 hours away, too complicated to set up and/or upload, they limited the number of albums a user can create, required Bluetooth or wifi to share, or required a social media account to set up. Your app served all the purposes that I need. It is great, fabulous, fun & simple! Keep up the good work!”
• “I really like the privacy of the app and the fact that only people invited or with the code can access our pictures.”
• “I want to thank you all for such a wonderful product - it really has brought us all even closer together. The constant banter, the photo streams, the comedy...all of it...it's been awesome. So, as far as my feedback goes, I'd say this is an awesome program and we'll continue using it for as long as it's available!”
The press LOVES Cluster:
• Featured by the Apple App Store (“New and Noteworthy”), NYTimes, TechCrunch and many more!
Cluster Club is a monthly or annual subscription to give admins more control over their groups. Check it out by visiting the Settings → Subscription Settings section of the app.
By purchasing a subscription you agree to Cluster's Terms of Use: https://cluster.co/terms/
and Privacy Policy: https://cluster.co/privacy/

bluejetty:00148223:ios.description:
Checkit AI is a food allergy scanner and ingredient checker that helps you avoid allergens in seconds. Just hold your phone in front of any product and it identifies it instantly. No barcode needed.
Checkit is the first scanner that recognizes products directly from your camera view. Point your phone at an item on the shelf and the app analyzes what's inside right away. No lining up barcodes. No manual search. Just point and scan.
Built for people with food allergies and sensitivities, Checkit flags common allergens like gluten, dairy, soy, nuts, seed oils, and other triggers in seconds. You get clear warnings before you buy so you can shop with confidence for yourself and your family.
Every scan also shows you what's really inside. Checkit reviews ingredients, additives, and processing level and turns them into a simple product score you can understand at a glance. Compare products side by side and find safer, cleaner alternatives while you shop.
Key features:
Instant AI product recognition from your camera (no barcode needed)
Allergen and diet alerts for gluten free, dairy free, nut free, and more
Ingredient and additive risk analysis
Nutrition and processing scores
Chemical, preservative, and seed oil flags
Side-by-side product comparisons
Works on food, drinks, supplements, cosmetics, and household products
Used by thousands of shoppers who want to know what's really in the products they buy.
Free and Premium options are available. The free version includes a limited number of scans per day with core allergen and ingredient alerts. Premium unlocks unlimited scans, deeper analysis, advanced scoring, and expanded product insights.
Checkit turns your phone into the smartest shopping tool in the store.

* Real-Life Conversations: Learn through interactive dialogues on topics ranging from business and travel to school, culture, daily life, pop culture, and technology. Expand your vocabulary, improve your pronunciation, and build practical speaking skills through engaging conversations.

* Real-Time Speech Recognition: Get instant feedback on your speaking, fluency, and pronunciation.
