bluejetty:00100676:ios.description:
Just chat “Run my payroll”— and Roll by ADP guides you through the process in under a minute. The Roll mobile payroll app makes it easy to pay your entire team in under a minute — anytime, from anywhere.
Roll is a first-of-its-kind, intelligent chat-based mobile payroll app for small businesses. Set up your account directly within the Roll app in minutes. See why Roll is faster, easier, and more affordable than other payroll providers.
Roll for you and your business:
● Easily add new employees, change salaries, give promotions, send bonuses, make updates, and more — all in a chat
● Quickly set up and pay hourly and salaried employees
● Track and manage worker hours with built-in time system
● Run unlimited payrolls with an easy-to-use mobile app
● Pay workers whenever, however you want
● Integrate with QuickBooks Online®
● Get proactive reminders and alerts to help you stay on top of important tasks and deadlines
● See everything you need to do in a super intuitive timeline-based view
● Get payroll reports sent to you and payroll registers sent to your accountant
● Simply chat with Roll whenever you need live support
Roll for your team:
Roll is the same payroll app for employers AND the employee (easy, right?!). With Roll self-service, your employees can:
● Easily update their home address, phone, email, and more — simply by starting a chat with Roll
● Receive payday notifications
● View and print paystubs
● Get proactive notifications, task and deadline reminders
● Visit their employee profile for at-a-glance job, pay, and benefits info
Plus, Roll brings decades of payroll expertise from ADP. So you get the ease, intelligence, and delight of an innovative payroll app with the expertise and reliability of the biggest name in payroll.
“Honestly, setting up ROLL was the easiest process I’ve ever done, and I’ve worked with a lot of payroll companies over the past 20 years. I even told my friend who owns a business that he should switch over because it was the easiest thing in the world, and the price is great. [Intuit] QuickBooks was easy, but ROLL is far easier.” - Kimberly and Ken Anaya, owners Anaya Treasures Corporation
With Roll, running your small business payroll really is as easy as Download. Chat. Pay.
Learn more at: rollbyadp.com
Note: This is a mobile payroll app for employers and employees who use the “Roll by ADP” product ONLY. If you are paid through another ADP product, download that product’s app to access your online account and see your pay stubs. If you are unsure of what payroll product your employer uses, please contact them to find out.

bluejetty:00060089:android.description:
□ 'MY': Only the essentials for card use at a glance
- Check card usage history and benefits at a glance
- Check services linked to your card
□ 'Today PICK': Recommends benefits perfectly suited to you
- AI solution recommends personalized benefits based on your spending habits
- Focused benefits from frequently used brands
- LINK: Automatically recommends benefits at nearby merchants
□ 'Finance': Seamless management and easy access
- Apply for financial services more easily and quickly
□ 'App Card Payment': Pay with an app without a physical card
- Easier and faster mobile payment service
- Manage various simple payments all at once
[Note]
- Only cards in your name (personal credit/corporate individual/check cards, etc.) can be registered as app cards.
- App cards can only be used on one phone with a USIM card installed in your name. However, they cannot be used on phones that have been modified by the user.
- To maintain device security, we recommend updating your operating system and antivirus software to the latest versions. Also, please avoid using wireless LAN (Wi-Fi) from unknown sources or with insecure settings, and use mobile networks (3G, LTE, 5G).
- Data charges may apply when downloading apps or using services while connected to a mobile network (3G, LTE, 5G).
- For more information, please visit our website (www.samsungcard.com) or call 1588-8700.
[App Access Permissions Guide]
Please allow the following permissions for a more convenient app experience. - (Required) Phone: Identity verification, connection to customer service line
- (Optional) Location: Weather information
- (Optional) Notifications: Send notification messages
- (Optional) NFC: Mobile transportation card use
- (Optional) Camera: Scan QR codes for payments, use SmartFax, take ID photos
- (Optional) Photos and videos: Use SmartFax
- (Optional) Microphone: Use chatbot voice search
- (Optional) Biometrics: Identity verification, login
※ Even if you do not agree to optional access permissions, you can still use the app for other functions.
※ Starting with Android 6.0 and higher, you can now consent to required and optional permissions separately. Therefore, we recommend updating to 6.0 or higher. After updating, you must delete and reinstall the app to reset permissions.
※ Access permissions can be changed under Settings > Applications > Samsung Card > Permissions on your phone. However, the path may vary depending on your phone model.
※ To prevent voice phishing and electronic financial transaction incidents, we may collect and use information about malicious apps installed on your mobile device.
※ For a faster and more convenient digital ARS experience, please allow the "Display on top of other apps" and "Display full-screen notifications on the lock screen."
[Call-related screen service information]
This app displays informative mobile content provided by the call recipient. To achieve this, it provides phone numbers and app notification information to the service provider, Bridgetech (Colgate Inc.).
- Functions provided: Call-related screen services (digital ARS, etc.)
- Retention and usage period: Until the provider withdraws consent
- Opt-out of provision and withdrawal of consent
· Main phone number: 1588-8700
· Email consultation
※ Data charges may apply depending on your subscription plan when using the screen service.

bluejetty:00087731:ios.name: Daylist: Grocery Shopping List
bluejetty:00087731:ios.summary: Daylist is the grocery shopping list for your whole home. Write down what you need, share the list with the people you live with, and check items off together at the store. No more forgotten milk, no more "did you already buy it?" texts, no
bluejetty:00087731:ios.description:
Daylist is the grocery shopping list for your whole home. Write down what you need, share the list with the people you live with, and check items off together at the store. No more forgotten milk, no more "did you already buy it?" texts, no more paper notes.
ONE SHOPPING LIST FOR THE WHOLE HOME
Keep groceries, household supplies and everything else your home runs on in one place. Add an item in seconds the moment you notice it is running low — at the fridge, in the pantry, or on the go. Make a separate list for the weekly grocery run, the hardware store, the pharmacy or a big stock-up trip, and switch between them with a tap.
SHARED IN REAL TIME
Invite your partner, roommates or anyone you shop for by email or with a simple link. Everyone sees the same list, and every change shows up instantly. When someone adds an item you get a notification, so you can grab it while you are still in the store. Whoever goes shopping always has the latest list — and nobody buys the same thing twice.
ORGANIZED THE WAY YOU SHOP
Group items into categories like produce, dairy, bakery, cleaning or pets, so you walk through the store once instead of doubling back. Daylist suggests categories as you type, and you can rename, reorder or create your own. Sort items manually, by name, by priority or by date, and hide what is already checked off to focus on what is left.
REUSE YOUR LIST EVERY WEEK
Buy mostly the same things each week? Reset a finished list with one tap and every item is ready to check off again. No retyping, no starting from zero. Your regular shop becomes a checklist you simply run through.
ADD THE DETAILS THAT MATTER
Attach a photo so the right brand, size or flavor comes home. Add a note with the quantity or a reminder like "the one in the blue box." Mark what is urgent with a priority, and set a due date for things that cannot wait.
DECIDE WHO BUYS WHAT
Splitting the errands? Assign items to a person, then filter the list to see only your own. It works just as well for dividing a party shop, a trip packing list or the weekend to-dos around the house.
A CHECKLIST MAKER FOR EVERYTHING ELSE
Daylist is not only for groceries. Start from a ready-made template or build your own checklist for packing, moving, home projects, gift ideas or a simple to-do list. Watch the progress bar fill up as you check things off, and move items between lists whenever plans change.
REMINDERS SO NOTHING IS FORGOTTEN
Set a reminder for the things that need to happen on time — pick up a prescription, order the cake, restock before guests arrive. Daylist tells you at the right moment, and overdue items are easy to spot.
WIDGETS ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Put your shopping list on your Home Screen in a small, medium or large widget. See what is left to buy at a glance, without opening the app.
ALWAYS WITH YOU
Sign in to back up your lists and keep them in sync across your devices. Lost signal in the store? Keep checking items off — your changes are saved on your phone and sync as soon as you are back online.
SIMPLE BY DESIGN
No cluttered menus and no learning curve. Open the app, add what you need, check it off. Daylist stays calm and quick, so a list never feels like a chore.
WHO IT IS FOR
• Couples and housemates who share the shopping
• Anyone who restocks the same groceries and home supplies every week
• People who want one tidy place for shopping lists, checklists and to-dos
FREE AND PREMIUM
Daylist is free to download and use. Daylist Premium unlocks unlimited lists, list sharing, item assignment, photos on items and moving items between lists. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them anytime in your App Store account settings.
Ideas or questions? Write to support@day-list.io.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00124041:ios.summary:
Be the king in this strategy game offline.
Reign your medieval kingdom with strategy, build mighty strongholds, engage in epic battle simulator, defeat enemies civilizations and expand your kingdom to a glorious empire. 
The King is dead!
bluejetty:00124041:ios.description:
Be the king in this strategy game offline.
Reign your medieval kingdom with strategy, build mighty strongholds, engage in epic battle simulator, defeat enemies civilizations and expand your kingdom to a glorious empire. 
The King is dead! Long live the King! 
Majesty, with regret, I have to inform you that the King has died. Now it is your turn to sit on the throne and lead the kingdom. Can you keep your dynasty alive? 
Age of Dynasties is a game set in the Middle Ages, from 476 to 1492 AD, in which you have to rule over your kingdom. Different rulers will occupy the throne in your stronghold and each will have their merits and their manias. Sometimes you'll have to make decisions while playing the role of an insane king, sometimes a wise king like the legendary King Arthur. 
Year after year you'll have to play the role of decision maker to maintain the stability of the kingdom. 
Will you succeed in obtaining the loyalty of the vassal states and putting down the rebellions that want to depose the rulers of your dynasty? Will you be able to prevent war and famine from decimating your subjects? 
Whatever you decide will have implications and consequences. In this choices game you have to plan your moves wisely!
Age of Dynasties is a turn based strategy game with a combination of role-playing elements: tactical rpg, intrigue, simulation and adventure. 
Take command in this turn based rpg, your Majesty, and measure yourself against the burdens and honours that will lead you on to greatness:
- Satisfy the demands of your subjects to keep the peace in the kingdom and put yourself to the test through a series of historical events, dynamically connected to each other.
- Choose the advisors of the round table with strategy: like King Arthur, surround yourself with trustworthy and capable knights like Sir Lancelot or Sir Galahad, and entrust your judgment to their valuable advice
- Collect iron, build swords and armor and guide the crusader kings against your enemies
- Discover new content and face new challenges in every game: with over 4,000 rounds of this medieval game of strategy you can enjoy many hours of fun back in the Middle Ages and different reigns. 
- Within this turn based RPG, you have to make choices, accumulate resources, and issue real decrees during each turn of the game. But remember that within this medieval game this will all have an impact on the longevity and the future of the king currently sitting on the throne.
- Manage thorny political issues and the intricate interpersonal relationships between the members of the council and the royal family in a medieval europe.
- Lead battles like a real leader, use strategy and tactics to plan your army's moves and win the war against all reigns in this turn based strategy game.
- Tactical manage at best the Kings and Queens who will sit on the throne
- Build a magnificent castle in your Camelot, make alliances with sultans and emeperors, enlist the help of advisors and become the undisputed master of your dynasty!
The age of kings began, are you ready to wear the crown and rewrite the history of the Middle Ages in this Game of Kings?
Age of Dynasties is not simply a medieval simulator but a new experience where strategy and tactical RPG mix perfectly. This turn based strategy game is completely free, also works offline and is available in 10 languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Russian, Italian, Japanese, Turkish, Chinese.

Mushaf Qatar
Description
A complete companion for reading, listening to, and reflecting on the Holy Quran, presented in a calm and easy-to-use experience.
Key features:
• Browse printed Mushaf pages or read in Verse mode, with search, a saved reading position, and night-reading options.
• Listen to a selection of reciters, control playback in the background, and download recitations for offline listening.
• Explore Tafsir linked to individual verses and download Tafsir books for offline reading.
• View prayer times and the Qibla direction, alongside Azkar, Khatma, memorization, and a digital Tasbih counter.
• Ask the Arabic Quran assistant about verse meanings and Tafsir, with relevant references included in its answers.
Press and hold a verse to access playback, Tafsir, bookmarking, copying, and sharing.
Support and feedback: mushafqatar@islamweb.net.qa

Whether you’re looking to kill time or just seeking a relaxing yet exciting activity, Kitten Match 3D offers the perfect solution. You can play it online or offline, no Wi-Fi required.
Kitten Match 3D is free to play, but you can purchase some cute virtual items with real money!

bluejetty:00092100:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00092100:ios.description:
Follow the patient's in-game treatment journey with EndeavorRx Insight: the official EndeavorRx® companion app for parents.
This free app connects directly to your EndeavorRx treatment, so you can get a daily snapshot of in-game mission completion and effort score.
KEY FEATURES:
- FOCUS SCORE: Track attention progress with a personalized score.
- VIEW MISSION COMPLETION: See if the patient completed all of their play for the day, so you can help them stay on track.
- MONITOR DAILY EFFORT: By analyzing in-game interactions, we give you a sense of the patient's level of effort and if they are playing correctly according to the rules.
- TRACK SYMPTOMS: By using the 21 question caregiver assessment.
- TREATMENT RECOMMENDATIONS: The Essentials for Caregivers course is designed to equip you with information you’ll need to successfully integrate EndeavorRx treatment into your family's daily life and support you throughout the first month of treatment.
- EXPORT REPORTS: Generate reports and share the results with your health care provider to inform the conversation and treatment planning. 
- GET SUPPORT: Having an issue? The app can help connect you to our Akili support team. 
Important: In order to use EndeavorRx Insight, you must already have an active prescription for the EndeavorRx digital treatment and be connected to the internet.
WHAT IS ENDEAVORRX? 
EndeavorRx is the first & only FDA-authorized video game treatment for inattention for kids 8-17 with ADHD. Access to treatment in the game requires a prescription from a healthcare provider. 
Created by world-class neuroscientists and award-winning game designers, EndeavorRx is powered by Selective Stimulus Management Engine (SSME™) technology that is designed to challenge and target areas of the brain that play a key role in attention function.
Please consult with your child's healthcare provider before use of EndeavorRx Insight or EndeavorRx®. For more information and to get tips on how to talk to your current healthcare provider to determine if EndeavorRx may be right for you, visit EndeavorRx.com.
INDICATIONS FOR USE
EndeavorRx is a digital therapeutic indicated to improve attention function as measured by computer-based testing in children ages 8-17 years old with primarily inattentive or combined-type ADHD, who have a demonstrated attention issue. Patients who engage with EndeavorRx demonstrate improvements in a digitally assessed measure, Test of Variables of Attention (TOVA®), of sustained and selective attention and may not display benefits in typical behavioral symptoms, such as hyperactivity. EndeavorRx should be considered for use as part of a therapeutic program that may include clinician-directed therapy, medication, and/or educational programs, which further address symptoms of the disorder.
SIDE EFFECTS
No serious adverse events were reported. Of 538 participants in trials supporting EndeavorRx authorization, 50 participants (9.3%) experienced treatment-related adverse events (probable, likely), and three participants experienced treatment-related adverse events with the digital control, in studies where a control was used. Associated adverse events included frustration (6.1%), headache (1.3%), dizziness (0.6%), emotional reaction (0.4%), nausea (0.4%), and aggression (0.2%). All adverse events were generally transient. Only 3 events led to device discontinuation, and no subject reported lasting or irreversible effects after discontinuation. 
Akili, EndeavorRx, Endeavor, Akili Care, ADHD Insight, Insight, EndeavorRx Insight, SSME, Play Your Medicine, and Akili Assist, as well as the logos for each, are trademarks or registered trademarks of Akili Interactive Labs, Inc. Other trademarks are trademarks or registered trademarks of their respective owners. Please see the Terms of Use below for applicable patent protection for EndeavorRx.
Terms of Use: https://my.akili.care/terms
Privacy Notice: https://my.akili.care/privacy

The best way to view Caltrans & California Highway Patrol (CHP) information. 
Live Stream CCTV Cameras
Create customized groups of CCTV cameras for viewing traffic on your route. This feature gives users a quick way of assessing road and traffic conditions.
Push Notifications
Track specific CHP Incidents and receive Push Notifications when new updates are available. The app also sends notifications when an incident is no longer being tracked by CHP. This feature is critical for staying up-to-date on road closures due to accidents. 
California Highway Patrol Incidents:
Traffic collisions, advisories, hazards, weather and wind advisory, wrong way driver, road closure, chain control, animal hazard, fire and all other CHP incident types
Caltrans QuickMap Road Conditions:
Full road closure, lane closure, rest area closure, on / off ramp closure, message signs, chain control signs
Home Screen Widgets
Add up to (4) four traffic camera widgets to your home screen and stay up-to-date with the latest traffic and road conditions.

bluejetty:00119266:ios.name: Jimdo Creator
bluejetty:00119266:ios.summary: With the Jimdo Creator app you can easily create your own free website with responsive website design, a blog, an online store, and much more. And edit it on-the-go! The Jimdo Creator app has been downloaded over a million times and has hel
bluejetty:00119266:ios.description:
With the Jimdo Creator app you can easily create your own free website with responsive website design, a blog, an online store, and much more. And edit it on-the-go! The Jimdo Creator app has been downloaded over a million times and has helped to create some of the 20 million websites now online with Jimdo. What do you want to show on your website? Your website. Always available. Always with you.
*What the app can do*
New to Jimdo?
It’s so quick and easy to get your new website online. Choose your template, select a domain, insert text and photos—done! The design of your Jimdo website is automatically responsive, so it is optimized for smartphones, tablets and desktop computers.
In addition to the app, you can also edit your website on a desktop computer to use many more features.
Already with Jimdo?
You can edit your existing website with the app. Wherever you are with your iPhone or iPad—your website is right there with you.
App features
Navigation: Add new subpages to your website—or you can change, hide or delete these pages.
Content for your website: Write or publish blog posts, add photos, photo galleries, text, headings, and buttons to your website.
Structure for your website: Headings, spacing, and lines can help your visitors get a great overview of your website.
Online store: You can see and edit your open and closed orders directly in the app. Mark items as sent and/or paid to have even more control on-the-go.
What else can Jimdo do?
Use the desktop version for even more features including more online store options, search engine optimization (SEO), contact forms and much more.
Also: We’re always working on making the Jimdo Creator app even better, and will continue to release new features for it. We can’t wait to see your new website
+++ We'd love to hear from you. Send us your suggestions and comments! +++
Ideas, suggestions, or comments?
Please share them with us: mobile-feedback@jimdo.com

http://www.jimdo.com/info/terms-of-use-privacy/
Privacy Policy:
http://www.jimdo.com/info/privacy-statement/

bluejetty:00015164:ios.name: Garbage Truck Games for kids.
bluejetty:00015164:ios.summary: Welcome to the most exciting adventure in the world of garbage trucks! Our game is not just one of the average truck games for kids or car games for kids. It's much more - a fun-filled, educational journey that lets you become an environmen
bluejetty:00015164:ios.description:
Welcome to the most exciting adventure in the world of garbage trucks! Our game is not just one of the average truck games for kids or car games for kids. It's much more - a fun-filled, educational journey that lets you become an environmental guardian and a responsible garbage truck driver!
Hop onto one of the coolest garbage trucks you've ever seen and prepare to clean up the city! But wait, there's more to it than just garbage. Our game even lets you drive a street sweeper, making it an integral part of our lineup of construction games.
Is snow causing trouble in the city traffic? No worries! In our game, you can take charge of a snow plow, clearing the roads and guiding vehicles to safety. Or perhaps you'd prefer to demolish ruins with your powerful hammer truck in our engaging garbage truck driving simulator.
There's a lot of garbage to be dealt with, and you're just the one to handle it. In this unique blend of car games and garbage truck games, you'll transport all kinds of waste, large and small, even old car parts, to the recycling center. Once there, you get to see the impressive disposal machine in action and enjoy the fun interactions that follow!
We've made education engaging in our learning games. You're in control of up to 30 different machines - sorting machines, car crushers, magnet devices, steamers, and more. These will help you learn about sorting and recycling mixed waste in the most entertaining way possible.
Our game teaches kids about waste management and the best practices to sort and eliminate it. They learn about various methods of waste recycling and energy production, all within this child-friendly, interactive environment. And it's all packaged with enjoyable animations and sound effects, making learning fun!
Choose your favorite garbage truck and start your adventure! Drive around as a little environmental guardian and develop good habits while cultivating an environmental consciousness. Remember, no adventure is too big when you're driving a mighty garbage truck.
Features:
• Five unique garbage trucks to choose from, including a snowblower, a sweeper truck, and a forklift
• Control up to 30 giant sorting machines
• Learn about waste management and the best ways to sort and eliminate it
• Develop environmental consciousness and good habits
• Fun animations and sound effects
• No third-party advertising
About Yateland
Yateland designs apps with educational value, inspiring preschoolers worldwide to learn through play. Every app we create is guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, visit our website at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is dedicated to protecting users' privacy. If you want to learn more about how we handle these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.
Join us on this fun-filled, educational journey with our garbage truck simulator games! Let's learn, play, and save the environment, one garbage truck ride at a time!

bluejetty:00019412:ios.description:
Going to school every day can be a drag, right? Well, how about playing hooky for a change?
◆ 'Skip School!' - What kind of game is it? ◆
Remember the times as a kid when you just didn't feel like going to school? Wishing you could skip just for a day, especially on days with subjects you didn't like? Well, this game is here to fulfill those old wishes of yours! Play as a student with a knack for skipping school, trying to escape from the teachers. With the help of quirky classmates and some silly ideas, along with whatever is at hand, dodge and repel the teachers trying to make you study!
Will your attempts at playing hooky be successful? This game is a fun escape for adults stuck in the grind of society and for kids tired from studying, offering a wallet-friendly, free puzzle escape experience!
◆ Easy Puzzles for Time-Killing! ◆
The gameplay is super easy. Tap on intriguing items lying around to collect them! Use these items to disguise yourself, get help from friends, or outwit the teachers with your newfound tools!
◆ Key Features! ◆
Enjoy numerous stages, each meticulously handcrafted, ensuring you never get bored. Perfect for killing time with slightly quirky and fun gimmicks!
◆ More Fun Apps Available! ◆
For those naughty ones who used to hate showing their test papers as kids, try 'Hide My Test'! And for the weary adults, busy with work every day, 'Skip Work' is a must-check out!

The free Bob Shop app brings South Africa’s safe and simple online marketplace to your iPhone or iPad.
SHOP SMART
Make sure you don't miss out on the best deals, flash auctions, crazy auctions, specials, sales and promotions. All at your fingertips on the Bob Shop app.

SECURE, SIMPLE AND SO, SO SUPER
So many products, so many sellers, and so many ways to buy and pay. 
Buying options: Bid, Buy and Make an Offer
Payment methods: Credit Card, EFT, cash deposits, bobBucks and bitcoin. 
Buying what you love is so easy, so fast and so secure. 
And did we mention the 1Password and Dashlane integration to make logging in so secure and simple?
AND EVEN MORE FEATURES:
Buyers: Keep track of orders, add items to your watchlist or shopping cart, set up bid notifications and email alerts, review and rate sellers.
Sellers: Request a payout, manage orders, answer questions, rate buyers, view listings and sales.

bluejetty:00100695:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00100695:ios.description:
FEATURES
On-demand Tigrigna Audio. Plus Geez, ASB, KJV and WEB bibles
* Lean the Geez language by using parallel text screens
* Verse by verse Cross References for all included Bible translations
* Highlight a verse(s), then touch the Cross-Ref icon to see related verses for selection
* Chapter subtitles in all Tigrigna and Geez Bible books, OT and NT
* Many color-coded section/topic title cross reference links to which open in a separate window
* Section titles and mini content references that open in new windows
* Selecting a verse in cross reference windows to top open whole Bible in popup content screen
* Search by: verses only, titles only, or verses plus subtitles
* View your Bookmarks in Search results, Mini-content...
* Great tool for serious Tigrigna, Geez Bible Study users, and beginners alike
* Select verses and Copy, Bookmark, and share to Facebook...
* Type in Geez to Search or to Add Notes (if no Geez keyboard installed)
* Track Reading History
* Chapter Notes: paste or type in Geez and/or Latin
* Share to Facebook, Twitter, Flickr, SMS, Mail...
On-demand audio requires Internet connection, it downloads a whole book at once and and then to it offline. Best to be on WIFI when downloading, some books are large. If your device does not have storage limitations, use our other Tigrigna Bible app with offline Audio allowing you to listen any book chapter at any time with no Internet required. When you are done listening to a book, you can delete the temporary files using the popup. Grateful to Pastor Hezekiah Yemane for permission to use his audio bible.
We are grateful to the many volunteers who typed up the Tigrigna Bible, and our appreciation to geezexperience.com. The English Bible translations SEV, KJV and WEB are in the public domain, God bless those who made it possible. We are grateful for the many groups of volunteers who work tirelessly to make the quality and accuracy of the app possible - BLESS YOU!
For more info: visit WongelAdvocate.com (Living Word Gospel Ministry)

bluejetty:00187415:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00187415:ios.description:
Live flight tracker for Newark Liberty Airport (EWR). Free.
Arrivals, departures and flight status — on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled or landed. Gate numbers, baggage carousels and terminals, live. And keep the rest of your trip in the same app: boarding passes, where you parked, packing lists, tickets and bookings.
Perfect for travellers, frequent flyers, taxi drivers, airport staff and anyone meeting or seeing off passengers at Newark Liberty Airport.
FLIGHTS
• Live arrivals and departures board, refreshed with one tap
• Search by flight number, airline, city, airport, terminal, gate or baggage belt
• Status at a glance: on time, delayed, diverted, cancelled, landed
• Codeshare flight matching
• Domestic and international filters
• Favourite flights
• Weather and local time at both ends of a flight, with a 3-day forecast
• Flights-per-hour report and status sharing
• Dark mode, 12- or 24-hour time, °C or °F
• Available in 61 languages
MY TRIP — YOUR TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
• Boarding passes: snap a photo, the barcode is read and shown full-screen at the gate
• My car: photos, a note and (optionally) the location of your spot, with walking directions back
• Checklists: packing lists to tick off, with a starter list
• Bag tags: tag number, airline and a photo of your bag
• Receipts: snap a receipt and the total is read for you
• Tickets: train, bus, ferry and event tickets, barcode shown large
• Bookings: hotel, car hire and insurance, with tap-to-call, maps and the confirmation attached
• Links and notes: save links from other apps and keep trip notes
• Trip dates with a countdown
• Backup to a file, with an optional password
Everything stays on your phone. No account needed.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add and edit everything in My trip
• Both ends of every flight: times, terminal, gate and baggage
• Flight details: taxi-out, air time, taxi-in and delays at each end
• Aircraft type and registration (tail number)
• Security and customs queue wait times (supported airports)
• PDF export of your trip and receipts
• No ads
Download now and always know exactly where every EWR flight stands.
—
This app is not an official airport app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Newark Liberty Airport or any airline. For definitive flight times, please check the official airport or airline website. The developer accepts no liability for incidents resulting from use of the data shown.
Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy
http://flightinfoapps.com/flightinfoapps-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00134618:ios.description:
=== A Second Line Phone Number ===
MySecondLine gives you a 2nd phone number on your smartphone.
Get started for just $5.99 / week with a USA/Canada local number.
The pricing is the most affordable and the best rate in the market for such a quality app.
Here are the benefits:
=== Get a USA/Canada local number: starts at $5.99 only ===
You can try the app for $5.99 only to get started! There is no advertisement inside for the paid version. The cost is fully transparent. It is super easy to get started.
You will unblock many advanced features in the premium version and get a dedicated phone number!
=== A separate second phone number ===
You will get a dedicated phone number from MySecondLine paid version.
You can choose a local area code while keeping yourself anonymous and private. You can also find the number based on letters related to your business, e.g. 212-Buy-Book, or 917-Go-Sales. The phone number is a memorable and great way to promote your business.
Besides that, we also provide:
- Toll-free numbers like 800, 888, and 855 phone numbers in the US/Canada.
- International phone numbers (e.g. GB, Israel, Germany, Mexico, etc.)
- You can import and transfer your current phone number to us
=== Easy texting and quality phone calls ===
It offers easy texting and quality phone calls in the premium version.
You can text your contacts, send out messages to them, and receive text messages from all over the world. You can also make and receive calls just like your mobile phone with the app. You will enjoy the best communication quality with the app with your mobile networks or WIFI.
Note: For the US/Canada, you can upgrade with a small fee to enable international calls and messages in the settings.
Note: you can upgrade to enable an eSim data plan when you travel around. 
=== Private personal communications ===
Get a second phone number for many personal usages such as:
- Stay safe and anonymous when you give out your number
- A fake number to avoid unwanted spam messages and calls
- A temporary number for dating, shopping, etc
- Website registration to receive SMS and still keep privacy
=== Professional business team number ===
MySecondLine is more than a second line for you and your business. 
You can manage the work number with your team: more productive, happier customers!
You can also upgrade to get an AI chatbot to engage and get more customers!
=== Great features and the best texting & calling app ===
- Customizable text tone, ringtone & vibration
- Voicemail transcription: transcript of your voicemail
- Caller ID: show the incoming calls' phone number and contact name
- Greeting: record your sounds to greet customers
- Auto-reply: automatically message reply when you are busy
- Upgrade to send picture messages
- Great support service: contact us if you have any questions!
=== Premium and advanced features ===
- Change your second phone number with a one-time fee
- Upgrade to receive verification codes from major websites
- Upgrade to text or call 150+ international countries
- Upgrade to choose toll-free phone numbers
- Team number: manage the number with your team together
- Call schedule: set schedule for different time slots for different members
- Virtual receptionist: automated answers for calls and press x to redirect
- Get phone numbers from 60+ countries
- eSIM/SIM Card: upgrade to get a SIM card or eSIM to enable data for you
- WhatsApp ChatBot: upgrade to register WhatsApp business ChatBot
=== Download the app and get started ===
Privacy Policy
https://mysecondline.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use
https://mysecondline.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00099181:ios.name: Chess Puzzles: Tactics Trainer
bluejetty:00099181:ios.summary:
Turn every puzzle into progress. Train with 5M+ puzzles from real games, personalized to your level. When you make a mistake, understand why - and learn from it. That’s the idea we built this app around.
Solving more puzzles is useful, but
bluejetty:00099181:ios.description:
Turn every puzzle into progress. Train with 5M+ puzzles from real games, personalized to your level. When you make a mistake, understand why - and learn from it. That’s the idea we built this app around.
Solving more puzzles is useful, but we wanted training to be about more than getting a position right or wrong. We wanted every puzzle to teach you something - about the move you missed, the pattern you didn’t recognize, or the way you calculated the position. 
There are more than 5 million puzzles from real games. But the number itself isn’t really the point. What matters is finding the right positions for you, at the right difficulty, and helping you learn from them. When you make a mistake, you can understand why. Use hints, explore better moves, get coaching, and look deeper into the position instead of simply moving on to the next puzzle.
Over time, your training starts to reveal which tactical patterns give you the most trouble. You can practice across 64 motifs and patterns - forks, pins, sacrifices, checkmates, endgames, and many more - and spend more time on the ideas that need it. You can also see how your training develops over time: your rating, accuracy, training time, and performance across different patterns.
And when you’re ready for something truly advanced, there are more than 300,000 composed chess problems from solving competitions. They’re difficult, precise, often beautiful - and solving them can be one of the most satisfying forms of chess training.

listings.description:
Turn every puzzle into progress. Train with 5M+ puzzles from real games, personalized to your level. When you make a mistake, understand why - and learn from it. That’s the idea we built this app around.

What matters is finding the right positions for you, at the right difficulty, and helping you learn from them. When you make a mistake, you can understand why. Use hints, explore better moves, get coaching, and look deeper into the position instead of simply moving on to the next puzzle.

Live365 allows listeners to easily find the perfect station for any musical taste enabling the discovery of music and talk content you won’t find or hear anywhere else. Live365’s online radio stations are created by music and talk enthusiasts from hobbyists to professional broadcasters.
Live365 is different from other Internet Radio services because Live365 provides each broadcaster with the platform and tools they need to create their own online radio station and reach their audience. For the listener, this means more unique, diverse, and quality music and talk content over other radio services like AM/FM, Satellite, and other Online Radio networks with robotic playlists. Download the Live365 app today and start experiencing the Radio Revolution!

bluejetty:00091151:ios.description:
네이버플러스 스토어에서
쇼핑에이전트를 새롭게 만나보세요.
이제 막막한 탐색과 번거로운 비교는 끝나고,
쇼핑에이전트와 함께 더 쉽고 빠른 쇼핑이 시작됩니다.
• 궁금한 점을 바로 묻고 답하는 대화형 쇼핑
• 검색 결과 상단에서 선택 기준을 안내
• 상품 정보와 리뷰는 필요한 핵심만 요약
• 관심사에 맞춘 탐색 질문을 먼저 제안
[ 더 쉬워진 탐색, 더 커진 혜택 ]
+ 혜택의 필수 조건, 알림설정
앱 다운로드 후 알림설정을 켜보세요.
나에게 꼭 필요한 할인과 쿠폰 소식을 가장 먼저 보내드려요.
* 할인 및 쿠폰 소식은 알림 설정 후 확인
+ 취향 맞춤 추천과 혜택
내 취향에 딱 맞는 상품 추천부터 재구매 타이밍까지 알아서 챙겨주니까.
더 쉽고, 편안한 쇼핑 생활이 시작됩니다.
+ 빠르게 무료! 네이버 배송
멤버십 회원이라면, 배송비·반품비가 무료!
'오늘배송', '내일배송'은 기본, 주말에도 도착하는 '일요배송;
'원하는 날 받아보는 '희망일배송'까지.
이제 원하는 날 원하는 시간에 빠르게 받아보세요.
* 멤버십 회원 만원이상 구매 시 무료배송, 무료반품
* 자세한 내용은 홈페이지/앱에서 확인
+ 생활에 보템이 되는 멤버십 혜택
네이버플러스 멤버십 하나면 끝. 최대 10% 추가 적립은 기본,
넷플릭스, 스포티파이, 영화관, 편의점까지!
쇼핑 적립을 넘어 라이프스타일 전반에 혜택을 더해갑니다.
* 포인트 결제 금액 등은 적립 제외
* 슈퍼적립 10%는 슈퍼적립 대상 상품을 구매한 멤버십 회원에게만 제공
+ 콘텐츠로 만나는 트렌드, 네플픽
생동감 넘치고, 취향이 가득한 영상 콘텐츠를 즐겨보세요.
콘텐츠를 통해 내 취향에 딱 맞는 상품을 발견하게 될지도 몰라요.
+ 쇼핑을 더 빠르고 쉽게, 쇼핑에이전트
이제 쇼핑 흐름에 맞춰 필요한 기준과 정보를 요약해 제안하고, 대화로 쉽게 사는 쇼핑에이전트와 함께, 더 빠르게 쇼핑해보세요.
상품을 찾고 고민하는 모든 순간, 나에게 딱 맞춰 알아서 챙겨주니까. 사는 게 더 쉽고 즐거워질 거예요.
[네이버플러스 스토어 고객센터]
1599-1399 * 365일 연중무휴(발신자 부담)
쇼핑이나 멤버십 이용 중 도움이 필요한 경우 언제든지 고객센터로 연락해 주세요.
멤버십 전용 고객센터가 항상 여러분의 곁에서 든든한 파트너가 되어드리겠습니다.
※ 필수 접근 권한 상세
- 카메라: 제품 설명, 리뷰, 문의 등에 첨부할 사진/동영상을 촬영하기 위해 필요합니다.
- 사진: 제품 촬영 및 게시, 문의하기, 리뷰 작성 기능을 이용할 수 있습니다.
- 마이크: 리뷰 작성, 동영상 촬영 시 오디오 녹음 등을 위해 필요합니다.
- 연락처: 휴대폰에 저장된 연락처 정보를 사용하여 선물하기, 주소록 등의 기능을 이용할 수 있습니다.
- Face ID: 네이버페이 결제 등에서 기기에 등록된 Face ID를 사용하여 본인 인증을 수행하기 위해 필요합니다.
- 위치: 위치 기반 주변 스토어의 탐색을 위해 해당 권한이 필요합니다.

bluejetty:00186584:ios.name: Hidden Animals: Seek and Find
bluejetty:00186584:ios.summary: Discover what it feels like to be a wildlife photographer chasing both common and completely unfamiliar animals in remote corners of the world! Search for them on striking and realistic 360-degree panoramas of pristine scenery with 3-D visu
bluejetty:00186584:ios.description:
Discover what it feels like to be a wildlife photographer chasing both common and completely unfamiliar animals in remote corners of the world! Search for them on striking and realistic 360-degree panoramas of pristine scenery with 3-D visual effects. 
Key features:
- Realistic 360-degree panoramas and 3D views
- Take in the sights and the actual sounds of a living forest, jungle, or savanna
- Replay! Go through scenes again to find new, more unusual and fascinating creatures here
- You can access encyclopedia pages with detailed information without leaving the game
In this hidden objects game, your allies are crisp HD graphics, and animals' names and outlines; special hints are available in case the task gets too challenging. If you just want to relax, take in the sights and the actual sounds of a living forest, jungle, or savanna, and if you have a competitive streak, collect your photographic trophies! We are convinced that even wildlife experts will encounter some unusual and fascinating creatures here. Whenever you want to learn more about any of them, you can access encyclopedia pages with detailed information without leaving the game. 
Play together with your kid: this game is fun as well as educational, and it helps improve attention!
We'll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp - make comments, ask questions, get news about coming games!

bluejetty:00096410:ios.description:
Plan to Escape & Run is a thrilling jobs adventure where every second counts and every decision could mean freedom—or capture. You play as a clever inmate trapped in a high-security, determined to break free using brains, stealth, and speed. Your mission: explore the facility, gather hidden tools, and craft the perfect escape plan without getting caught.
Navigate through locked doors, security cameras, and patrolling guards as you uncover secret passages and solve puzzles to unlock your path. Each level presents new challenges, from decoding keypads to distracting guards with clever tricks. The more you explore, the more escape routes you’ll discover but choose wisely, because one wrong move could send you back to your cell.
Customize your character, upgrade your gear, and unlock new abilities to improve your chances of success. Whether you prefer sneaky stealth or bold breakouts, the game adapts to your play style. With immersive environments, suspenseful gameplay, and a gripping storyline, Plan to Escape & Run delivers an unforgettable escape experience.
Are you ready to outsmart the system, dodge danger, and run for your life? The prison walls won’t hold you forever. It’s time to plan, escape, and run!

bluejetty:00065928:ios.description:
Think you have fast reflexes? Death Run 3D is a high-speed survival game built for players who crave a real challenge. You’re flying through a neon tube packed with moving blocks, and one wrong move ends your run. It’s simple, brutal, and incredibly addictive.
In Death Run 3D, the gaps are tight and the speed never lets up. Most obstacles shift and move as you approach, forcing you to make split-second decisions. If you’re tired of easy runners and want something that actually tests your coordination, this is it.
Why you’ll keep playing:
- Infinite Running: The further you go, the faster it gets. There is no finish line—only your next high score.
- Dynamic Obstacles: Blocks move, spin, and slide. You can’t just memorize the path; you have to react in real-time.
- Global Leaderboards: See how you stack up against the best players worldwide. Every point counts when you’re chasing the top spot.
- Unlock New Levels: Hit high score milestones to open up even more intense challenges.
- Pure Skill: No power-ups to save you here. It’s just your hands versus the machine.
Join thousands of players trying to master the tube in Death Run 3D. How long can you survive before the blocks catch up to you?
Download now for free on iOS!

bluejetty:00077714:ios.developer: ORIENT BASIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY PTE. LTD.
bluejetty:00077714:ios.summary:
Lesbian Short Dramas, Stories & Community
Discover sapphic stories, share what inspires you, and find a community that understands you. LesPark is a social entertainment app created for lesbian, bisexual, queer, sapphic, and LGBTQ+ women.
bluejetty:00077714:ios.description:
Lesbian Short Dramas, Stories & Community
Discover sapphic stories, share what inspires you, and find a community that understands you. LesPark is a social entertainment app created for lesbian, bisexual, queer, sapphic, and LGBTQ+ women. Explore lesbian short dramas, follow creators, join interest-based communities, and share your own posts and videos.
Whether you’re part of the WLW community—women who love women—or simply looking for stories and conversations that feel closer to your experience, LesPark offers a place to watch, create, and connect.
LESBIAN SHORT DRAMAS & SAPPHIC STORIES
Find short dramas featuring women-led stories, compelling characters, and relationships between women. From romance and campus stories to mysteries, complicated reunions, and emotional second chances, there are different kinds of lesbian and GL dramas to explore.
Start with a story that matches your mood:
《Such a Good Girl》A designer returns to the life of her former girlfriend with a plan for revenge. But old feelings and complicated loyalties make it harder to know who is using whom.
《ONE BY ONE》A doctor and a wedding planner investigate the same unresolved case for different reasons. As they uncover hidden truths, suspicion gives way to an unexpected connection.
《Forbidden Us》Three years after their breakup, two women meet again and find themselves facing the past—and the feelings they never quite left behind.
《NOT INTO LOVE》At a prestigious girls’ school, one student is determined to focus on her studies. Then new friendships and unexpected attention make her plans more complicated.
《Love Me Against》A wealthy heiress and her devoted bodyguard navigate loyalty, control, and a bond that becomes more complicated than either expects.
Discover a drama that fits your taste, follow the stories you enjoy, and share your favourite moments and plot twists with other fans.
A COMMUNITY FOR WLW WOMEN
LesPark is made for women across the LGBTQ+ community, including lesbian, bisexual, queer, and sapphic women. Find people who share your interests, follow creators, join groups, and take part in conversations about dramas, hobbies, culture, and everyday life.
Looking for a group that shares your favourite genre, a creative interest, or an enthusiasm for a particular story? Explore community posts and groups to discover people with something in common. Connect with women nearby or explore perspectives from around the world.
CREATE AND SHARE YOUR OWN CONTENT
LesPark is not only a place to watch stories. It’s also a space to share yours. Post photos, short videos, thoughts, recommendations, and other creative content. Use creative tools and video templates to express your personality and bring your ideas to life.
Follow creators whose work you enjoy, respond to posts, and share your own take on a drama or topic. Whether you’re making videos, recommending a story, or starting a conversation around a shared interest, your perspective can help make the community richer.
A WOMEN-CENTRED SPACE
LesPark is designed around the interests and experiences of LGBTQ+ women. We want users to have more control over how they participate and what they see. Set your privacy and content preferences, manage who can contact you, and use blocking and reporting tools when needed. Community moderation helps support a more respectful environment.
No online community can guarantee every interaction will be comfortable, so we encourage everyone to use the available safety tools and follow community guidelines. Share only what you feel comfortable sharing, and report content or behaviour that concerns you.
LesPark VIP
LesPark VIP offers additional profile features, exclusive badges, and options to personalise your experience. Subscription details, including pricing and renewal terms, are shown in the app before purchase.
Discover lesbian short dramas, explore sapphic stories, share your creativity, and find your WLW community on LesPark.
Official website: https://www.lespark.us/

bluejetty:00127840:ios.summary:
DESCRIPTION

bluejetty:00127840:ios.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Xerox® Workplace mobile app enables simple local printing and scanning with your Xerox MFP. When used in conjunction with Xerox® Workplace Cloud / Suite (www.Xerox.com/mobile), it further allows users to connect in a controlled secure way from any anywhere, to any device over any network (without direct printer connection.) 
KEY STANDARD FEATURES
-Add and connect to a printer by simply scanning the printer specific QR Code or using NFC to tap on NFC-enabled MFP
-Open documents directly from this app for easy print and preview
- Use the camera function to capture a picture and then print it
-Select print options such as 1-Sided/ 2-Sided, color/ black-white, stapled, paper-size, page range, and Secure Print pin (for direct print only)
-Print directly from other applications such as Dropbox, Google Drive and more
-Integrated Public/Hot Spot printing
-Scan documents from your MFP wirelessly from within the app
Additional Features when used with Xerox Workplace Suite or Cloud
- Controlled and secure user permissions with mobile app user account log in
- Unlock supported Xerox Printers, using the mobile app instead of a card (unlock code or NFC)
- Print to Xerox, Fuji Xerox and non-Xerox including HP, Ricoh, Epson, Canon and others’ network print devices
- Print MS Office, Adobe Acrobat, email, text, Open Office and various image formats
- Use GPS to find locations and available printers
- View the currently selected printer status
- Print documents immediately or upload them securely for release later at any licensed printer (pull print)
- Job accounting support
- Capability to integrate with a single release queue including jobs sent from desktop PC, MAC and Chrome book
- View all waiting pull print jobs to release at any printer from your mobile device
Feature availability depends on Xerox Workplace solution Mobile Print solution version and Administrator configuration
HOW TO GET STARTED WITH XEROX® WORKPLACE
1.) Obtain your Company Code information for your Xerox® Workplace Solution from your administrator
2.) Download and install Xerox® Workplace App
3.) Register & Login to Xerox® Workplace using your Company Code and Credentials
4.) Browse your Mobile Device and open a document to print
5.) Select “Open In…” using Workplace to Upload, Preview & Print your Documents*
6.) Select an available printer, printer options and release your document
*Actual names and availability of menu commands may vary across mobile platforms.
Visit www.xerox.com/mobile for more information on Xerox Mobile Solutions

bluejetty:00089200:ios.description:
Locker is the answer to your endless screenshots, shopping tabs, and notes app links. You can save any online product you want to your organized collections in seconds. Login to discover from thousands of shoppers’ curated Collections, invite your friends to see what they’re eyeing, create Collaborative Collections to shop together, visualize products you want before you buy them through Collages, and make a Giftable Collection so you never get a gift you don’t want. 
It's the same utility and discoverability you love from our Locker Chrome Extension now at your fingertips whenever you scroll social media or shop on any device.
How it works:
-Download our free mobile app and LOGIN if you already have a Locker account.
-SAVE any product you want by clicking “share” (box with arrow) on any product page on any online website.
-Choose the COLLECTION you want to save a product to, or even create a new one so you never lose track of your wants.
-DISCOVER what thousands of other shoppers are saving, and even search by category, brand or Locker username.
-SHARE links to your curated collections with your friends easily over text and through social media.
More reasons that shoppers love Locker:
-COLLABORATE on collections with your friends. It's perfect for planning your next girls trip or bachelorette!
-Create PRIVATE or even GIFTABLE collections. Don't leave your friends guessing, show them what you actually have on your wishlist.
-Curate COLLAGES with shoppable products. Visualize outfits or room layouts before you buy the products!
-DISCOVER new brands & amazing sales. The Locker team curates weekly shopping edits of trending products!
-Earn REWARDS for online shopping! Join our Payback program to become eligible for cashback and commissions, and you can also apply for our Locker Shopping Club to earn from shoppers you refer to sign up.
-Join a COMMUNITY of social shoppers. Locker was built by everyday shoppers for everyday shoppers, no matter your vibe or social stats.

bluejetty:00184943:ios.summary:
Following the worldwide successes of Pro Snooker, Pro Pool and our other sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Darts 2026; one of the most feature packed and playable darts games available for mobile devices.
With fully textured 3D gam
bluejetty:00184943:ios.description:
Following the worldwide successes of Pro Snooker, Pro Pool and our other sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Darts 2026; one of the most feature packed and playable darts games available for mobile devices.
With fully textured 3D game environments, specialist custom boards for standard and more obscure game types, and millions of possible dart component combinations, Pro Darts 2026 is the complete package for both casual and serious gamers.
The simple 'swipe to throw' interface combined with an innovative adjustable 'player assist' system allows everyone from novices to pros to pick up and play the game instantly at their own skill level.
Download Pro Darts 2026 now and try it for free, you will not be disappointed.
System Requirements:
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.
∙ Supports iOS 15.0+
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices
∙ Game Center compatible
Game Features:
∙ Localised to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, American English, Canadian English, Canadian French and Mexican Spanish.
∙ Full High Def 3D textured environments.
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own.
∙ Quick Play: Play a custom match against a friend, family member or computer opponent.
∙ League: Participate in league events with 3, 5, 7 or 9 rounds where the highest points total wins.
∙ Tournament: Test your nerves in a 4 round knockout tournament event.
∙ Configure up to 4 unique player profiles.
∙ Each profile holds 5 custom darts, comprehensive stats and progression history.
∙ Custom dart configuration system allows for millions of combinations of barrels, stems, stem colors, flight shapes and textures.
∙ Innovative 'player assist' system to help with getting those tricky doubles and trebles.
∙ 3 levels of Oche (throw line) camera to suit all playing styles.
∙ User controlled Orbit Camera and Snapshot system allows you to save close up images of your dart grouping.
∙ Ranking system from Rookie to Legend.
∙ 28 computer opponents with customizable names. Play against the pros!
∙ Over 10 unique dart boards including 'American', 'Par Darts', 'Hi Score', 'Quadro', 'Mini', 'Snooker', 'Yorkshire', 'Fives' and 'Target' boards, each with multiple color options.
∙ Play 301, 401, 501, 601, 701 and 1001 games on many of the custom boards.
∙ Play 'Round the Clock' including special 'doubles' and 'trebles' only variations.
∙ Play 'Snooker' darts on three custom boards and standard boards.
∙ Play 'Par Darts' (Golf) on three custom boards.
∙ Play 305, 405, 505, 605, 705 or 1005 'Fives' games on either the London 'narrow' fives board or the Ipswich 'wide' fives board.
∙ Play 'Cricket Darts'.
∙ Complete control over the numbers of Sets and Legs per match.
∙ Multiplayer game modes including ‘Online Play’, ‘Local Network’ and 'Pass and Play'.
∙ Over 25 achievements to collect locally or via Game Center.
∙ Track your game progress and achievement progress locally in the new 3D Trophy Room.

bluejetty:00119168:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of GOJO: the ride-sharing or e-hailing app for all passengers.
Now you can book a trip, make a car reservation, ride hourly, and get from point A to point B seamlessly. With GOJO, you can access the most convenient booking service for private cars and taxis from the largest community of drivers in the region. Rest assured: you’re going to get to your destination safely and swiftly.
Whatever you need, GOJO has you covered.
Book Rides anywhere
We pride ourselves on having both e-hailing or ride-sharing functions available today. Are you a frequent traveler? Are you planning a trip? GOJO is ready to support you with airport pickup, airport rides, and more. If you can dream it, GOJO can do it.
Rides for All Occasions and Costs
* Grab the Nearest Car: Simply open the app and find a nearby car or taxi that can get you to your destination.
* Upfront Fixed Fares: Never wonder what your taxi is going to cost you again. Check out the fare right in the app.
* Affordable Everyday Pricing: Enjoy access to affordable, everyday pricing in our cars, taxis, or luxury cars. Ride alone or with a group.
* Scheduled Rides: Did you know you can schedule rides ahead of time? If you know you are going to need an intercity ride or a long-distance ride, you can program that time and place right into the app.
* Airport Pickup: Landing at the airport? Why wait for a taxi when you can pre-schedule your airport ride?
* Book Now or Book Later: Whatever fits your schedule that day!
* Delivery: Contactless, door-to-door delivery made fast and easy. We’ll be launching this soon!
* Car of Your Choice: Book a car of your choosing so you can ride in style to your destination.
The Ride-Sharing App Made for You
Unlike Grab, Bolt, Careem, Ola, Didi, MyCar, EzCab, Maxim, Dacsee and Uber, we care about you, your well-being, and your safety. We believe our customers deserve to get the premium, safe and affordable services. That’s what you can count on when you drive with us today. Look out for new intercity bookings and delivery features coming soon on GOJO.
Become a GOJO Driver
Do you want to run your own e-hailing business? Driving with us just got easier. No more jostling for passengers or driving dead miles. Visit this link for driver signup information: https://www.gojo.global/driver/.
Available in All Major Cities Worldwide
New and exciting updates are going to GOJO ride-sharing app this year! Be sure to stay tuned.
Find out more about GOJO at https://www.gojo.global

bluejetty:00079048:ios.description: Introducing Truck Depot, the ultimate casual idle game for truck management! Take charge of your own trucking business and watch it thrive. Unlock a parking spot and witness trucks rolling in. As the driver steps out, unlock a restroom for them. Once relieved, they'll earn profits. The driver then waits by the truck as you hire a worker to load goods from the warehouse onto the truck. Each loaded item generates income. With each truck carrying 20 goods, the cargo gradually accumulates. Once filled, the driver boards the truck, vacating the spot for a new arrival. Trucks head to the fueling area where you unlock a gas pump. Tap on it to refuel, taking 10 seconds. A full tank rewards you. Unlock more parking spots, offices (for hiring more workers), gas stations, restrooms, restaurants (where drivers purchase burgers for profits), and even a bathhouse (where drivers relax and earn). Experience the joy of managing a truck empire in Truck Depot!

bluejetty:00175888:ios.description:
myHealthCheck360 guides you on your journey to a healthier life. Access your personal health information to uncover the risks your body may be hiding. Work directly with our bilingual Health Coaches to improve your health or overcome your habits including unhealthy eating, nicotine use, and more. Track activity towards your company’s wellness challenges, connect with friends and colleagues with custom 1-on-1 challenges, and earn badges for hitting milestones. 
Nutrition trackers
 * Barcode scanning makes it easy to search and log your food, and keep track of your health.
 * We have over 550,000 foods in our database, with brand names and common foods to ensure that you’ll find your favorites.
Activity & Health tracking
 * Track your exercise, steps, weight, sleep, blood pressure, heart rate, cholesterol, glucose, nicotine, and more. 
Health challenges
 * Participate in company-wide health challenges with and against your colleagues. Create your own fun challenges and have fun getting healthy.
Biometric surveys and screenings
 * Take your Health Risk Assessment (HRA) survey on the go with the myHealthCheck360 app
 * Access your biometric screening results
 * Earn a score based on your results and gain access to ways to improve
Lifestyle Rewards
 * Be healthy, get rewarded.
 * Whether it’s going to the doctor, running a 5k, or logging your nutrition habits, you’ll be eligible for credits and monetary rewards based on your organization’s preferences. 
Apple Health integration
 * Retrieve existing health data from Apple Health for increased accuracy and ease-of-entry.
 * Send your entries to Apple Health to share with other apps.

bluejetty:00186675:ios.summary:

EXPLORE THE COSMOS
Search,
bluejetty:00186675:ios.description:
Explore the universe of exoplanets — over 6,000 confirmed worlds orbiting distant stars, updated from leading scientific archives. Track new discoveries as they happen and dive into the data behind every planet.
EXPLORE THE COSMOS
Search, filter, and sort the complete catalogue of confirmed exoplanets. Find planets by discovery method, star type, orbital characteristics, or habitability potential. Every entry includes detailed scientific data from peer-reviewed sources.
ATMOSPHERIC SPECTRA
Browse JWST and Hubble transmission spectra for planets where atmospheric data is available. Toggle molecular overlays for CO2, CH4, H2O, CO and more to see which absorption features have been detected.
3D SYSTEM VIEW
Step into a planetary system in 3D — see each planet's orbit around its host star with realistic shading and a visualisation of the habitable zone. On iPhone and iPad you can also place a system into your environment in AR.
COMPARE WORLDS
Analyze exoplanets side-by-side — or compare them with Solar System planets like Earth, Jupiter, and Mars. Compare sizes, masses, orbital periods, star properties, and habitability scores to understand what makes each world unique.
HABITABLE ZONE VISUALIZATION
See exactly where planets orbit within their star's habitable zone — the region where liquid water could exist. Identify potentially Earth-like worlds and understand the conditions for life beyond our solar system.
FEATURES
• 6,000+ confirmed exoplanets with detailed scientific data
• Atmospheric spectra with molecular overlays
• 3D system view with AR mode
• Advanced filtering and sorting
• Planet comparison tool with Solar System reference
• Habitable zone analysis
• Spotlight search with deep linking
• Home screen widgets
• Apple Watch companion app
• Bookmark favorites with iCloud sync
• Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro
GO PREMIUM
Enjoying the app? Premium takes it further — unlimited bookmarks, the full planet comparison tool, and additional widgets. A small yearly upgrade that makes a big difference.
Whether you're a curious stargazer, student, educator, or researcher, Exoplanet Explorer puts the cosmos in your pocket.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://the-exoplanets.space/eula/
Privacy Policy: https://the-exoplanets.space/privacy/

bluejetty:00015286:ios.name: Halloween Games for Kids!
bluejetty:00015286:ios.summary: ***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum.
bluejetty:00015286:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum. 
Trick or treat, it’s Halloween! Educational specialists from an award-winning studio 22learn treat you to a series of EDUCATIONAL AND CREATIVE GAMES for TODDLERS AND PRESCHOOLERS that brim with gruesome ghosts, amber lights, adorable monsters, and plump pumpkins.
================================
Engaging and just the right amount of scary—get your children the Halloween app they’ll love!
================================
Dress your Dracula in ghoulish pink and turn the sky green in our Halloween-themed coloring book. Spell Halloween words. Carve funny pumpkins and practice matching with our pumpkin maker. Train your memory with an assortment of colorful creatures. Learn to trace letters and associate them with Halloween words that begin with these letters. And much more!
FEATURES:
* 11 fantastic Halloween-themed games
* Practice in matching, memory, tracing, spelling, and creative skills
* Loads of ghosts, pumpkins, candles, and candies
* Halloween music
* Professional voice-over
* Intuitive, child-friendly interface
EDUCATIONAL CONTENT:
* Matching
* Tracing letters
* Spelling
* Memory
* Creativity
GAMES:
* Pumpkin Maker: Create Your Pumpkin and Pumpkin Matching
Make a matching pumpkin! Or make your own! Which face, nose, or smile is your child’s pumpkin going to have?
* Tracing Letters: Uppercase or Lowercase
Learn to trace all the letters of the English alphabet. Lovely Halloween pictures that accompany each letter provide additional opportunities for awareness of connection between letters and words.
* First Words: Matching and Make a Word
All the letters in the Halloween-themed words got mixed up. Can your child drag them back to make the word?
* Memory Games: Easy, Medium, and Hard
With three levels of difficulty, Memory Games offer plenty of opportunities for improving memory. Children can start from the easy level and word their way to the most difficult one.
* Coloring Book: Matching Colors and Coloring Book
What color does your child’s Dracula like to wear? And what color would he or she give to a ghost? In our coloring book, children expand their imagination as they consider creative ways to color the scenes we prepared for them.
Based on our two-decade old experience in development of educational software, we made this app developmentally appropriate and easy to use for children. We hope your children have fun playing! Happy Halloween!

bluejetty:00023190:ios.description:
My Aurora Forecast is the best app for seeing the Northern Lights. Built with a sleek dark design, it appeals to both tourists and serious aurora watchers by telling you what you want to know - whether that is exactly how likely you are to see the aurora borealis or details about the solar winds and high-resolution sun imagery. With this app, you'll be seeing the Northern Lights in no time.
- Find the current KP index and how likely you are to see the Northern Lights in the United States or the rest of the world.
- View a list of the best locations to view from right now.
- Map showing how strong the aurora is around the world, based on the SWPC ovation auroral forecast.
- Free push notifications when auroral activity is expected to be high.
- Forecasts for the next hour, several hours and several weeks so you can plan your Northern Lights viewing long in advance (subject to weather conditions).
- Solar wind statistics and sun imagery.
- View live aurora webcams from around the world.
- Tour information so if you're considering to go to locations such as Iceland, Sweden, Finland or even Alaska or Canada, you'll be able to find tours that we can recommend to you.
- Support for the latest iPhone and iPad models.
- Completely free of charge for all functionality, no in-app purchases.
If you want the latest updates on geomagnetic activity and enjoy viewing the aurora borealis, this app is right for you. This version is ad-supported and is similar to other apps such as Aurora Forecast., SpaceWeatherLive and hello aurora.

bluejetty:00163409:ios.description:
Build a club. Win the flag.
Footy Mayhem 26 puts you on the oval as coach, manager and match-winner. Build your list, back your skills, and chase premiership glory season after season.
PLAY THE GAME 
• Pick-up-and-play controls — run, handball, and launch kicks with precision
• Real footy action — fly for marks, spoil packs, win ruck contests, snap from the boundary
• Master the kick meter — hit the sweet spot or shank it off the side of the boot
• Smart teammates that lead, crumb and defend — opponents punish every mistake
• Quick Match or Practice mode — jump in anytime
BUILD A DYNASTY
• Run your club across multiple seasons and finals campaigns
• Build your list — draft, trade, develop and manage contracts
• Hire staff — scouts, coaches, medics — each shaping your club
• Navigate the off-season — trades, retirements, tough calls
• Manage form, fitness and injuries
• Weather, wind and crowd all impact match day
BIG GAME MOMENTS
• Nail a goal and feel the crowd erupt
• Camera swings onto your kicker in clutch moments
• Commentary calls the action as it unfolds
• Lift the cup on grand final day
BUILT FOR PHONE
• One-hand friendly controls
• Play quick matches or full seasons
• No account required — your career is saved locally
FAIR PLAY MODEL
• Play free — jump into matches and try the game with no pressure
• Unlock the full career after a few games
• No ads, no pay-to-win, no endless purchases
• Buy once and own the full experience forever
Pick your club. Back your skills. Chase the flag.

bluejetty:00027256:ios.description:
EasyCanvas, turn your iPad into a wired or wireless liquid crystal tablet
EasyCanvas is an app that lets you use your iPad as a wired or wireless liquid crystal tablet.
Draw directly in PC programs such as Photoshop and Clip Studio through your iPad.
▶ Excellent performance of iPad and Apple Pencil
Now, if you have a iPad and Apple Pencil, you don't need to buy an expensive LCD tablet.
The excellent hardware of the iPad is combined with the technology of EasyCanvas to make the perfect LCD tablet.
▶ Familiarize yourself with drawing on paper
It fully supports ""Palm Rejection"", which allows you to draw with your palm on the screen, and ""Pen Pressure"" and ""Tilt"" of the Apple Pencil.
Also, the stable performance makes the screen and stylus movement smoother.
▶ Independent Virtual Display Solution
Easy&Light's virtual display solution provides extended display. 
It can be used as an extended monitor in triple or higher environments as well as a dual monitor.
▶ Simultaneous wired/wireless connection support
It supports both stable USB connection and convenient wireless connection via Wi-Fi.
Now work anywhere, anytime, any way you want.
Pay after you experience it for yourself!
We provide a trial function that you can use for free for 3 days.
[Support Environment]
PC: Windows 10 (WDDM version 2.0 or later)
iPad : iOS 12.2 or later iPad
- Support : http://www.easynlight.com/en/supporteasycanvas
- Privacy policy : https://www.easynlight.com/easycanvaspolicy/

Lilucat's QR Code Reader is the essential digital tool that empowers you to scan and interpret all types of QR codes, encompassing URLs, Wi-Fi, Calendar events, VCards, Contacts, Text, Email, Geo locations, and more.
Beyond just scanning,
bluejetty:00172329:ios.description:
Lilucat's QR Code Reader is the essential digital tool that empowers you to scan and interpret all types of QR codes, encompassing URLs, Wi-Fi, Calendar events, VCards, Contacts, Text, Email, Geo locations, and more.
Beyond just scanning, Lilucat's QR Code Reader also facilitates the generation of QR codes for a myriad of purposes, be it social media platforms (like TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, etc.), URLs, Wi-Fi networks, VCards, Contact details, and beyond.
Key Features:
Rapid QR code scanning.
Dynamic QR code generation.
Integrate codes directly into Apple Wallet.
Conveniently add codes to Widgets.
Scan QR codes and barcodes directly from images.
Maintain a comprehensive scan history.
Sync and ensure your scans are always backed up.
* In order to use QR Code Reader you need to purchase the Lilucat Pro which is an annual service that costs 29.99$. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and auto-renews at the same price unless disabled in iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your subscription can be managed in your iTunes Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Links
Terms of Service: https://qrcode.lilucat.com/legal/terms
Privacy: https://qrcode.lilucat.com/legal/privacy

bluejetty:00155320:ios.description:
Apeman Strong is more than just an apparel brand — it’s a movement rooted in resilience, strength, and overcoming adversity. Built for those who’ve faced challenges and come out stronger, our gear is designed to inspire and empower. From the gym to everyday life, Apeman Strong apparel combines bold, iconic designs with high-quality materials, making it a favorite among athletes, lifters, and anyone who embodies the “Stronger Than Yesterday” mindset. With over $100,000 donated to charitable causes, we’re proud to stand behind a mission that’s about more than shirts — it’s about strength, inside and out.
Now, shopping Apeman Strong is easier and more rewarding than ever with the launch of our new mobile app. The app gives you early access to exclusive product drops, flash sales, and limited-edition gear only available through the app. You’ll be the first to know about new releases with push notifications and in-app alerts, so you never miss a drop. It’s the fastest way to shop, get rewarded, and stay connected to the Apeman Strong community — all from the palm of your hand.

bluejetty:00023664:ios.description:
The app provides contents and services about astrology, biorhythm, numerology and palmistry.
Astrology is a mystery that claims to divine information about human affairs and terrestrial events by studying the movements and relative positions of celestial objects. 
Astrology has been dated to at least the 2nd millennium BCE, and has its roots in calendrical systems used to predict seasonal shifts and to interpret celestial cycles as signs of divine communications. Western astrology, one of the oldest astrological systems still in use, can trace its roots to 19th–17th century BCE Mesopotamia, from which it spread to Ancient Greece, Rome, the Arab world and eventually Central and Western Europe. Contemporary Western astrology is often associated with systems of horoscopes that purport to explain aspects of a person's personality and predict significant events in their lives based on the positions of celestial objects; the majority of professional astrologers rely on such systems.
A biorhythm is an attempt to predict various aspects of a person's life through simple mathematical cycles. A person's life is influenced by rhythmic biological cycles that affect his or her ability in various domains, such as mental, physical and emotional activity. These cycles begin at birth and oscillate in a steady (sine wave) fashion throughout life, and by modeling them mathematically, it is suggested that a person's level of ability in each of these domains can be predicted from day to day.
Numbers hold value, both numerical and spiritual. Numerology, in its simplest terms, is the relationship between a number and its mystical nature on both an individual and worldly level. Numerology is also the study of the numerical value of the alphabet. Similar to an astrological natal chart, a numerology portrait is your personalized guide to life. It reveals your strengths, weaknesses, and who you could become. 
Palmistry is the claim of characterization and foretelling the future through the study of the palm, also known as chirology, or in popular culture as palm reading. The practice is found all over the world, with numerous cultural variations. Those who practice chiromancy are generally called palmists, hand readers, hand analysts, or chirologists.
The three lines found on almost all hands, and generally given most weight by palmists:
● The heart line is the first of the major lines examined by a reader and represents love and attraction.
● The next line identified by palmists is the head line. Palmists generally interpret this line to represent their subject's mind and the way it works.
● The life line is perhaps the most controversial line on the hand.The life line is believed to reflect major life changes.
