bluejetty:00044003:ios.summary:
iBobber can now display fish detection and depth info on your Apple Watch!
Love at first cast. The fishfinder that  syncs with your iPhone or iPad.
There’s a lot to love about iBobber™. It syncs via Bluetooth® Smart (Bluetooth Low Energy
bluejetty:00044003:ios.description:
iBobber can now display fish detection and depth info on your Apple Watch!
Love at first cast. The fishfinder that  syncs with your iPhone or iPad.
There’s a lot to love about iBobber™. It syncs via Bluetooth® Smart (Bluetooth Low Energy Technology) with your iOS device up to 100’ away from a boat, shore, kayak, or pier, so you have a fishfinder with a solid connection, that won't deplete your phone's battery like wi-fi does, a fishfinder that goes up to 8hrs on a charge, that's half the size and weight— a fishfinder that’s as mobile as you are.
The Bluetooth Smart standard is different from the Bluetooth® used in other fishfinders. 
Bluetooth Smart is designed for short messages from nearby devices such as temperature sensors, proximity sensors, and medical devices such as heart monitors, and now sonar signals. 
The iBobber app in conjunction with the iBobber bobber (sold separately) enables you to locate fish up to 135’ under water, GPS Tag favorite hotspots, map the contour o waterbeds, and measure water temperature.
You’ll love that you can save all your fishing adventures with the Trip Log, and share them all on social media. You’ll also love the Lunar Calendar, Fish Alarm, Strike Alarm, Bobber Beacon, Weather sync, and the app’s stunning graphics.
iBobber is for anyone who loves to find fish, and wants to catch more of them.  Just cast the bobber (sold separately) and Ping! the iBobber app syncs via Bluetooth Smart and displays where the fish are. 
  The iBobber app is designed for one-handed use, and can help make fishing more fun  than it's ever been. Even if you have a boat-mounted fishfinder, iBobber can free  you from seeing fish only under your boat.  And finding more fish is always a lot  more fun than just fishing!
iBobber App Features:
Sonar Screen
Locate Fish at Depths up to 135ft
Depth Scale
Fish Tagged with Depth
Sonar Status Dashboard
Battery Status (up to 8hrs of charge)
Water Temperature
Fish Alarm (on/off)
Strike Alarm (on/off/adjustable)
Bobber Beacon (on/off)
Trip Log
Just tap any GPS Tag button on any screen and the Date, Time, and Location of your trip auto-loads in Trip Log. Name your trip, then log conditions and the type of fishing. Log lures the fish are hitting on, and species of fish you've caught. Then share it all on social media with your friends who are stuck back in the office.
Date 
Time 
Location (GPS coordinates)
Title
Lure
Conditions
Type of Fishing
Fish Caught (type & number)
Notes
Share: Facebook, Twitter, Mail, Text
Waterbed Mapping
Map the contour of the bottom up to 100ft. Just cast, tap Begin, get ready  to a count of 5, then reel the  iBobber over the area to map,  tap Stop, and have a look at the waterbed map, and see the contours of the bottom (up to 135' deep).
Lunar Calendar
Moonrise / moonset 
Sunrise / sunset 
The monthly lunar calendar will give you the moon phases by day and date. And you can also get the moon rise and set, and the sunrise and set— just tap today's date to see it.
Weather
iBobber weather is GPS based and provides current temperature, estimated high and low temperature for the day, the percentage chance of rain, wind speed and what direction it's blowing in from, as well as the barometric pressure.
Settings
Bluetooth Smart Sync
Imperial / Metric 
Sonar Demo. And Waterbed Mapping speed adjustment. 
Bobber Specs
Sonar Depth: Up to 135ft / 41m
Bluetooth® Smart Range: Up to 100 ft / 30m
Sonar: Single Beam, 90º, 118 kHz
Power: Auto-On in water
Units: Imperial / Metric
Battery: 3.7V Rechargeable
Battery Charge: Up to 8 hours
Size: 59mm Diameter
Weight: 47gm / 1.7oz

You’ll love that you can save all your fishing adventures with the Trip Log, and share them all on social media. You’ll also love the Lunar Calendar, Fish Alarm, Strike Alarm, Bobber Beacon, Weather sync, and the app’s stunning graphics.

iBobber is for anyone who loves to find fish, and wants to catch more of them.  Just cast the bobber (sold separately) and Ping! the iBobber app syncs via Bluetooth Smart and displays where the fish are. 

  The iBobber app is designed for one-handed use, and can help make fishing more fun  than it's ever been. Even if you have a boat-mounted fishfinder, iBobber can free  you from seeing fish only under your boat.  And finding more fish is always a lot  more fun than just fishing!


iBobber App Features:

Sonar Screen

Locate Fish at Depths up to 135ft
Depth Scale
Fish Tagged with Depth


Sonar Status Dashboard

Battery Status (up to 8hrs of charge)
Water Temperature
Fish Alarm (on/off)
Strike Alarm (on/off/adjustable)
Bobber Beacon (on/off)


Trip Log

Just tap any GPS Tag button on any screen and the Date, Time, and Location of your trip auto-loads in Trip Log. Name your trip, then log conditions and the type of fishing. Log lures the fish are hitting on, and species of fish you've caught. Then share it all on social media with your friends who are stuck back in the office.

Date 
Time 
Location (GPS coordinates)
Title
Lure
Conditions
Type of Fishing
Fish Caught (type & number)
Notes

Share: Facebook, Twitter, Mail, Text


Waterbed Mapping

Map the contour of the bottom up to 100ft. Just cast, tap Begin, get ready  to a count of 5, then reel the  iBobber over the area to map,  tap Stop, and have a look at the waterbed map, and see the contours of the bottom (up to 135' deep).


Lunar Calendar

Moonrise / moonset 
Sunrise / sunset 
The monthly lunar calendar will give you the moon phases by day and date. And you can also get the moon rise and set, and the sunrise and set— just tap today's date to see it.



Weather

iBobber weather is GPS based and provides current temperature, estimated high and low temperature for the day, the percentage chance of rain, wind speed and what direction it's blowing in from, as well as the barometric pressure.


Settings

Bluetooth Smart Sync
Imperial / Metric 
Sonar Demo. And Waterbed Mapping speed adjustment.

bluejetty:00062742:ios.name: Swift Playground
bluejetty:00062742:ios.summary: Swift Playground makes it fun to learn to code and build real apps. You solve interactive puzzles in the guided “Get Started with Code” and learn the basics of building apps in “Get Started with Apps.” You experiment with a wide range of ch
bluejetty:00062742:ios.description:
Swift Playground makes it fun to learn to code and build real apps. You solve interactive puzzles in the guided “Get Started with Code” and learn the basics of building apps in “Get Started with Apps.” You experiment with a wide range of challenges and samples that let you explore unique coding experiences.
Swift Playground doesn’t require any coding experience — it’s perfect for anyone just starting out, from eight to one-hundred-and-eight. The whole time you are learning Swift and SwiftUI, the powerful programming technologies created by Apple and used by professionals around the globe to build many of today’s most popular apps. And because it’s built to take advantage of iPad and the real iOS SDK, Swift Playground provides a one of a kind learning experience.
Lessons Built-in
• Apple-created lessons guide you through the core concepts of programming by using code to solve puzzles
• See your code run in a beautiful, interactive 3D world that you can rotate with a finger and pinch to zoom
• Animations introduce each new coding concept at a high-level before you dive into the puzzles
• Glossary and built-in help pages give detailed information about available commands, frameworks, and terminology
Explore and Create
• Interactive coding shows the results of your code instantly, alongside your work
• Step through code in playground books to highlight each line as it runs
• Books provide a head start to create your own playgrounds that use graphics, sound, and touch
• App Gallery walks you through the building blocks of apps, like tabbed navigation and receiving input from device sensors
Build Apps on iPad
• Create real apps on iPad using SwiftUI
• See your code changes reflected live while you type
• Type quickly and accurately with inline code suggestions
• Extend your app with an ecosystem of Swift packages
• Navigate your code with project-wide search
Smart Coding Assistance
• Touch and hold to grab any command and move it around to change the order of your code
• Drag a brace with your finger to wrap a block of code inside a loop or conditional statement
• Drag and drop snippets of commonly-used code directly into your playground
• Fix common code errors with helpful inline suggestions
• Stay organized with automatic code formatting
Real Swift, SwiftUI, and iOS Code
• Learn the same powerful Swift programming language used by the pros to create apps in the App Store
• Build dynamic, elegant apps using SwiftUI, a modern way to create user interfaces
• Access iOS frameworks such as SpriteKit for 2D games, SceneKit for 3D graphics, UIKit, and more
• Your code has direct control of iPad hardware, including the gyroscope, accelerometer, camera, and touch events
Share or Publish
• Send your projects to friends and family using Messages, Mail, AirDrop, or other Share Sheet extensions
• Bring your app projects to Xcode on Mac and back again
• Submit your completed apps to the App Store with App Store Connect

bluejetty:00156708:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00156708:ios.description:
YOUR RECORDS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
The information and photos you add to myArmsCache are stored on your device, not on a server. No account or registration is required.
ONE OF THE ORIGINAL GUN APPS
myArmsCache has been on the App Store for 10 years.
• Used by thousands of gun owners.
• Featured in American Handgunner and Athlon Outdoors.
• Available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
• Created by a developer, not a company. 
AUTOMATIC ROUNDS TRACKING
Log a Range Report and everything updates automatically:
1. Ammo Updated: the rounds you fired are subtracted from your inventory, so your counts stay up to date.
2. Rounds & Malfunctions Added: round counts and any malfunctions are added to each firearm, magazine, accessory, and the ammo you used.
3. Maintenance Updated: if a firearm reaches its cleaning interval, it's added to your maintenance queue.
MANAGE YOUR COLLECTION
myArmsCache helps you manage your collection all in one place
FIREARMS
Maintain a detailed ownership record for every gun in your collection — kept current every time you log a Range Report or a Maintenance record
• Firearm Details & Photos: including purchase and sale information
• Assigned Items: magazines and accessories used with the firearm and parts installed on it
• Range Activity: total rounds fired, last-fired date, and malfunctions
• Maintenance and Repair History: record cleanings, inspections, repairs, and other service, including what was done, when it was completed, and what it cost
AMMO
Always know how much ammo you have available (set a target and know when to buy before you run low). Track the rounds purchased and fired — counts update automatically when you add a purchase or log a Range Report
• Ammo Details & Photo
• Purchase History: number of times purchased, total spent, cost per round
• Range Use and Malfunctions: total rounds fired, malfunctions, the last-used date
• Total Ammo Available: rounds available by caliber, manufacturer, and bullet type
MAGAZINES
Keep a record for every magazine you own — what guns it's used with, where it is, what you paid, how often you have used it, and how reliably it has performed.
• Magazine Details & Photos: including purchase information
• Assigned Firearms: guns each magazine is used with
• Reliability Rating: know which magazines perform the best
• Range Activity: total rounds fired, last used date, and malfunctions
RANGE REPORT
Keep a detailed log of your time at the range — including the guns, ammo, and magazines used, target photos, distance, weather, time, malfunctions, and rounds fired.
ORGANIZATION
Create custom tags to organize your collection. Use the same tag across guns, ammo, magazines, accessories, and parts — for example, use an “NFA” tag to group related items
COLLECTION INSIGHTS
View detailed breakdowns & spending in every section
• Firearms: What you own, what it's worth & what you've spent by caliber, manufacturer, firearm type
• Ammo: Rounds on hand, what they cost, cost per round & what you've shot by caliber, manufacturer, bullet type
• Magazines: What you own & what you've spent by caliber, manufacturer, capacity
• Range: What you spent & rounds fired by gun and caliber
• Maintenance: What's been serviced & what it cost by maintenance type
BE PREPARED
• Insurance Reports: generate a PDF report for one or multiple firearms, including photos
• CSV Export: export a CSV file for Guns, Ammo, Accessories, Magazines, Parts, Maintenance, and Range Reports
• Backup & Restore: create a backup file to protect your data or move it to a new device
YOUR FEEDBACK MATTERS
Submit feature requests and vote on what you'd like to see added to the app
--------------------
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Your subscription is processed via your App Store account and will automatically renew according to Apple's terms and conditions. You can manage your subscription plans in your App Store Account Settings
Privacy: https://myArmsCache.com/privacy
Terms: https://myArmsCache.com/terms

• Range Activity: total rounds fired, last-fired date, and malfunctions
• Maintenance and Repair History: record cleanings, inspections, repairs, and other service, including what was done, when it was completed, and what it cost

• Ammo Details & Photo

• Range Use and Malfunctions: total rounds fired, malfunctions, the last-used date

• Assigned Firearms: guns each magazine is used with
• Reliability Rating: know which magazines perform the best

Arcade Watch Games is a collection of 12 games for the Apple Watch and iPhone.
Enjoy hours of endless entertainment all Ad free! 
List of currently available games:
• FLAK ATTACK
Use your cannon to fight off an air attack of aircraft, bombers and paratroopers.
• INCOMING MISSILE
Steer your spaceship avoiding asteroids and missiles. 
• ALLEY BALL
Roll down the changing alley ways using the watch crown to manoeuvre through. Roll on!
• BOAT RUN
High speed action, navigating your boat using the watch crown to collect gold medals, and to avoid crashing on a treacherous and unpredictable river at increasing speeds.
• DODGEM BIPLANES 
Take to the skies, with dual Biplanes by tapping them to switch flight corridors in order to dodge on coming aircraft and to pick the roundels. Thanks for flying!

• PILE HIGH
How high can you go? Test your skill by tapping to pile the slabs as high as possible, exact fits gets you bonus points.
• POULTRY DASH
How did the chicken, rooster, chick and duck cross the road? That’s up to your directional swiping skills, guiding them round obstructions and across the lanes of traffic safely to the other side. Good luck! 
• RAINBOW RUNNER
Run the rainbow gauntlet by tapping to jump between the colour bands. Happy landings!
• TABLE PONG
Timeless classic with circular paddle action using the watch crown to keep the volley going.
• WORMER
Oldie but a goodie, worm your way around with directional swiping to the green apple. Bon appétit!

bluejetty:00159356:ios.description:
Voda is the daily wellbeing app designed by expert LGBTQIA+ therapists. 
We're here to hold you through the ups and downs of being queer: explore coming out, release shame, reduce stress, improve your mood and process your emotions alongside whatever support you already have.
YOUR PERSONALISED 10-DAY PLAN
Get started with a personalised 10-day plan built around your biggest challenge right now, with practices drawn from evidence-informed approaches like ACT, CFT, CBT, DBT and IFS.
Made for the realities of queer life:
- Minority stress
- Self-worth in unaffirming spaces
- Coming out - at any age or stage
- Navigating transition
- Identity, burnout, and disclosure at work
- Finding your way back after rejection, shame, and isolation
TODAY'S WISDOM
A one-minute insight each morning, written by queer therapists and tailored to you. Feels like a horoscope, but evidence-informed and intersectional.
DAILY 5-MIN PRACTICES
Open Voda, get one thing you can do in five minutes to feel better. For the days you have capacity - and the days you don't.
QUEER MEDITATIONS
Meditations voiced by LGBTQIA+ creators. Find calm before a hard conversation, soften a triggering moment, and reconnect with your body.
GUIDED JOURNAL
Reflect with prompts and personalised insights that help you see your patterns, understand yourself more deeply, and notice how far you've come.
PRIVATE & DISCREET BY DESIGN
For many of us, privacy isn't a nice-to-have, this is why Voda is built to be yours alone:
- Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode, so what's inside stays private and secure.
- Your entries are encrypted with industry-standard security. We'll never sell your data.
- You own your data, and you can delete it at any time.
FREE SELF-CARE RESOURCES
Access 220+ modules on coming out safely, coping with hate speech, and more - including the Trans+ Library, one of the most comprehensive collections of trans+ wellbeing resources anywhere, free to everyone. Whether you're lesbian, gay, bi, trans, queer, non-binary, intersex, asexual, Two-Spirit, questioning - or anywhere beyond and between - Voda is built for you.
Disclaimer: Voda is designed for 18+ users, for everyday mental wellbeing and self-care. Voda is not designed to be used in a crisis, and is not a replacement for medical treatment. Please seek care from a medical professional if required. Voda does not provide therapy, it is neither a clinic nor a medical device, and does not provide any diagnosis. 
________________________________________________
BUILT BY OUR COMMUNITY
Voda is built by LGBTQIA+ therapists, psychologists, and community leaders who have walked the same paths as you. Our work is informed by lived experience and LGBTQIA+ expertise, because we believe every LGBTQIA+ person deserves affirming, culturally competent wellbeing support, exactly when they need it. 
________________________________________________
BUILT WITH EXPERTS
The development of Voda has been supported by leading accelerators including Headstream, DigitalHealth.London, GoodTech Ventures, and INCO, the world’s leading social enterprise supporting impact startups.
_______________________________________________
HEAR FROM OUR USERS
"I'm currently questioning both gender and sexuality. It's so stressful that I'm crying a lot, but this gave me a moment of peace and happiness." - Zee (they/them)
“No other app supports our queer community like Voda. Check it out!” - Kayla (she/her)
________________________________________________
CONTACT US
Have questions, require a low-income scholarship or need assistance? Email us at support@voda.co or find us at @joinvoda on social media platforms.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.voda.co/privacy-policy

GTE Mobile seamlessly integrates your cards, payments and money management into an innovative experience, so banking is ultra-convenient, simple and fast.

bluejetty:00014273:ios.summary:
Get all the building blocks for early education with the #1-rated childcare app! Center management features let you complete daily reports, schedules, attendance, check-ins and meal planning faster than ever before.
Family engagement tools
bluejetty:00014273:ios.description:
Get all the building blocks for early education with the #1-rated childcare app! Center management features let you complete daily reports, schedules, attendance, check-ins and meal planning faster than ever before.
Family engagement tools keep families informed through daily reports, pictures and videos.
Simple registration and payment options make the lives of families easier.
Research-based curriculum offers developmentally appropriate lesson plans aligned to state standards and pre-populated with engaging themes.
Download Lillio today and experience the all-in-one solution for building a high-quality childcare program!
Here is what one of our thousands of happy directors had to say about Lillio:
"Lillio (formerly HiMama) has become a huge asset for our school! Families love the photos and daily reports. Teachers agree that it is extremely easy to use and replaces piles of paperwork."
FAMILY ENGAGEMENT AND COMMUNICATION
• Family portal - Parents and family members can view photos, videos, daily reports and schedules, update their child’s information, and message educators in their own private, secure account.
• Real-time photo sharing - parents can receive timely updates throughout the day
• Email, text, and in-app communication - Send messages, alerts and reminders to individual family members or to an entire group of family members at once
CARING AND TEACHING
• Digital curriculum - Developmentally appropriate, research-based lesson plans and activities from Funshine Express allows flexible planning and offers play-based, engaging themes and activities that are aligned to state and early learning standards
• Weekly Planner - Create custom activities organized by learning areas and select developmental skills tied to your state and early learning standards.
• Photo and video observations - Tag real-time observations with images from the classroom
• Child Developmental Evidence Reports - Follow a child’s development across developmental domains, skills and indicators
• Easy-to-use childcare assessments to support every child’s learning path
CENTER MANAGEMENT
• Childcare daily reports: document meals, snacks, sleep checks, toileting, activities and observations, medication and more for individual children or multiple children at once
• Attendance: record check-in, check-out, drop off and pick up times, and absences
• Administrative: classroom and activity reports; updatable parent and child contact, emergency, allergy, and health information; meal and snack menu planning and schedules, enrollment management for upcoming, current, and graduated children; schedule rotations
Lillio is secure, reliable and easy to use, and the child care center’s information is backed up, synced and accessed through our apps and our website.
We have a friendly customer support team that would happily answer your questions by phone (1-800-905-1876) or email (support@himama.com).

bluejetty:00131291:ios.description:
FordPass is now the Ford app
The Ford app is everything you need to elevate your Ford journey — all in one place. Access features like remote start, lock and unlock, vehicle stats, and GPS tracking at no extra cost.

bluejetty:00124303:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00124303:ios.description:
One of the best hack-and-slash games of all time now fits in your pocket!
Originally released on PC in 2006, Titan Quest is an action RPG set against a mythological backdrop. The Titans have escaped from prison and are hell-bent on destroying the Earth. The Gods alone can’t stop them -- a hero is needed to lead this epic struggle. Victory or defeat will determine humanity’s fate and that of the Olympians.
You are that hero! Create your character, explore ancient civilizations like Greece, Egypt, Babylon, and China, and fight against hordes of legendary creatures! Master the arts of archery, swordsmanship or magic and upgrade your character to unlock awesome powers! Discover special items to help you complete your quest: legendary swords, devastating thunderbolts, enchanted bows, and much more!
Specially adapted for mobile devices, this new version offers numerous new features:
● A new touch-friendly interface 
● Completely redesigned touch-friendly gameplay 
● High-quality graphics
● A huge, open world to explore
● Full day/night cycle
● 80 different mythological creatures: Minotaurs, Cyclopses, Gorgons, and many more
● 1200+ items to discover
● 30 different character classes 
● 150 different character skills
● Colossal playtime of more than 60 hours 
● Scalable difficulty modes: weapons and enemies match your skill level 
● Dozens of unlockable achievements to discover
● No ads, no microtransactions. 
Mixing ancient mythology with non-stop action, Titan Quest is a classic hack-and-slash offering energizing gameplay with a fast, intense rhythm. Overcome thrilling challenges and vanquish the greatest enemies ever to invade the mobile world!
DLCs available as in-app purchase: 
● IMMORTAL THRONE - Encounter the greatest villains of Greek mythology, brave the attacks of Cerberus, and hazard the banks of the River Styx to conquer this dark new adventure.
● RAGNARÖK - In the uncharted lands of northern Europe, you’ll brave the realms of the Celts, the Northmen, and the Asgardian gods!
● ATLANTIS - Set out on a journey across the western Mediterranean, in search of the mythical kingdom of Atlantis. Including the Tartarus Arena for epic battles!
● ETERNAL EMBERS - Summoned by the legendary Emperor Yao, the Hero is called back into the East to deal with a demonic threat that has been ravaging the land after the Telkine was slain.

bluejetty:00132256:ios.description:
Wallpaper* is the world's leading design magazine, championing the best in architecture, interiors, fashion, art and contemporary lifestyle from across the globe. 
Wallpaper* magazine has changed the way the world looks, not only identifying trends but creating them while tagging need-to-know new products and places. Our roving editors make it their mission to identify the design talents of tomorrow and honour the heroes of today. Our architecture news stretches from the under-construction to the iconic, while our travel coverage tracks everything from the most innovative hotel openings to off-the-radar destinations. In short, Wallpaper* magazine sets the pace in the design world, ensuring you never get left behind.
Join thousands of others and download our free app now!
-------------------
Once you’ve downloaded our app, you will need to take a free trial or purchase a single issue or subscription to access our in-depth content. We also publish specials and guides - browse our publications, read what interests you most, and get inspired.
Back issues, specials, and future issues are available for purchase within the app. Subscriptions are available on various monthly and annual terms, and auto-renew until you decide to cancel it. Check inside the app for current pricing.
*** Please Note: Our digital edition is not printable and does not include the covermount items or supplements you would find with the print edition ***
• The free trial offer is only available to new subscribers. If you have previously subscribed then payment will be taken immediately.
• You can cancel at any time during the free trial period and you will not be charged. Simply turn off auto-renew in your Apple account subscriptions page at least 24 hours before the auto-renew is due.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
• You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for that product.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase .
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. This does not affect your statutory rights.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
• We will be collecting information about your use of the app both when you are online and offline. To find out more please see our privacy policy.
The subscription will include the current issue if you don't already own it and subsequently published future issues for the duration of your subscription period.
-------------------

Frank Shann’s DrugDoses booklet has been a trusted tool for nearly 40 years. bluejetty:00136280:ios.description:
Step aboard SEA OF CONQUEST!
This game includes in-game purchases (including random items)
Embark on an extraordinary maritime odyssey through the captivating Devil's Seas. Sail into uncharted territories, assume the role of Captain, and immerse yourself in exhilarating adventures. Build your cabin, assemble a mighty fleet, and customize your majestic Flagship. Prepare for awe-inspiring encounters, heroic duels, and adrenaline-charged clashes with fellow pirates.
THRILLING ADVENTURES UNFOLD:
GLOBAL EXPEDITIONS: UNVEIL PORTS & EXCITING CHALLENGES
Unleash your wanderlust and embark on an inspiring global escapade. Traverse the treacherous waters of the Devil's Sea, and push the boundaries to reach the farthest corners of the world. Prepare to conquer unforeseen challenges and immerse yourself in captivating new storylines!
CRAFT YOUR FLAGSHIP: BECOME A PIRATE LEGEND
Forge your own path to piracy by meticulously crafting your majestic flagship. Every detail, from the fluttering flag to the formidable armaments you choose to wield, reflects your unique style and strategic prowess. With your personalized flagship, you shall fearlessly withstand raids and monstrous encounters, paving the way to become the unrivaled king of all pirates! Don't miss out on the thrilling weekly Pirate Revel event, where fulfilling grand orders of delectable food and refreshing drinks can shower you with abundant rewards!
UNITE YOUR FEARLESS CREW: EMBARK ON AN EPIC JOURNEY
Ahoy, ready to step into the legendary shoes of a pirate captain? With a diverse and spirited crew by your side, set sail on grand adventures across the seven seas. The exhilaration of treasure hunts in search of coveted riches awaits you. Will it be gleaming gold, exquisite pearls, rare materials, or perhaps an enigmatic drifting bottle that unravels tales of untold fortunes? It's your destiny to find out!
HEROIC TRIALS & ROGUE'S RUMBLE: BOOST YOUR POWER!
As a dauntless Captain, you'll be drawn into the heart-pounding Hero Trials. Conquer each level as you expertly assemble your team of heroes and strategically command your assaults. Brace yourself for the Rogue's Rumble, an inferno of valor and hard-earned triumphs. This is a battle and a test of your courage and tactical genius! Are you up for the challenge?
PLUNGE INTO BATTLE: YOUR CHALLENGE AWAITS, CAPTAIN!
Prepare for the exhilarating rush of adrenaline as a fearless Captain, engaging in intense naval battles against rival pirates, formidable navies, and unpredictable sea monsters. The thrill of conquest awaits as you seize ports, sentry towers, and strategic passages. With new trading alliances looming on the horizon, the excitement never ceases! Rise to the challenge in the cyclical Showdown o'Gangs event, where alliances compete for glory and rewards!
ANSWER THE CALL OF THE SEA: EMBARK ON THE PIRATE'S QUEST FOR TREASURE!
Are you ready to feel the exhilaration of the ultimate treasure hunt? As a seasoned pirate, the vast sea becomes your playground. Envision leading your crew, engaging in battles against sea creatures and rival pirates, all in the relentless pursuit of concealed fortunes. Decipher cryptic maps, unravel the enigmas of the sea and plunge into the ultimate adventure.
Reputation, glory, and wealth await amidst the uncharted realm. Come and discover the extraordinary secrets the Devil's Sea has in store for you!
Need assistance, matey?
Feel free to contact us via the in-game Customer Service or send us an email at: seaofconquestcs@funplus.com
For more fun, join the pirates' gangs!
Discord: https://discord.gg/seaofconquest
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/seaofconquest
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sea.of.conquest/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/seaofconquest
Official Website: https://seaofconquest.com
Terms and Conditions: https://funplus.com/funplus-general-campaign-terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://funplus.com/privacy-policies/

bluejetty:00155834:ios.description:
Our app makes it easy to stay informed about the whereabouts of your family and friends. With a simple QR code system, you can quickly add members and set up important locations like home, work, or school. Get real-time notifications when someone arrives at or leaves a designated place, ensuring peace of mind without constant check-ins.
Key Features:
1. Easy Member Addition – Quickly connect with family and friends by scanning a QR code. No complicated setup required.
2. Custom Locations – Mark important places like home, office, school, or any other frequent location.
3. Real-Time Notifications – Receive alerts when a member reaches or leaves a set location.
4. Intuitive Design – A clean, user-friendly interface that keeps everything simple and efficient.
How to Use:
1. Add Members – Tap the "+" button, select "QR Code," and scan the code from another phone to connect.
2. Set Up Locations – Add frequently visited places like home, work, or school to receive location updates.
3. Get Notifications – Receive instant alerts when someone arrives at or leaves a saved location.
Whether you're making sure your child got home safely, tracking a loved one's commute, or staying connected with friends, our app provides a hassle-free way to stay updated. No unnecessary features—just what you need to feel connected and secure.
Terms of use: https://itdigitalservices.site/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://itdigitalservices.site/privacy.html

bluejetty:00126734:ios.name: Falcon Mx - DICOM Viewer
bluejetty:00126734:ios.summary:
Falcon Mx™ – DICOM Viewer for iPhone and iPad
Falcon Mx is a powerful DICOM viewer for iPhone and iPad designed to view, manage, and share medical imaging studies wherever you are. Open and review DICOM images from virtually all imaging mo
bluejetty:00126734:ios.description:
Falcon Mx™ – DICOM Viewer for iPhone and iPad
Falcon Mx is a powerful DICOM viewer for iPhone and iPad designed to view, manage, and share medical imaging studies wherever you are. Open and review DICOM images from virtually all imaging modalities, including CT, MRI, X-ray, Ultrasound (US) and more.
Whether you’re reviewing studies, organizing your personal medical imaging library, or securely sharing exams with colleagues or patients, Falcon Mx provides a fast, intuitive experience built specifically for Apple devices.
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
- - - Key Features - - - 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Image Navigation & Viewing Tools
• Window Width / Window Level (WW/WL)
• WW/WL presets
• Adjustable scrolling speed
• Zoom
• Pan
• Rotate
• On-screen navigation controls
• Cine Mode
• Image looping
• Sort by Instance or Slice Location
DICOM & PACS Connectivity
• Support for custom DICOM Nodes (DICOM Protocol)
• Import studies quickly and securely from your PACS
• Send and retrieve DICOM studies between devices using DICOM Protocol or Bonjour
• Import studies from iCloud Drive, Dropbox, and Google Drive
Advanced DICOM Viewing
• Photorealistic 3D Volume Rendering
• 3D Multiplanar Reconstruction (MPR)
• Orthogonal (2D) MPR
• MIP, MinIP, and Mean rendering modes
• 3D SSD Rendering
• Multiple windows (Split Screen)
• Synchronized multi-window viewing
• No resolution restrictions on imported images
Measurements & ROI Tools
• Distance measurement
• Angle measurement
• Point ROI (pixel values)
• Area ROI (minimum, maximum, standard deviation, area)
• Closed Path ROI
• Curved Line ROI
• Freehand (Scribble) ROI
• Text ROI
• Arrow ROI
• Cardio-Thoracic Ratio (CTR)
Study Management
• Patient Folders
• Study anonymization
• Export anonymized studies
• View and edit DICOM metadata
• Support for numerous DICOM image formats, including JPEG and JPEG2000 (see DICOM Conformance Statement)
Falcon Cloud™
• Cloud-based storage, synchronization, and secure sharing of DICOM studies across the Falcon ecosystem.
Falcon Link™
• Your personal space for patients to securely share DICOM studies with you. Works seamlessly with Falcon Mx.
Languages
Available in:
* English
* German
* French
* Ukrainian
* Greek
* Hungarian
* Polish
* Russian
No resolution restrictions in imported images
Falcon Mx™ (iPhone and iPad) is not CE or FDA-cleared and SHOULD NOT be used for primary diagnosis.
It is for informational purposes only and not intended for diagnostic use.
Subscriptions automatically renew on term (monthly, bi-annual or yearly) from the date of original purchase (unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period). Does not support Family Sharing.
Subscriptions may be managed within iTunes Account Settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.

bluejetty:00062069:ios.name: Exploring Emotions: The Zones
bluejetty:00062069:ios.summary:
Exploring Emotions is an SEL app that helps learners build emotional awareness, self-regulation skills, and coping strategies through interactive scenarios grounded in The Zones of Regulation® framework. 
Built on the same principles as T
bluejetty:00062069:ios.description:
Exploring Emotions is an SEL app that helps learners build emotional awareness, self-regulation skills, and coping strategies through interactive scenarios grounded in The Zones of Regulation® framework. 
Built on the same principles as The Zones of Regulation Digital Curriculum (not included), the app gives learners a structured way to recognize emotions, understand triggers, and practice strategies for self-management. When used alongside the Zones Digital Curriculum, learners have an opportunity to practice, strengthen, and generalize regulation skills. 
“Exploring Emotions is highly recommended for any educator working with students on emotional regulation.” — Jackie Bryla (A.C.T.) 
Build emotional literacy through real scenarios:
Players navigate common school and social situations: a classroom, cafeteria, and park, learning to identify their Zones, reflect on goals, and explore regulation tools that support daily functioning. This approach reinforces core SEL concepts: emotional regulation, perspective taking, and flexible thinking. 
Key Features:
- Audio narration supports accessibility and models communication. 
- Data tracking strengthens reflection by letting learners log their Zones, identify patterns, and share insights with educators or caregivers. 
- Customizable Toolbox with dozens of coping strategies and self-regulation tools. 
- Replayable scenarios that support practice, problem-solving, and skill generalization. 
- Mini games that connect emotional reactions to real-time decision making. 
- Multiple real-life environments that strengthen social-emotional learning. 
- Embedded references to The Zones curriculum for deeper instructional support. 
Designed for flexible use across SEL settings:
Exploring Emotions supports Pre-K through secondary students and is also applicable for adults working on emotional regulation. It can be used in classrooms, therapy settings, and at home as part of a broader SEL or behavioral health program. Adult facilitation enhances skill transfer and strengthens connections to everyday life. 
Educators, therapists, and families use the app to reinforce emotional regulation, self-management, and coping strategies taught through The Zones framework. 
Download Exploring Emotions: The Zones and help learners build lifelong self-regulation skills.

bluejetty:00040711:ios.summary: Joggo is a running app for beginners and experienced runners — built for outdoor runs, treadmill training, and everything in between. With a personalized running program, custom meal plan, and a convenient running tracker, you can reach you
bluejetty:00040711:ios.description:
Joggo is a running app for beginners and experienced runners — built for outdoor runs, treadmill training, and everything in between. With a personalized running program, custom meal plan, and a convenient running tracker, you can reach your fitness and weight loss goals in a way that works for you.
Think of Joggo as your personal running coach, your nutritionist, and your support system — right in your pocket. Created by elite coaches. Tailored to your goals.
PERSONALIZED RUNNING PLANS FOR EVERY LEVEL Take our in-app quiz, complete a short assessment run, and get a fully personalized training plan tailored to your needs, goals, and lifestyle. Whether you're running for weight loss, training for a couch to 5K, or chasing a new personal best — your plan adapts to you.
BI-WEEKLY PLAN ADJUSTMENTS Like a real-life coach, Joggo evaluates your results every two weeks and adjusts your plan's intensity based on your progress and feedback. You train at the right pace for your body — no guesswork.
TREADMILL MODE Not a fan of outdoor running, or the weather isn't cooperating? Switch to treadmill mode and train from the comfort of your own home — any day, any time.
CUSTOM MEAL PLAN Get a meal plan tailored to your food preferences and dietary requirements — designed to support your weight loss or fitness goals without cutting the foods you love.
RUNNING & WEIGHT LOSS TRACKER Track your runs with GPS and distance monitoring, view your activity history, and monitor your weight loss progress — all in one app.
EDUCATIONAL CONTENT & COACHING TIPS From nutrition and injury prevention to breathing techniques and more — access a library of educational articles and tips, curated for your level and goals.
REWARDS & MOTIVATION Earn digital medals for every running streak you complete. Stay consistent, stay accountable, stay on track.
APPLE WATCH INTEGRATION Leave your phone at home and track your runs from your Apple Watch. Get heart rate zone guidance as you run — so you know exactly when to slow down or speed up for best results.
FULL-BODY WORKOUT PLAN (additional purchase) Get a complete workout plan with video tutorials for lower body, upper body, and core — created by our top sports specialists.
Joggo works with Apple Health to sync your workout data.
DISCLAIMER: Please seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. Privacy policy: https://joggo.run/en/data-protection-policy/ General conditions: https://joggo.run/en/general-conditions

With a personalized running program, custom meal plan, and a convenient running tracker, you can reach your fitness and weight loss goals in a way that works for you.

Think of Joggo as your personal running coach, your nutritionist, and your support system — right in your pocket. Created by elite coaches. Tailored to your goals.

PERSONALIZED RUNNING PLANS FOR EVERY LEVEL Take our in-app quiz, complete a short assessment run, and get a fully personalized training plan tailored to your needs, goals, and lifestyle. Whether you're running for weight loss, training for a couch to 5K, or chasing a new personal best — your plan adapts to you.

BI-WEEKLY PLAN ADJUSTMENTS Like a real-life coach, Joggo evaluates your results every two weeks and adjusts your plan's intensity based on your progress and feedback. You train at the right pace for your body — no guesswork.

TREADMILL MODE Not a fan of outdoor running, or the weather isn't cooperating? Switch to treadmill mode and train from the comfort of your own home — any day, any time.

CUSTOM MEAL PLAN Get a meal plan tailored to your food preferences and dietary requirements — designed to support your weight loss or fitness goals without cutting the foods you love.

RUNNING & WEIGHT LOSS TRACKER Track your runs with GPS and distance monitoring, view your activity history, and monitor your weight loss progress — all in one app.

EDUCATIONAL CONTENT & COACHING TIPS From nutrition and injury prevention to breathing techniques and more — access a library of educational articles and tips, curated for your level and goals.

REWARDS & MOTIVATION Earn digital medals for every running streak you complete. Stay consistent, stay accountable, stay on track.

APPLE WATCH INTEGRATION Leave your phone at home and track your runs from your Apple Watch. Get heart rate zone guidance as you run — so you know exactly when to slow down or speed up for best results.

FULL-BODY WORKOUT PLAN (additional purchase) Get a complete workout plan with video tutorials for lower body, upper body, and core — created by our top sports specialists.

Joggo works with Apple Health to sync your workout data.

DISCLAIMER: Please seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. Privacy policy: https://joggo.run/en/data-protection-policy/ General conditions: https://joggo.run/en/general-conditions

bluejetty:00131702:ios.description:

**Conditions in the outdoors can, and frequently do change. Like life, danger may lurk around any corner. The information in the app is provided free of any warranty or liability. Be careful, be prepared, and use good judgment.**

bluejetty:00096818:ios.description:
Diet Log AI – Calorie & Macro Tracker with AI-Powered Food Logging
Snap a Photo. Get Your Macros. Hit Your Goals.
Diet Log AI makes tracking your nutrition effortless. Just snap a photo of your meal, nutrition label, or food packaging—or upload one from your gallery—and our advanced AI will automatically recognize the food and estimate its calories, protein, carbs, and fat.
HOW IT WORKS
• Set Your Goals: Start by entering your age, weight, height, gender, and your goal—whether it’s weight loss, muscle gain, or maintenance.
• Get a Custom Plan: Based on your inputs, we calculate your daily calorie and macronutrient targets (carbs, protein, fat).
• Snap or Upload: Take a photo of your food or nutrition label, or upload one from your gallery.
• AI Analysis: Our AI instantly analyzes the image and logs your estimated macros.
• Track Your Progress: Visual graphs show your daily and weekly calorie and macro intake to help you stay on track.
WHY USE DIET LOG AI?
• No More Manual Logging: Forget typing in every ingredient—just take a photo.
• Personalized for You: Your macro goals are customized based on your body and your goal.
• Stay Accountable: Visual tracking helps you see trends and make better food choices.
• Fast & Accurate: Our AI is trained to recognize a wide range of foods and labels for quick, reliable estimates.
FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
• AI-powered photo recognition of meals, packaging, and nutrition labels
• Instant calorie and macro breakdowns
• Personalized daily goals for calories, protein, carbs, and fat
• Daily and weekly progress charts
• Simple and intuitive interface
• Works with both camera and photo gallery
• Free trial available; subscription required for ongoing access
Support mail: support@dietlog.ai
Privacy Policy: https://www.dietlog.ai/privacy-policy
Terms And Conditions: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00163403:ios.name: Holman Home
bluejetty:00163403:ios.summary: With the Holman Home app you can use your smartphone to control all the programming and interface functions of a continually increasing range of Holman and K-Rain garden products via a permanent internet (and Wi-Fi) connection, you can then
bluejetty:00163403:ios.description:
With the Holman Home app you can use your smartphone to control all the programming and interface functions of a continually increasing range of Holman and K-Rain garden products via a permanent internet (and Wi-Fi) connection, you can then control the device remotely from anywhere in the world (using mobile data or Wi-Fi). These products are designed for easy DIY installation.
You can control the following products with the Holman Home app:
1 | GARDEN WATERING
• WX8 Irrigation Controller – 8 Zones
• WX1 Tap Timer – 1 Zone
• WX2 Tap Timer – 2 Zones
• K-Rain KRX6 - 6 Zones
• K-Rain KRX8 - 8 Zones
• K-Rain K Connect Tap Timer (Bluetooth only - can only connect to tap timer when within Bluetooth range)
• K-Rain K Connect Tap Timer connected to K-Rain K Connect Wi-Fi Hub
Features
• You have remote control access to your device to change any setting at any time via the app (excluding K Connect Tap Timer - Bluetooth only)
• Schedule three Starts to run on the days of your choice (KRX8 has four Starts and K Connect Tap Timer has eight Starts)
• Manually run any zone or Start from anywhere in the world (excluding K Connect Tap Timer - Bluetooth only)
• Set your run time in hours and minutes
• WX8s with the Holman Rain Sensor “Evie” or other third party rain sensors are able to automatically disable watering during wet weather
• WX1s and WX2s with Moisture Sensors are able to automatically disable watering when the soil moisture is above the set threshold
• KRX6s and KRX8s with a third party sensor is able disable watering using Scene Automations
• It is easy to share your device with other family members or users
2 | Garden Lighting
• RGB Garden Light
• WW (Warm White) Garden Light
Features
• Easy 2-Pin (WW) or 4-Pin (RGB) Plug + Socket System. No Electrician required
• Scene automations and custom scene options allow you to light up your garden, however you want
3 | WEATHER MONITORING
• Helios Weather Station
Features
• Compatible with other Holman Home products
• Accurate weather readings for your property
• Includes 10” Indoor LCD Display Panel
• Daily, Weekly and Monthly graphs of key weather data

bluejetty:00182949:ios.description:
Raid the Dungeon is the perfect incremental clicker / Idle Adventure RPG with an endless fun.
Battle your way through the Dungeons and power up your hero by collecting epic weapons, armor and gear!
Jump into PVP battle against players from all around the world and crush them all !
Game Features
▶Convenient Idle System
Is this game Idel or idl? Nope, this game is IDLE with an autoplay!
Switch between IDLE and Control Mode anytime you want! It's your choice to AFK or Tap to control with your finger!
No more painful grinding! Your hero will level up even when you are away from your phone!!
▶Easy to play
Whether you are an experienced gamer or not, you’ll be able to have fun with the game right off the bat!
Raid the Dungeon is an easy tap tap clicker game with a backgroud of exotic fantasy world and an epic adventure.

Are you a fan of collecting games ?
Over 500 avatars, 200 equipment, dozens of Relics and companions to collect!

Customize your heroes from head to toe with the loot collected from your Idle adventure!!

Choose whether to use melee or ranged weapons!
Manage your skill sets by selecting skills that suits your strategy the most!!
▶Intense PVP Action
Test the power of your hero by challenging other players in the Arena from all around the world!
Fight at the PVP Arena to reach the top of the ladder and get rich rewards!!
▶Tons of Content
Raid Raid Raid! Endless dungeons and raid dungeons allow you to collect legendary gears!
Create your own GUILD to play with other heroes around the world!
▶High Quality BGM
Beautiful title BGM composed by Matsumae Manami, the composer of ""The Mega Man"" and ""SHOVEL KNIGHT""!
An immersive Idle clicker RPG experience for all! Join the adventure and tap tap tap to victory!
Download now and start your Idle adventure or Tap Tap Tap!!

bluejetty:00046197:ios.description:
Snap a photo. Find your stuff.
SnapFind is the AI home inventory app that remembers where everything lives. Label your bins with QR codes, snap a photo of what's inside, and AI names, tags, and categorizes every item — so you can find anything you own in seconds.
ORGANIZE ANY SPACE
• Assign QR code labels to bins, totes, boxes, shelves, and drawers
• AI image recognition names and catalogs your items automatically — no typing
• Snap one photo of many items and AI detects each one separately
• Rapid capture mode: photograph an entire bin's contents in seconds
• Patent-pending fullness tracking shows how full each container is — and how much it weighs — at a glance
• Organize by spaces, rooms, locations, categories, or custom tags
FIND ANYTHING FAST
• Scan a bin's QR code to instantly see everything inside
• Smart search finds items by description — "black charging cable" — not just exact names
• Scan any item and SnapFind tells you which bin it belongs in
• Ask Siri where your stuff is
MOVING & DECLUTTERING
• Moving mode: pack, label, and track every box so nothing gets lost on the way to your new home
• Declutter mode: sort items into sell and toss piles — AI even writes your sale listings
PROTECT WHAT YOU OWN
• Track item values and generate a polished PDF insurance report of your home inventory
• Export your entire inventory to a CSV file anytime
• Check out items that leave a bin and get reminded to bring them back
• Share spaces with family or your team and organize together
• View your inventory from any web browser
Perfect for organizing basements, attics, garages, closets, storage units, moving boxes, collections, and small business inventory. Never forget what's in your boxes again!
SnapFind is free to start, with auto-renewable subscriptions for extended features and expanded storage needs.
TERMS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00097152:ios.name: Animals Solitaire: Protect
bluejetty:00097152:ios.summary:
Animals Solitaire: Protect – Where Classic Card Fun Meets Meaningful Conservation
Slide, match, and save—dive into the world of Animals Solitaire: Protect, a heartwarming fusion of timeless Klondike solitaire and urgent wildlife advocacy.
bluejetty:00097152:ios.description:
Animals Solitaire: Protect – Where Classic Card Fun Meets Meaningful Conservation
Slide, match, and save—dive into the world of Animals Solitaire: Protect, a heartwarming fusion of timeless Klondike solitaire and urgent wildlife advocacy. Perfect for card game lovers and eco-conscious players alike, this app transforms your daily dose of fun into a journey of discovery, shedding light on the plight of endangered animals and inspiring you to stand up for our planet’s most vulnerable species.
Play the Game You Love, Discover a Cause That Matters
At its core, Animals Solitaire: Protect is all about the thrill of classic Klondike solitaire. Flip, arrange, and strategize to clear the board—whether you’re a seasoned pro or new to the game, its intuitive mechanics make it easy to pick up and impossible to put down. But there’s a deeper layer waiting to unfold: every win unlocks a piece of the puzzle. As you master each level, you’ll gradually reveal captivating stories, photos, and facts about endangered animals—from the elusive snow leopard roaming remote mountains to the critically endangered vaquita, the world’s rarest marine mammal. Learn about their shrinking habitats, the threats they face (poaching, climate change, human encroachment), and why their survival is critical to our ecosystem’s balance.
More Than Just a Game: A Movement in Your Hands
Animals Solitaire: Protect is designed to entertain and educate. Each unlocked fact is a small but powerful step toward raising awareness. By playing, you’re not just racking up wins—you’re becoming part of a global effort to protect these animals. The more you play, the more you’ll see the faces behind the statistics: a baby orangutan clinging to its mother in Borneo, a sea turtle nesting on a threatened beach, a rhino’s last stand against poachers. These stories aren’t just eye-opening—they’re a call to action.
Join the Herd. Protect Together.
Whether you’re looking for a relaxing way to unwind or a meaningful way to engage with wildlife, Animals Solitaire: Protect has something for you. Challenge your card skills, expand your knowledge, and let every shuffle remind you that even small actions—like playing a game—can make a big difference.
Ready to deal, discover, and defend? Download Animals Solitaire: Protect today. Let’s turn fun into purpose, one card at a time.

Flip, arrange, and strategize to clear the board—whether you’re a seasoned pro or new to the game, its intuitive mechanics make it easy to pick up and impossible to put down. But there’s a deeper layer waiting to unfold: every win unlocks a piece of the puzzle. As you master each level, you’ll gradually reveal captivating stories, photos, and facts about endangered animals—from the elusive snow leopard roaming remote mountains to the critically endangered vaquita, the world’s rarest marine mammal. Learn about their shrinking habitats, the threats they face (poaching, climate change, human encroachment), and why their survival is critical to our ecosystem’s balance.

More Than Just a Game: A Movement in Your Hands
Animals Solitaire: Protect is designed to entertain and educate. Each unlocked fact is a small but powerful step toward raising awareness. By playing, you’re not just racking up wins—you’re becoming part of a global effort to protect these animals. The more you play, the more you’ll see the faces behind the statistics: a baby orangutan clinging to its mother in Borneo, a sea turtle nesting on a threatened beach, a rhino’s last stand against poachers. These stories aren’t just eye-opening—they’re a call to action.

Join the Herd. Protect Together.
Whether you’re looking for a relaxing way to unwind or a meaningful way to engage with wildlife, Animals Solitaire: Protect has something for you. Challenge your card skills, expand your knowledge, and let every shuffle remind you that even small actions—like playing a game—can make a big difference.

Ready to deal, discover, and defend? Download Animals Solitaire: Protect today. Let’s turn fun into purpose, one card at a time.

Pay your bill using either a credit card or a bank account. Payments made through Mi LUMA app are credited the same day.

Simply download the free app and begin enjoying the convenience of doing all of this from anywhere 24x7.

Hey there! 
What a great day to blow town! 
Build a dream Super Farm where nothing is what it seems to be and take part in exciting adventures for true Superheroes!
You think this is just an ordinary truck? Surely not. With its jet engine, it can deliver orders to any spot on the globe, any town or village, virtually instantly. What about this old shed? Take a closer look. This is a high-tech superhero data center! Even that toad behind the wheat patch has his secrets. Believe me, the Super Farm is a place where any piece of fruit can surprise you!
Just between us: Superheroes are ordinary imperfect people who have trouble warming up their breakfast or mending their socks. It is our farms that ensure peace and prosperity on the planet. 
What about the Heroes? What about them? They are just lazy celebrities. 
It is us Super Farmers who do the real work for them!
FEATURES
-Build a world-class Super Farm!
-Help Superheroes save the world by fulfilling their orders
-Ship farm produce by land, sea, and air
-Create a secret HQ for Superheroes
-Discover new continents and collect items from around the world
-Meet Superheroes and join a super team
This world needs its Superheroes!
Install the game and join our ranks! Get started now!
Super Farm is a free game (some in-game elements may be purchased for real money)

- 100% additional coins in orders;
- All timers are reduced by 50%

We charge your iTunes account right after a purchase confirmation.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on the device.
See the links below for more details.
Cancelling the subscription

• Features:
- Contains 85 different levels with a n
bluejetty:00091608:ios.description:
Coptic adventure is an educational Game for kids that takes you through multiple stages to explore the Coptic language with large number of Coptic words in a New , Fun and Innovative way .
• Features:
- Contains 85 different levels with a new Coptic word to learn each time.
- A beautifully animated levels map with Coptic words images .
- Each level consists of 4 stages (play, study, quiz , color) to ensure you learn each Coptic word with multiple fun games .
- Different mini-games with each level to enjoy Learning the Coptic language in a fun experience.
- Supports English and Arabic languages for Coptic words translation.
- Each Coptic word and letter has its audio to hear its correct pronunciation . 
- Each Coptic word has its picture with it, with translation of word in English and Arabic.
- Study part explains each Coptic word to you with its picture and Coptic letters in the word with translation to selected language.
- Compete with your Friends in Coptic Adventure leader board and see who collects the majority of Coptic words from each level and be at the top of chart .
- Simple and easy touch mobile control .
- Haptic and visual feedback for every user action.
- Coptic adventure is free and works without internet and doesn't contain any ads.
- Suitable for all age groups.
- Choose your avatar in the game boy or girl from the menu.
- Contains Coptic letters dictionary to show name and pronunciation of each Coptic letter.
- Hint in each Coptic level to guide the player how to win game.
- Introducing new Bible Stories! Now you can enjoy reading and listening to the most inspiring stories from the Holy Bible, Learn about the faith, morals, and values of Christianity in a fun and engaging way.
We are trying everything to improve our games "Coptic Adventure" experience! So please, feel free to contact us to give your feedback !.

bluejetty:00186759:ios.description:
"Where should we eat?"
"I don't know… where do YOU want to eat?"
Stop. Spin the wheel instead.
Decide Now! turns any decision into a colorful spinning wheel. Type your options, tap, and let fate do the arguing. It's the fastest way to end a debate nobody actually wants to win.
SPIN IT FOR
• Dinner — the eternal question, answered in three seconds
• What to watch, when scrolling the menu has become the evening
• Who goes first, who does the dishes, who takes out the trash
• Picking names in class — fair, random, and no "you ALWAYS pick Emma"
• Giveaways, raffles and party games
• Yes or no, when you already know the answer but need a second opinion
MAKE ANY WHEEL IN SECONDS
Type your options, or paste a whole list straight from your notes — boom, wheel. Unlimited wheels, unlimited options, and no paywall lurking after option number three.
THE CLEVER BIT
Tap an option to cross it off without deleting it. Had pizza yesterday? Deactivate it, spin again, bring it back next week. It's the small thing that turns a party trick into the app you open every Friday.
TIP THE SCALES
Some options deserve better odds. Give any option a weight from x0.25 to x10 and its slice grows to match — the wheel always shows the true chances. Nudge Friday toward pizza, or your workout toward "Rest!". Fate, with a thumb on the scale.
ALSO ON BOARD
• Ten color themes, proper dark mode included
• Shake to spin (dangerously satisfying)
• Export, back up and move your wheels between devices
• Share a wheel — or its verdict — with friends
• Works completely offline
THE HONEST PART
You pay once. That's the whole business model. No ads standing between you and your answer, no subscription, no account, and no update that quietly eats the wheels you built. Decide Now! has been on the App Store since 2010 — longer than some of your dinner options have existed.
Spin. Accept your fate. Get on with your day.

So, download convenience with Novo Cinemas and just tap to make a booking or more with just a few taps.

bluejetty:00035552:ios.name: Openvibe – Bluesky & Mastodon
bluejetty:00035552:ios.summary: You're already on Mastodon, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and Nostr. That's five apps to keep up with the same people. Openvibe makes it one — a single chronological timeline across every open network you use, plus the RSS feeds you actually rea
bluejetty:00035552:ios.description:
You're already on Mastodon, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and Nostr. That's five apps to keep up with the same people. Openvibe makes it one — a single chronological timeline across every open network you use, plus the RSS feeds you actually read.
No algorithm reordering your feed. No app-switching. Everything you follow, in the order it was posted.
ONE TIMELINE, EVERY NETWORK
Mastodon, Bluesky, Nostr, Threads, Tumblr and RSS/Atom feeds, merged into a single chronological timeline. Read it all in one place, or filter to one network when you want to.
POST ONCE, CROSS-POST EVERYWHERE
Write once and send it to multiple networks at the same time. Or tap repost on anything you find and crosspost it across the open social web — a rare way to move good posts between platforms that don't otherwise talk to each other.
FOLLOW WEBSITES, NOT JUST ACCOUNTS
Add any RSS or Atom feed and read articles in a clean, clutter-free reader mode, right next to your social timeline. Follow the source instead of waiting for someone to repost it.
SEPARATE PROFILES, SEPARATE IDENTITIES
Group your accounts into distinct profiles and keep your worlds apart. Share your whole profile set as a single image so people can find you across every network at once.
YOUR ACCOUNTS, NOT ANOTHER SILO
No bridges. No mirror accounts. No Openvibe account to create. You sign in with the accounts you already have, on the protocols they already run on. Your identity stays yours.
FEATURES
– Unified chronological timeline: Mastodon, Bluesky, Nostr, Threads, Tumblr
– One inbox for DMs from every network that supports them — Mastodon and Bluesky, side by side
– RSS and Atom feeds with built-in reader mode
– Cross-post to multiple networks in a single action
– Crosspost any post across the open social web
– Multiple profiles to keep accounts separate
– Shareable profile sets
– Sign in with your existing accounts — no new account, no bridges
Mastodon, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and Nostr all run on different protocols that don't interoperate. Openvibe is the app that puts them on one screen.

bluejetty:00140668:android.description:
Nuts & Bolts Screw Wood Puzzle – Fun Screw Puzzle Game!
Welcome to Nuts & Bolts Screw Wood Puzzle – a relaxing and brain-teasing screw puzzle game where you solve tricky puzzles by removing nuts, bolts, and wood screws. This is one of the best free puzzle games that will keep your brain active and entertained!
If you love wood puzzle games or are looking for a fun screw game, this is the game for you! It’s simple to play but full of challenges that make you think. Play anywhere, anytime – no Wi-Fi needed!
HOW TO PLAY:
In this screw away 3D pin puzzle game, your goal is to remove all the bolts, nuts, and wood screws in the correct order. If you remove the wrong piece first, you’ll get stuck in a screw jam! So take your time, think carefully, and solve each puzzle step by step.
The puzzles get harder as you go. Some are easy, some are tricky – all are fun!
GAME FEATURES:
 • Lots of fun levels with different wood puzzles to solve
 • Realistic nuts, bolts, and wood screw mechanics
 • Each puzzle game is a new challenge to test your brain
 • Satisfying sounds when you unscrew a bolt or nut
 • Easy to learn, hard to master – perfect for all ages
 • 100% free puzzle game 
This game is not just a puzzle game, it’s also a relaxing and satisfying experience. The sound of turning a screw, unscrewing a wood screw, or removing a tight bolt will make you feel calm and focused.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS SCREW PUZZLE GAME:
 • Great for fans of screw game and wood puzzle games
 • Helps improve focus, memory, and thinking skills
 • Easy controls – just tap to unscrew the nuts and bolts
 • Enjoy hours of fun with this screw away 3D pin puzzle
It’s one of the most satisfying free puzzle games out there!
Whether you’re playing during a break, before bed, or on the go, this screw jam solving game is perfect. Each level is short, fun, and makes your brain work.
You’ll never get bored with so many creative wood screw and bolt puzzles to try. And new levels are added often, so there’s always something new!
WHO SHOULD PLAY THIS GAME?
 • Fans of free puzzle games
 • People who like screw games and brain teasers
 • Anyone who enjoys nuts, bolts, and wood screw challenges
 • Players who love simple, fun, and relaxing wood puzzle games
 • Puzzle lovers looking for a new screw puzzle to master
This game is great for kids and adults alike. Whether you’re solving a small wood puzzle or trying to escape a tricky screw jam, it’s always fun and rewarding.
DOWNLOAD NUTS & BOLTS SCREW WOOD PUZZLE NOW!
If you’re ready to twist, turn, and unscrew your way through amazing puzzles, download now! Try this fun and satisfying screw away 3D pin puzzle today – the best screw puzzle and wood puzzle experience on mobile!
Start solving puzzles, remove every wood screw, beat every level, and become the best at this fun and free screw game!

bluejetty:00061536:ios.description:
The PEX financial platform and corporate cards provide powerful capabilities to manage business spending and reconciliation.
PEX automates and simplifies your spend and expense workflows, saving you time on issues meaningful to your bottom line. PEX reduces data entry, helps manage cash flow, captures and tracks receipts, streamlines reconciliation, and provides detailed reporting. 
Your employees, volunteers or contractors can spend (only) when and where you want them to using their PEX Prepaid Visa® or Mastercard®. PEX also provides on-demand virtual cards and a scalable API for custom needs.
The PEX app is a free companion app for existing Administrators and Cardholders intended to complement the main PEX platform.* 
With the PEX platform, you can:
• Control Spend. Modernize spending controls by automatically limiting what, where and how much an employee can purchase. In addition to daily, weekly, and monthly limits, employees can also be restricted to specific industries via the use of Merchant Category Codes (“MCCs”). 
• Capture Receipts. Seamlessly snap a photo of a receipt, add to a transaction, and annotate with custom notes.
• Tag Transactions. Easily categorize and organize transactions by using PEX Tags. Append accounting or general ledger codes to transactions to speed up reconciliation.
• Make Quick Transfers. Transfer funds from your organization’s bank account to your PEX account on an ad hoc basis, or schedule automatic transfers. Fund and de-fund employee cards instantly for granular control or allow cards to debit from a central shared account.
• Request Funds. Allow employees to request funds from authorized administrators with an audit of the entire process. Push and email notifications keep everyone informed.
• Enhanced Reporting. Quickly create a variety of reports on purchasing activity with detailed transaction data. Export via CSV or in custom formats.
• Leverage Complimentary Systems. Easily integrate PEX with processes and tools you already use, including QuickBooks, Xero, Certify, and more.
*When using a mobile device, standard text messaging and/or data rates from your wireless service provider may apply.
***
Any questions? Email us at: sales@pexcard.com
If you are interested in becoming a customer please visit: https://apply.pexcard.com
***
The PEX Visa® Prepaid Card and the PEX Disburse Visa Prepaid Card are issued by Fifth Third Bank, N.A., Member FDIC, or The Bancorp Bank, N.A., Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A Inc and may be used everywhere Visa Prepaid cards are accepted. The PEX Prepaid Mastercard® is issued by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. pursuant to license by Mastercard International Incorporated and may be used everywhere Debit Mastercard is accepted. Mastercard is a registered trademark, and the circles design is a trademark of Mastercard International Incorporated. Please see the back of your card for its issuing bank.

bluejetty:00174880:ios.description:
Instagram is a nice Photo Sharing app where you can share photos with millions of people.  • Carousel Post: easily split your Panorama photo into one Instagram post easily using Carousel Preset selection which allows you to split up 10 grids in any sizes such as Square, Portrait, Landscape and Story.

 • Render and split your photo by keeping the original resolution and in HD.

bluejetty:00153845:ios.description:
iSingles loves you and will ...
- make your heart shine.
- show you that love exists in many forms.
- open new paths for you to meet exciting people.
- gift you true friendships and special connections.
- connect you with singles in your area.
- ignite your passion for real encounters and new adventures.
- iSingles: bringing people together
Our app offers you everything you need for successful dating experiences. With features like the MatchGame, the chat area, verified profiles, and unique search filters, you can search for a partner safely and with purpose.
- MatchGame – Find your perfect match
In the iSingles MatchGame, you see profiles of singles from your area. Swiping is super easy: if you like what you see, swipe right; otherwise, swipe left. If you have a match, you can start a conversation immediately. This feature is ideal for playfully getting to know singles and having fun at the same time!
- Visitors & Likes – Discover who’s interested in you
Do you want to know who visited your profile and who likes you? With iSingles, you can find out exactly that! You have the opportunity to reveal your visitors and likes and get in touch with these people directly. That way, you won’t miss the chance to find your perfect match.
- Chat area – Stay in touch
With iSingles, communication is simple. In the chat area, you can not only send messages, but also pictures, videos, and emojis. You can also send small gifts to make your match happy and show your interest. Everything you need for exciting and successful chats is available on iSingles.
- For you – Perfect match suggestions
Our "For you" feature is specifically designed to suggest singles who perfectly match your search criteria. Based on your interests and preferences, you’ll receive new suggestions every day that are ideal for you. This way, you save time and get to know people who have the same expectations and desires as you.
- Nearby – Singles in your area
With the Nearby feature, you can meet people in your immediate area. Whether you’re on a walk in the park or waiting in a café – iSingles shows you who is nearby and also looking for a match. This way, you can spontaneously meet people in your area and take the connection into the real world.
- Wheel of Fortune – Daily rewards
Who doesn’t love little surprises? With our Wheel of Fortune, you have the chance to win coins every day.
- Premium search filters – Find exactly what you’re looking for
iSingles gives you the option to refine your search based on specific criteria. With our premium search filters, you can set exactly what qualities, interests, or hobbies you are looking for.
- Verified profiles – Safety in dating
Safety is especially important to us. That’s why iSingles offers verified profiles that give you confidence, so you can fully focus on getting to know others without having to worry.
Dating tips for your profile:
- Choose an authentic profile picture.
- Write an honest and interesting profile description that reflects your personality.
- Be active and respond quickly to messages – this shows interest and
leaves a good impression.
- Use the Icebreaker feature to start a conversation in a charming and relaxed way.
Download iSingles now for free. Whether you're looking for a casual connection or a serious relationship – with iSingles you’ll find your perfect match!
Terms & Conditions: https://isingles.app/agb

Privacy Policy: https://isingles.app/datenschutz

bluejetty:00061654:ios.summary:

Save time by not needing to open Seller Central to view your Amazon sales data. In fact, you don’t
bluejetty:00061654:ios.description:
Seller Siren sends you live, instant push notifications whenever you make a sale on Amazon, along with an optional sound effect. Cha-Ching!
Save time by not needing to open Seller Central to view your Amazon sales data. In fact, you don’t even need to unlock your phone! Simply view the Seller Siren push notifications on your home screen. 
Tired of constantly checking and refreshing the Seller Central app to see if you made any new sales? 
You can also add a bit of fun to your sales by adding one of our 20 optional sound effects. Cha-Ching!
Notifications are fully customizable so you only get the updates you want. Filter by specific SKUs or marketplaces. You can also only get alerts every Xth sale. (If you don't want a notification for EVERY sale, but rather every 50th sale for example, you can do it.) 
You can also customize notifications to include only the item sold, or add sales amount/quantity data, and total sales for the day, week, or month. 
You can tap on a notification to open the app and view a more detailed sales dashboard within the app.
Seller Siren is available in all marketplaces worldwide. 
App Features:
- Get Live Push Notifications When Amazon Sales are Made.
- Choose from Over 20 Optional Sound Effects. Cha-Ching!
- Fully customizable so you only get the Notifications You Want.
- Filter Notifications by SKU. (Get notified for some products but not others.)
- Filter by Number of Sales. (Only get notified every 10th, 20th, 100th sale, etc)
- Filter by Marketplace. (Only get notified for Canada, EU, etc) 
Privacy Policy: https://www.sellersiren.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use (Standard Apple License): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
