bluejetty:00044323:ios.name: Harpagia: Offline Idle RPG
bluejetty:00044323:ios.summary:
Welcome to Harpagia, a deep offline idle RPG for players who love long-term progression, strategic combat, rare loot, and character customization. Skip flashy, battery-draining graphics and enjoy the depth of a classic text-based RPG.
Trai
bluejetty:00044323:ios.description:
Welcome to Harpagia, a deep offline idle RPG for players who love long-term progression, strategic combat, rare loot, and character customization. Skip flashy, battery-draining graphics and enjoy the depth of a classic text-based RPG.
Train skills, optimize your build, and make meaningful progress whether you're actively playing or checking in throughout the day.
IDLE SKILLING & LOOT HUNTING
Master 16 unique, interconnected skills up to level 200, including Combat, Mining, Forging, Fishing, Weaponry, Insight, and Archaeology. Gather resources, craft powerful equipment, discover rare items, and optimize your character through countless progression paths.
Every action contributes to your long-term growth with absolutely no forced prestige resets. Your progress is permanent, your achievements matter, and your character is always moving forward.
STRATEGIC TEXT-BASED COMBAT
Battle over 100 unique monsters in deep turn-based encounters. Equip powerful gear, socket Runes, activate Soulstones, collect pets, and hunt rare monster cards as you build the ultimate combat setup.
Experiment with different strategies, optimize your equipment, and push into increasingly difficult combat zones in search of powerful rewards and rare loot.
TRUE OFFLINE PROGRESSION
Play anywhere, even without an internet connection.
Harpagia is a lightweight offline RPG that allows your character to continue training skills, gathering resources, and earning rewards even while the game is completely closed. Enjoy meaningful progression without draining your battery or consuming excessive storage space.
TRADE WITH OTHER PLAYERS
Buy, sell, and trade resources, equipment, and collectibles through a live player-driven marketplace. Build wealth, find valuable deals, and participate in an evolving economy shaped by the community.
WORLD BOSSES & ENDGAME CHALLENGES
Take on rotating World Bosses with unique mechanics, restrictions, and rewards. Compete with other players, earn exclusive loot, and test the limits of your character through increasingly challenging content.
Complete long-term goals, fill out your collection log, chase rare drops, and climb the leaderboards as you continue expanding your account.
FEATURES
• 16 Skills: Train a wide variety of interconnected skills up to level 200.
• Offline Progression: Continue training, fighting, and gathering resources while away.
• Deep Character Customization: Optimize your build with equipment, Runes, Soulstones, pets, and more.
• Strategic Turn-Based Combat: Battle over 100 unique monsters and challenging bosses.
• Rare Loot & Collectibles: Discover unique items, monster cards, pets, and valuable rewards.
• Live Marketplace: Buy, sell, and trade with other players through a player-driven economy.
• World Bosses: Participate in rotating community challenges for exclusive rewards.
• Weekly PvP Tournaments: Compete against other players in multiple tournament modes and test your combat strategies.
• Collection Log: Track your discoveries and pursue long-term completion goals.
• Permanent Progression: No forced resets or prestige mechanics.
• Leaderboards & Milestones: Compete with other players and unlock hundreds of achievements.
• PvP Tournaments: Compete against other players in multiple tournament modes, place bets, and climb the rankings.
WHY PLAY HARPAGIA?
• Clean Portrait Interface: Designed for comfortable one-handed play.
• True Offline Gameplay: Progress even when the game is closed.
• Low Battery Usage: Deep gameplay without demanding graphics.
• Long-Term Progression: Build a character that continues growing for months and years.
• Built for RPG Fans: A game focused on progression, strategy, loot, and meaningful choices.
If you're looking for a deep offline idle RPG with strategic combat, rare loot, skill progression, and long-term goals, start your journey in Harpagia today.

bluejetty:00128354:ios.description:
Enter the shoes of a Vatican secret agent in this story-rich, hidden-object puzzle adventure set in a terror-stricken medieval Spanish village.
Inquisitor Augustine has lost his mind, plunging Portonero into fear. You must step in, investigate suspicious villagers, uncover the truth behind the chaos and end the reign of terror.
Investigate the obsessive inquisitor Augustine, discover hidden clues in Portonero, and solve hundreds of puzzles to bring peace back to the terrified villagers.
WHAT AWAITS YOU:
• A hidden-object puzzle adventure with a rich story
• Puzzle & mystery adventure — dozens of unique riddles and mini-games.
• Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.
• Atmospheric visuals & soundtrack — moody scenes that pull you deep into the mystery.
• Full voiceovers & HD visuals — immerse yourself in the story.
• 3 difficulty levels — from relaxed exploration to true challenge.
PERFECT FOR PLAYERS WHO WANT:
• Fully optimized for iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with stunning HD graphics and detail!
• Play completely offline — Desktop, Phone & Tablet support — anytime, anywhere
• No data collection — your privacy is safe
• Try free, unlock full game once — no ads, no micro-transactions
Gameplay
Tap to search scenes, collect clues, combine items from your inventory, and complete mini-games to progress.
Use hints if you get stuck — but the reward is uncovering more of the mystery.
Play your way
Explore, investigate, find hidden objects and items, and solve puzzles and mini-games to reveal the mystery in your own way:
adjustable challenge — Casual, Adventure, and Challenging difficulty modes.
Earn Achievements & Collectibles.
Atmospheric adventure
A gripping mystery adventure: narrative-driven gameplay with strong detective elements.
Immersive locations are waiting to be explored — seek, search, and solve.
Why players love it
The mix of art and atmosphere, combined with story-driven adventure and classic puzzles and mini-games.
Whether you enjoy relaxing hidden-object hunts or brain-teasing challenges — this game offers both.
Free to try
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire mystery — no distractions, just a mystery to solve.

bluejetty:00185196:ios.description:
Join millions of players in MamoBall, a unique and competitive multiplayer soccer game! Play thrilling real-time matches with friends or players worldwide, climb the ranks in 4v4 ranked games, or create custom lobbies for matches from 1v1 to 4v4!
*Challenge your friends in real-time!
Get social with MamoBall by adding friends to your in-game friend list! Play thrilling football matches together and prove who’s the best. Create your own club or team to unite with other players and work towards shared goals. Join exciting tournaments hosted on Discord to showcase your skills. Plus, engage with others through the in-game live chat and become part of a vibrant community!
*Rumble Through Competitive Soccer Leagues with your team!
Compete in 5 different soccer leagues and do your best to make it to the very top of the ladder. Join a team or create your own, either way, you’re much powerful with your team! Join the competition each week where you have a chance to challenge other teams all around the world. More team you beat, more chance to rise from Amateur League to Champions League! Fight your way through real opponents and challenging soccer matches. You can’t know who the winner before the match will be is over.
*Unique Gameplay
Experience soccer like never before with MamoBall's unique gameplay! While the mechanics may seem simple at first, mastering them requires strategy and sharp football IQ. Kick, strike, and score using your hero in action-packed matches where no two games are the same. Connect with friends via Facebook or Discord and challenge them to see who truly rules the field!
Build your skills and dominate the field in MamoBall! Unlock exclusive bonuses, unique characters, and stylish accessories as you play. With every match, the competition gets tougher do you have what it takes to outplay your opponents and claim victory?
*Upgrade Your Character to Become a Champion!
Stand out from the crowd by choosing from hundreds of accessories to find your unique combination. Improve your characters’ skills to dominate the field. Progress to unlock new characters and cosmetic rewards and upgrade your favorite characters.
Make every day more exciting with Daily Missions! Complete unique challenges daily and claim amazing rewards as you play.
Features:
-Play online soccer games against real players from around the world.
-Compete in 5 competitive leagues with 15 brackets to climb through.
-Enjoy dynamic and exciting gameplay with vibrant, dashy graphics.
-Upgrade your character and customize them with cool accessories.
-Discover new characters, items, and events added regularly!
-Collect card packs to unlock unique items and characters.
-Connect via social media to play and team up with friends.
-Complete Daily Missions for extra fun and exciting rewards!
-Create or join in-game communities and clubs to team up with like-minded players.
-Participate in tournaments hosted on Discord and showcase your skills.
-Socialize through the in-game live chat and build lasting friendships.
Download MamoBall to experience the thrill of the match and compete against millions!
IMPORTANT!
MamoBall is free to download and play, however, there are some items in the game that can be purchased for real money. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings if you don’t want this feature.
A network connection is required to play.

bluejetty:00043966:ios.name: Blood: Period & Cycle Tracker
bluejetty:00043966:ios.summary: Figure out your flow. Worry less. Do more. Backed by science and driven by fun, the Blood period tracker app gets to know you and your body on a deeper level – giving you opportunities to personalise your own period journey, and providing s
bluejetty:00043966:ios.description:
Figure out your flow. Worry less. Do more. Backed by science and driven by fun, the Blood period tracker app gets to know you and your body on a deeper level – giving you opportunities to personalise your own period journey, and providing support at every step of your cycle. With a combination of intelligent menstrual cycle tracking, period predictions, health insights, and highly-customisable avatars that reflect your every mood, Blood does more than just track your periods – it’s designed to help you understand your cycle like never before. 
TAKE THE GUESSWORK OUT OF YOUR PERIODS
Track your period length, flow intensity, and symptoms, and view your predicted periods and ovulation dates for months in advance. Using machine learning artificial intelligence, our predictions get better over time. The more you log, the more accurate your predictions! Sync your life with your cycle – whether you’re planning for a big date, a sunny getaway, or an important presentation, being able to view future periods will help you know what’s coming. 
CUSTOMISABLE AVATARS
Let your inner self shine through with highly-customisable Blood avatars that reflect your every mood. Switch up looks or show how you’re feeling today. Make this period journey truly yours!
LOG YOUR SYMPTOMS & MOODS 
Keep tabs on your symptoms such as cramps, bloating, aches, fatigue and insomnia so that you can observe trends and gain overall insights on your health.
INSIGHTS ABOUT YOU, FOR YOU
Your menstrual cycle is made up of more than just PMS and your period. It comes with its own ups and downs according to your hormonal changes – we’re here to help you make sense of everything! The Blood app quickly gets to know all about you, and provides personalised daily tips that go with your flow and guide you on how to benefit from each menstrual phase. Enjoy insights on your mood, energy levels and more so that you can stay informed and take control of your cycle!
GET REMINDERS
Set up and receive reminders for what’s important to you! Want a heads up on your period, fertility or ovulation day? No problem! You even get to add your own personal touch to your reminder message! Keep it secret, include an inside joke, or show some self-love – go ahead and toss in some fun of your own!
SYNC TO YOUR PERSONAL CALENDAR APP
Your period predictions can be synced with third-party calendars (such as Google Calendar or iCal) with just one tap for an overview of what your schedule holds – and how your period may come into the picture! No more switching between apps and struggling to keep track of things. With this integration, you can easily get a glimpse of your flow together with other events so that you can plan your holidays, dates and other activities – worry-free! 
USER-FRIENDLY DESIGN 
Taking a user-first approach, we’ve given our app a brand new refresh! There’s so much to discover about your cycle and health – this exciting interface makes tracking your period, viewing countdowns, checking on fertility, and getting support a fuss-free and fun experience that you’ll want to keep coming back for.

bluejetty:00134537:ios.description:
Take the WMTW News 8 app with you everywhere you go and be the first to know of breaking news happening in Portland and the surrounding area. Always stay up to date with the latest local news, national, sports, traffic, political, entertainment stories and much more. Download the WMTW News 8 app for free today.
Our Local News, Weather and Sports App Features Include:
- Portland breaking news alerts with push notifications
- Live streaming breaking news updates from our WMTW News 8 reporters when it happens, where it happens
- Local news submission area for breaking news, news tips and the ability to email your news photos and videos right to our newsroom to be featured on air
- Share stories via email or your social media pages
- Up to date, current local weather conditions, hourly Portland weather updates, and 7 day forecasts
- An interactive radar that lets you zoom in and out to street level and watch storms as they approach. Move the map around to see major weather activity
- Portland weather alerts and updates, Maine's Total Weather videocasts and more
Although Hearst Television believes the majority of its news content is appropriate for a variety of ages, it is intended for individuals 18 and older.

bluejetty:00065943:ios.description:
"Dink Smallwood is a perfect example of the refined basics of classic RPG and adventure games…enjoy the hearty dose of something simple, silly, and special." - Jordan Thomas, Avault.com
"The main hook in this game has to be the sense of humor that permeates it... the difference is that this game is beautiful, gory, and has a wonderful (and twisted) sense of humor.” - T. Byrl Baker, Computer Gaming World
It all began in a world where dragons roamed the land and knights fought with valor and honor.
And then there was Dink. Can a simple pig farmer thrust into an epic journey of magic and adventure save the world?
Dink Smallwood HD is the revamped version of the classic RPG brought to you by the original creators featuring:
• Full in-game DMOD support! 300+ user made quests/stories available
• Supports iOS controllers and keyboards in addition to touch controls!
• Includes the complete re-mastered original CD soundtrack
• Speed up" button to fly through dialog and cutscenes at your own pace
• Automatic full state save/restore whenever you quit/restart the game
• Auto save and Quick save/load feature
• Upgraded and optimized engine, Dink never looked or sounded better

bluejetty:00072493:ios.description:
Instantly generate voice and video from text. Just input your text, the app will generate audio & video for you.
The app converts your text into captivating audiovisual experiences! Whether you're a content creator, storyteller, or simply want to add a unique touch to your messages, this app is designed to bring your words to life like never before.
The app uses cutting-edge artificial intelligence models to generate voices that are so realistic, you won't even recognize them as artificial voices.
Key Features:
- Voice Generation: Transform your text into realistic voices
- Over 60 human-like voices available in multiple languages
- Save & export generated audio for your YouTube videos or any personal and commercial projects
- Text to Video Creation: Instantly create video from script
- Ai Quiz Builder: Generate quiz videos instantly
- Many word-level animations that synchronize perfectly with the spoken words
- Text style customization: fonts, color, alignment, size, stroke, text 3D, etc.
- Automatically highlight keywords with different colors
- Custom text-video's background using solid colors, gradient colors or photos from your library
- Over 20 languages support
- Multiple canvas ratios for all social networks
- High resolution and up-to 60 FPS video exporting.
Premium Upgrade:
The app is completely free to use with many features, but you can unlock even more voices and characters with the Premium.
The Premium offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
$4.99 per week
$9.99 per month
$39.99 per year with 3 days free trial
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

Stay connected and keep your loved ones safe—wherever they are. FamSync is your all-in-one location-sharing app designed to help families, friends, and close groups stay in touch, stay safe, and feel closer—no matter the distance.
IMPORTAN
bluejetty:00095163:ios.description:
Stay connected and keep your loved ones safe—wherever they are. FamSync is your all-in-one location-sharing app designed to help families, friends, and close groups stay in touch, stay safe, and feel closer—no matter the distance.
IMPORTANT: GPS tracking requires mutual consent. Only share your location with people you know and trust.
FamSync includes free features for personal use, as well as powerful premium tools to connect with others and access advanced tracking. Premium access is available via subscription.
Free Features:
- See your own live location – View yourself on the map at any time
- Track your own route history – Check where you’ve been recently, day by day
Premium Features (available with a subscription):
- Real-time location tracking – Know where your family is at any moment
- Create private groups – Organize your family or friends into trusted circles
- Location history – See where your contacts have been in recent days
- Track members by phone number – Find and follow people using their number
- Check new contacts – Look up info by phone number, email, address, or name
We offer auto-renewing subscriptions with the following pricing and terms:
- Subscriptions are available for 1 week, 1 month, or 12 months
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription
Prices may vary by region.
Optional Permission Requests:
- Location Services – to share your real-time location with trusted contacts
- Notifications – to receive alerts about your family’s location changes
- Contacts – to invite others and connect with people you know
- Motion & Fitness – to improve location accuracy and reduce battery usage
- App Tracking – to deliver more relevant ads and offers
IMPORTANT: Contact access is used only locally on your device to help you invite people from your address book. No contact data is uploaded or shared.
Please note: GPS location sharing is only available with mutual consent from all members. Your contacts privacy is our top priority—share your location only with people you trust.
For more information, please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://famsync.net/pp
https://famsync.net/tou
Disclaimer: Continued use of GPS running in the background may significantly decrease battery life.

This means you may not use our site, services, or any information obtained through FamSync.net to make decisions about employment, tenant screening, insurance, consumer credit, education admission, or any other purpose that requires FCRA compliance.

bluejetty:00023720:ios.description:
A magic eraser app that let you remove objects and people out of your picture. It's also offers an advanced AI technology for AI expand image or generative fill tools such as AI fill and AI replace. Say goodbye to unwanted objects in your photo, with Remove Objects, you can create a flawless image with just a few taps.
Key Features
- AI Remove Objects
This magic eraser feature use AI remove to erase objects with precision and leave behind a natural looking background. Whether it's a stray passerby, an unwanted object, or anything else you wish was not there, this AI remove objects tool will make it disappear like magic.
- AI Generative Fill
This AI fill technology can intelligently predicts and generates content that blends perfectly with your photo, allowing you to enhance what's already there. Our AI replace feature giving you the power of unleashing your creativity without the need of complex software.
- AI Expand Image
Enlarge the boundaries of your image while maintaining the level of detail and quality. With the help of the new AI expand tool, you can easily fit your picture into a any format, or just to blow a new breathe to your photo.
- AI Edit
Simply describe what you want and watch it happen. This AI edit tool let you transform your photo directly using text prompts, no complicated tools or steep learning curve, just type what you want changed and let the AI do the rest.
- Isolate
Want to move a subject somewhere else in your photo? This isolate feature separates objects from the rest of your image while generative AI intelligently fills in the background behind it, giving you the freedom to reposition anything exactly where you want it.
- Remove Background
No more manual selecting or masking, this AI remove background tool automatically erase the background from any photo in seconds, leaving you with a clean cutout ready for whatever you have in mind.
- Upscale
Bring your photos into stunning clarity with this AI upscale tool. Enhance resolution up to 4K using advanced AI image generation, perfect for printing, cropping in closer, or just giving old photos a new life.
- Complete Redesign with Liquid Glass
We rebuilt the entire app from the ground up with a brand new Liquid Glass design, bringing a fresh, fluid look and feel to every corner of the experience.
- More Basic Tools
Beyond our AI-powered toolkit, we've expanded with more basic editing capabilities including Adjustments, Layers, and Crop, giving you everything you need to perfect your photo in one place.
- Optimized for iPad
Now fully optimized for iPad with support for resizability, so you can edit your photos in whatever window size fits your workflow.
How to use our magic eraser tools
1. Take a picture or choose a photo you want to remove objects
2. Choose where you want to replace or erase objects
3. Retouch the image with AI replace or generative fill based on your need
4. Get a peak outside of what the lens captured with AI expand your picture
5. Export your content to library or send it via any social media
Smart Eraser:
- You can subscribe to unlock Smart Eraser, an AI-powered object removal that provides super realistic result.

bluejetty:00131530:ios.description:
Make safer, faster clinical decisions – anywhere you practice.
epocrates is the trusted clinical reference app for U.S. physicians (MDs/DOs), nurse practitioners (NPs), physician associates (PAs), pharmacists, and medical students – helping you confidently prescribe, stay up to date, calculate dosages, and save time. 
Top tools for busy clinicians: 
 • Comprehensive Drug Reference – 6,000+ Rx and OTC monographs for brand and generic drugs, including adult and pediatric dosing, contraindications, black box warnings, and pharmacology.  
 • Drug Interaction Checker – Quickly identify interactions among up to 30 medications at once to ensure safer prescribing and reduce medication errors.
 • Pill Identifier – Instantly identify pills using imprint, shape, color, or image – one of the most trusted pill finder tools for clinicians.  
 • Lab Reference Values – Access normal lab ranges, interpretations, and clinical guidance to support diagnostic decisions.  
 • Dosing Calculators – Weight- and age-based calculators for precise prescription guidance at the point of care.  
 • Symptom Checker & Disease Reference – Evaluate symptoms and conditions efficiently with evidence-based guidelines.  
 • Herbs & Supplements Database – Search herbal, supplement, and alternative medicine information, including known interactions.  
 • Offline Access – Use the full app without internet —perfect for rural, remote or on-the-go care.  
Whether you’re searching by pill identifier, entering ICD-10 codes, or looking up a prescription, epocrates delivers fast, reliable results. It’s more than a drug reference—it’s your trusted clinical assistant. 
Why Clinicians Choose epocrates:  
 • #1-Rated Clinical App – trusted by U.S. physicians, NPs, and PAs for fast, reliable drug reference and clinical decision support.  
 • Used Millions of Times Monthly – Tools like the pill identifier, drug interaction checker, and dosing calculators improve workflow efficiency.  
 • Enhances Patient Safety – Helps reduce medication errors with evidence-based guidance and interaction alerts.  
 • Continuously Updated – Medical Editors and healthcare experts ensure current, accurate drug and clinical information.  
 • Saves Hours Each Week – Streamline prescribing, lab lookups, and clinical reference tasks with integrated tools.  
 • Supports Medication Delivery & Fulfillment – Optimized for use in prescribing, pharmacy, and point-of-care environments.  
Download now to support safer, faster prescribing with the leading decision support app trusted by over 2M prescribers. 
Subscription & Payment Info: 
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of premium upgrade purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Introductory pricing or discounts, if available, apply only to the first subscription period.
Learn more:

bluejetty:00078348:ios.description:
Transform your iPhone or iPad into a powerful 4WD offroad GPS navigator with Offline Topo maps of Australia. BillyGoat is the 4WD mapping app purpose built for 4WD enthusiast. 
• Australian 4X4, Camping, Touring, Hiking maps.
• Get directions to any destination. BillyGoat automatically plots routes turn by turn to your destinations, including routing via 4WD tracks.*
• Stunning 3D shaded mapping. 
• 1:5,000 scale. Unbeatable!
• Full coverage of Australia.
• Maps Works OFFLINE, no internet or phone connectivity required.
• Real-time GPS - see your exact location on the map at all times. 
• 10,000+ Campsites & Caravan parks with Amenities.
• GPS tracking records where you’ve been. (aka Bread crumbs feature)* 
• See your GPS speed in real time.
Perfect for a quick weekend camp or an epic outback touring trip of a lifetime, BillyGoat is the must have companion app for 4WD, Camping and Touring enthusiasts.
BillyGoat simplifies trip planning by figuring out the best route to your destination, including routing via 4WD offroad tracks.
On an iPhone or iPad, the best in class 4WD Topo map come to life, rendering Roads, 4WD Tracks, Fire trials, Points of Interest and Terrain topography in stunning levels clarity.
As you travel, see your location update in real time on a map. Should you lose your bearings, BillyGoat can record a tracklog (bread crumb) of your process so you can easily retrace your steps.
Finding a place to crash for the night has never been easier. BillyGoat features a comprehensive database of over 10,000 Campsites and Caravan parks with amenities.
All of these features work seamlessly OFFLINE, without the need for internet or phone connectivity.
BillyGoat packs detailed 4WD maps, campsites and powerful navigation features in a simple to use package.
Download BillyGoat now and you will be ready to explore OFF the beaten track!

DESCRIPTION
Get our new TicketNetwork App today! The fastest and easiest, way to get tickets to live events. The TicketNetwork mobile app is a must-have for fans of live events, offering instant access to over 100,000 events & millions of tickets. Download now and save!
WIDE SELECTION
TicketNetwork lets fans buy with confidence from one of the largest selection of tickets available. From North America to Europe,TicketNetwork has your tickets to your next live event!
100% GUARANTEE
Backed by TicketNetwork’s 100% Guarantee, fans will have valid tickets that will arrive before the event, and they will be the ones you ordered or upgraded, and your seats will be together unless otherwise noted.
WHY IT WORKS 
With seventeen years of industry experience, TicketNetwork offers competitive prices, data driven pages to aid customers and a customer service team always here to help, TicketNetwork is a brand you can trust.

I bought tickets for the Jason Aldean concert in Camden, NJ for 10 people using TicketNetwork and my experience using this service was extremely satisfactory. I received my tickets well in advance of the concert!
I paid $20 for $60 tickets. I was thrilled. I also received a follow-up email from TicketNetwork thanking me for my order and asking if I received the tickets.
The ordering process was easy, and we were able to get into the center without any issues using printed tickets. Would recommend in the future.
TicketNetwork has been good and I've never had an issue in the many times that I've used them.
TicketNetwork has great ticket prices. I printed the tickets off from their website. Overall, I've had a pretty good experience.
TicketNetwork has better prices and I've been using them for years. I've been going to concerts and Dodgers games. I used to buy tickets somewhere else, but now, I use TicketNetwork.

bluejetty:00135731:ios.name: Loop - Interval & Multi Timer
bluejetty:00135731:ios.summary:
Loop makes setting timers easier, faster and more beautiful. Start multiple (interval, Tabata, and cooking) timers, create presets, import your own sounds and so much more!
- Easy Start:
The start screen shows the most recently started tim
bluejetty:00135731:ios.description:
Loop makes setting timers easier, faster and more beautiful. Start multiple (interval, Tabata, and cooking) timers, create presets, import your own sounds and so much more!
- Easy Start:
The start screen shows the most recently started timers and your favorites. One tap is enough to start a timer. You can also create a new quick timer with natural-language input: Simply type something like "1h Work, 30m Break" to create a timer with two intervals. Any number of timers can be started in parallel. The first timers will be displayed as nested rings.
- Automatic Reset:
After a timer expires, the app plays a sound and the timer automatically resets, so you can start it again immediately. Alternatively, you can configure a timer to play the sound like an alarm until you disable it. Loop supports AlarmKit so the alarm is also shown on your Apple Watch (requires at least iOS or iPadOS 26).
- Presets:
You can save your favorite timers as presets, which can be started with a tap. You can use text or an icon for your presets, and also change the color as you like. You can create multiple categories for your presets, with each category able to customize the app’s default settings.
- Interval Timers:
You can create interval timers and save them as Presets. The app plays a sound for each elapsed interval and displays it as a small dash on the ring. Additionally, you can name each of them, select repetitions for the intervals, or make the timer repeat automatically.
- Choose Sounds:
In addition to many included sounds, you can also import your own sound files from the Files app. Start, pause, finish, reset, interval, and background sounds can be selected separately.
- Meditation Sounds:
You can activate a background sound such as ocean waves or white noise in the settings, which will then be played when a timer is running. It is also possible to switch off the screen in order to concentrate fully on your meditation.
- iCloud Sync:
Your timers, settings, and sounds sync with your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac.
- Push Notifications & Live Activities:
Loop will send you a push notification when the app is closed if a timer or interval has expired. The sounds selected in the app will also be used for the notification. In addition, a live activity is displayed when timers are running.
- And More:
Custom app icons, Apple Watch integration, HealthKit support, configure when the screen should stay awake, and countless further options.
This application is governed by Apple’s standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement (EULA), available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00039239:ios.name: Mastercard Airport Experiences
bluejetty:00039239:ios.summary: IMPORTANT: This app provides eligible Mastercard cardholders with the ability to locate airport lounges and offers. If you are an eligible member of this program, your Mastercard issuer should provide you with information related to accessi
bluejetty:00039239:ios.description:
IMPORTANT: This app provides eligible Mastercard cardholders with the ability to locate airport lounges and offers. If you are an eligible member of this program, your Mastercard issuer should provide you with information related to accessing the program. Please contact your issuer for questions regarding eligibility. 
To verify your eligibility, after registration you may see a temporary charge of $1.00 (USD) in your payment card transaction history. This is solely a “pending” transaction and your card will NOT be charged. After your eligibility is verified, the pending amount will be removed (usually within 10 business days).
This easy-to-use mobile app, developed by LoungeKey, is designed to enrich the time that Mastercard cardholders spend at the airport. The app enables cardholders to explore more than 1000 airport lounges from around the world as well as hundreds of curated airport offers.
AIRPORT LOUNGES
Escape the airport crowds and retreat to an oasis in more than 600 airports worldwide. 
- Search for a lounge by simply typing an Airport, Airport code, City or Country
- Make the most of the favorites features for quick and easy access
- See detailed lounge information such as location, amenities, and hours of operation
AIRPORT OFFERS
Take advantage of a curated listing of airport offers that span across dining, spa, and retail. 
- Find offers available to you based on the terminal where you are located 
- See detailed offer information (i.e., location of the merchant, hours of operation, and terms and conditions)
- Generate a QR offer code for redemption of the offer
ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
Easily manage your account information, view lounge visit history, and access active and historical offers.

Soothing Beachside Vibe: Immerse yourself in a tranquil coastal setting, designed to provide a calm and visually pleasing escape.
Satisfying Cube Merging: Experience the simple yet engaging gameplay of launching and combining three-dimensional numbered blocks. Watch as they collide and merge in a visually rewarding way.
Build Your Paradise: Use the coins and resources you earn to develop a deserted shore into your own personalized beach retreat.
Diverse Upgrades: Unlock and enhance a variety of beach amenities, from functional items like barbecue grills and drink machines to comfortable loungers and decorative umbrellas.
Harmonious Blend of Genres: Enjoy a gameplay experience that seamlessly combines the thoughtful fun of a puzzle game with the steady, rewarding progression of a building simulator.
Progress at Your Pace: The game is designed for relaxed engagement, allowing you to develop your beach and advance through the puzzles at a comfortable rhythm.
Invest your resources to shape a vibrant coastline. Each upgrade enhances your coastal haven, making your Lucky Cube Holiday complete.

bluejetty:00152941:ios.description:
Seals Shatter! Ancient Titans have returned. Choose your exclusive Class, awaken divine powers, and fight for civilization's survival in a dynamically crumbling world - Rally allies to command Titanforged Behemoths, turn the tide, and tear through the apocalypse with your Sacred Arms.
You, chosen by fate, are the last light in the darkness. As the bearer of the Eternal Flame, you will journey across sacred lands, forgotten ruins, and perilous skies, gathering elemental relics to seal away the Dragon King once again. The fate of all realms rests on your shoulders.
Who will dominate the final battlefield—light or shadow?
==Features==
▶Epic Fantasy World with Cinematic Visuals◀
Experience a vast, magical continent brought to life with exquisite modeling.
From the golden towers of Skyhaven to the haunted marshes of Duskmoor, every step of your journey is filled with breathtaking scenery and deadly secrets.
▶Generous AFK Rewards—Grow Without Limits◀
Log in to claim FREE VIP10 and 100K Red Diamonds!
Go AFK and watch your hero's level and combat power soar automatically.
Hunt colossal world bosses for legendary gear, and hit 1000% drop rate boosts—maxing out your power in record time!
▶Hundreds of Outfits & Legendary Companion System◀
Mix and match Mystic Armor, Royal Robes, Battle Mechs, and Festival Outfits to express your unique style.
Summon companions from across realms—Frost Warrior, Moon Bat, Bastet—and unleash powerful link skills in battle.
▶Challenging Dungeons & Dynamic Boss Evolutions◀
Face evolving bosses that grow stronger with each defeat, unlocking rarer loot every time.
Conquer modes like Chaos Rift, Titan's Trial, and Mirage Wars for exclusive rewards.
▶Massive Cross-Server Battles & Guild Wars◀
Join forces with friends in epic guild sieges, defend your realm from invading armies, and claim the Throne of Eternity in massive cross-server showdowns.
Stand united, or watch your world fall to ruin.

bluejetty:00128844:ios.description:

BizXpenseTracker (BXT) is finely tuned, exceptionally reliable and has been helping users track their expenses, mileage and time since 2010
* Apple named BizXpenseTracker "Noteworthy"
* Selected as a "very useful app" by Apple in: Apps for Business
* Inc. Magazine Recommended
Amex Recommends: http://tinyurl.com/AmexTopPick
WHY BizXpenseTracker IS BETTER
* NOW in its 11th year
* Elegant user interface
* The most powerful and flexible Reporting features available
* Organize your entries into logs for maximum organization
* Quick and easy on-screen filtering to get the most from your tracked data
* File Linking feature allows you to link files received via email
EASE OF USE
* Completely customize your app and make it your own
* Record your entries with easy to use screens that show your frequently used items
* Customize categories and sub-categories
* Custom keyboard with calculator functions
* Smart functions to make data entry FAST ( ie For each category, the last payment type is remembered)
REPORTING
* Flexible and Powerful
* Choose the attractive PDF format or CSV for importing into Excel
* Over two dozen built-in templates
* Email your reports and photo receipts
* Export your reports to Dropbox, iCloud or to your desktop via wi-fi
* Include photo receipt images in the same file as the PDF report
* Accountants love our reports!
PHOTO RECEIPTS
* Capture multiple images per entry
* Easily Crop images
PREFERENCES
* The MOST extensive set of preferences available
* Hide those fields you do not need
ON-SCREEN FILTERING
* Sort entries by Date,Category,Payment or Client
* Extensive on-screen filtering
MILEAGE
* Track mileage the way you want
 1. LIVE mileage tracking - the app will track your every move - just tell the app when you depart and when you arrive. The app will do the rest
 2. Enter Start/Stop odometer reading
 3. Enter the start and end addresses and the app will determine the travel distance
 4. See optional fully automatic AutoTrack feature below
* If using odometer, will pre-fill start mileage with last stop mileage
* Access Frequent trips from the QUICK menu
* Supports Multiple Vehicles
TIME
* Create custom rates using a rate type of
hourly, per visit, or per day
* Categorize by: Work, Vacation, Sick or Other
BUSINESS SPECIFIC
* Per Diem
* Commuter mileage
INTERNATIONAL
* Supports ALL major currencies
* Extensive support for VAT
BACKUP AND SAFE KEEPING
* Backup your data to iCloud, Dropbox or directly to your desktop
* Set Backup to “Automatic” to iCloud or Dropbox
* Set Password or use TouchID
-----
Required Subscription
A subscription to Unlimited Usage or AutoTrack (which includes unlimited usage) is required after adding 25 free entries
Subscription Details:
* Choose between Unlimited Usage or AutoTrack (includes unlimited usage)
* AutoTrack is a feature that will automatically track your drives. All you need to do is carry your device with you.
* Payment charged to iTunes account.
* Automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
* Either subscription is available monthly or yearly
Optional Subscription - HumanScan:
* Human Scan will allow you to take a picture of a receipt and have an actual human extract the key information and update your expense entry. You do NOT need this add-on if you simply want to take photos of your receipt as the app already has that built-in
Questions/Comments:
Just tap the Email the Author link in the Prefs screen

bluejetty:00170848:ios.name: InstaTeam sports team manager
bluejetty:00170848:ios.summary: Instateam mobile app is used by thousands of teams and social groups including sports teams, classrooms, churches, boy scouts, and many other kinds of groups. It is a consolidated mobile dashboard for team admins, sports team managers, te
bluejetty:00170848:ios.description:
Instateam mobile app is used by thousands of teams and social groups including sports teams, classrooms, churches, boy scouts, and many other kinds of groups. It is a consolidated mobile dashboard for team admins, sports team managers, teachers or coaches with instant access to all the team information. Several high school and college athletic directors use Instateam to manage, communicate with and get access to all their teams in an integrated mobile and web environment. 
The mobile-first design of Instateam supports almost all team management functions on the mobile app and does not require web access. A simple to use mobile interface makes it convenient for team admins and team members.
What makes Instateam different from other sports team management apps like TeamSanp or Teamapp? 
Instateam automates creating team rosters and event schedules with an advanced mobile and email notification system. While notification system generates automatic notifications, the team members can easily customize their notification preferences. Instateam’s real-time messaging, similar to Whatsapp, makes the communication with team members very effective. Admins can check who has read their urgent messages and who has not. Most importantly, all the enhanced features in Instateam are free.
Here are some of the enhanced features that you will not find in other team management apps. 
• Team Roster: Easily import and export team members from excel file or copy team members between teams. Members can also join team using self-signup
• Simple and quick signup with single sign-on integration with Google and Facebook. 
• Events Management: Create multiple games, practices, meetings and other events on multiple days with just few clicks. No need to create one event at a time. Edit multiple events in one click. 
• Communication via instant messaging, team messages or team surveys 
• Schedule Integration: Import events from an excel file or use iCal link from external calendars to subscribe. Export team events in multiple formats such as excel, iCal, web url or integrate directly with Google calendar. 
• Carpool: Team admins can easily check who needs a ride, who is driving and arrange carpool. Coaches can also add transportation for games or events.
• Signup Items: Create signup items for single event or multiple events with just few clicks. Send reminders and easily export signup list.
• Track Items: Assign tasks or items to team members with due date. Find out who need to return team equipment, submit registration or medical forms, etc, 
• Notification flags when a payment is due or a track item task is not completed.
• Payments & Dues: Receive payment from team members using Paypal and keep track of who paid when and how. Coaches or team admins can easily view which members have not paid their dues
• Attendance and player availability: Team members or parents can set their availability for upcoming events. Coaches can mark member attendance as present or absent for the events.
• Team Surveys: Create custom team surveys with response by date
• Privacy: InstaTeam gives full control to team member to keep their information private and still be able to communicate with other team members.
• Team Fans and followers: Sports teams can promote their teams by getting fans within local community as team supporters. The fans can view all games schedule and be there to support the team.
• Ads Free Subscription: The subscription removes ads within the app. The in-app purchase is charged to your itunes account after confirmation. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchaseSubscription. Subscription automatically renews for 3 months unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
Terms of use:
https://tmspapp.s3.amazonaws.com/html/terms.html

bluejetty:00074031:ios.description:
Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD) may present with obsessions, compulsions, or both. Obsessions and compulsions are often distressing, time-consuming, and impairing.
Everyone has worried about germs or losing something or someone getting hurt. These thoughts tend to be fleeting and do not disrupt daily living. If these thoughts are constantly occurring, uncontrollable, intrusive, and cause a lot of anxiety or stress, then they may be considered 'obsessions.'
Everyone has felt the need to double check that the door is locked or arrange items in a correct way. If you perform these actions like a ritual or with rigid rules in order to prevent or reduce anxious thoughts, or if these actions greatly disrupt your life, then they may be considered 'compulsions.'
This app is designed to evaluate your symptoms of OCD with a scientifically-supported 18-question test. It uses the Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory - Revised (OCI-R), a screening questionnaire for OCD that is commonly used in research and healthcare settings. The OCI-R is also helpful for monitoring your OCD-related symptoms during and after treatment.
OCD Test contains four tools:
- Start Test: take the OCI-R questionnaire to assess OCD symptoms
- History: see a history of your test scores to monitor your symptoms over time
- Information: learn about OCD and discover additional resources that can help you on your path to recovery
- Reminder: set up notifications to re-take the questionnaire at your convenience
Disclaimer: The OCI-R is NOT a diagnostic test. A diagnosis can only be provided by a qualified healthcare professional. Please consult a physician or mental health professional if you are concerned about OCD. 
References: Foa, E. B., Huppert, J. D., Leiberg, S., Langner, R., Kichic, R., Hajcak, G., & Salkovskis, P. M. (2002). The Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory: development and validation of a short version. Psychological assessment, 14(4), 485.
American Psychiatric Association. (2013). Diagnostic and statistical manual of mental disorders (5th ed.). Washington, DC: Author.

- History: see a history of your test scores to monitor your symptoms over time
- Information: learn about OCD and discover additional resources that can help you on your path to recovery
- Reminder: set up notifications to re-take the questionnaire at your convenience

Disclaimer: The OCI-R is NOT a diagnostic test. A diagnosis can only be provided by a qualified healthcare professional. Please consult a physician or mental health professional if you are concerned about OCD.

bluejetty:00131687:ios.description:
SCRUFF is the top-rated and most reliable app for gay, bi, trans, and queer people to connect with each other.
SCRUFF is an independent, LGBTQ+ owned and operated company, and we use the app that we build. We give users a private and secure experience, a friendly and diverse community, and more features than any other gay dating app. We’re dedicated to protecting our members’ data and improving user experience, so you’ll never see banner ads on SCRUFF, and we won’t sell your data to shady 3rd party companies.
MAKE REAL CONNECTIONS
30+ million users, no spambots
Find exactly the people you like with search and filters
View, Woof, and chat with people
SCRUFF Match connects you with the people you like
Click "I'm Interested" on a profile and SCRUFF will let you know if there's a mutual attraction
EXPRESS YOURSELF
Share your story with multiple profile pics, rich profiles, private albums, hashtags, and more
Let others know what you’re into with profile details like preferences and safer practices
Comprehensive pronoun and gender identity options put you in control of your identity
A SMARTER, SAFER EXPERIENCE
24/7 support for our community, including in-app links to our Safety Center
We never share your data with 3rd party ad networks or data aggregators like Google or Facebook
Message history, photos, and videos sync across your devices and never get lost
VERIFIED PROFILES
Let others know you're real by verifying your profile photos
Complete the process in seconds and receive a verification badge on your profile
Know whose photos are real by looking for the badge on other profiles
VIDEO CHAT
A fun and flirty way to get to know each other before you meet
Prefer to keep it virtual? Video chat has you covered
MATCH
Every day, SCRUFF Match shows you a new stack of profiles who are looking for people like you
Swipe left to pass, right if you’re interested - if it’s a match, we’ll let you both know
Choose “Ask later” if you’re not sure about them, and we’ll show them again tomorrow
SCRUFF EXPLORE
Browse the top LGBTQ parties, prides, and festivals around the globe
RSVP, see who else is going, and find your squad
Traveling? Let others know when you'll be in their area and chat with local members before you arrive
Question? Comments? We’re available any time at support.scruff.com.
ABOUT SCRUFF SUBSCRIPTIONS

bluejetty:00016438:ios.description:
Gaia is your guide to conscious life. We’re dedicated to finding and creating informative films, original shows, practices, and documentaries that aren’t available through mainstream media. We look to elevate your awareness through enlightening content covering personal transformation, ancient origins, alternative medicine, and much more. Gaia is your window into a new way of viewing the world.
Gaia is the premier streaming platform where the world’s top thought leaders and teachers share knowledge and expertise to empower your conscious awakening. Seek your truth with our library of 8,000+ videos, films, documentaries, series, and live events aimed at answering life’s biggest questions while at the same time helping you navigate everyday complexities.
Stream videos on personal transformation, yoga, meditation, and more with Gaia as your guide to holistic mental health and spirituality. Use our videos to discover new perspectives today and track your yoga practice and meditative activity in your Apple health app. Gaia is a complete resource for personal enlightenment, mindful living, and universal consciousness.
Whether you want to enjoy a mindful yoga practice, practice deep meditation, or you’re seeking truth through metaphysics, fuel the pursuit of your highest potential with Gaia.
GAIA FEATURES
COMPELLING CONTENT THAT BREAKS BOUNDARIES
- Discover ancient history, metaphysics, yoga, meditation, alternative health and more
- Explore videos according to your taste and let your conscious journey begin
- Enjoy exclusive content and videos that push the boundaries of tradition and encourage different ways of viewing the world
- Learn more about spirituality and explore the world of astral projection, tarot cards, and hypnosis
EXPLORE A NEW WAY OF THINKING
- Join thought leaders in exploring topics like lucid dreaming, spiritual healing, and aura health
- Dive into a vast library of content that will have you questioning what you know about the world
- Explore the mysteries of metaphysics, extraterrestrial life, astrology, and more
- Navigate the intricacies of topics such as plant medicine, hypnosis, and energy healing
YOUR PATH TO HOLISTIC & SPIRITUAL WELLNESS
- Access the world’s best teachers and spiritual luminaries to guide you on your self care path
- Enjoy exercises for personal growth, including yoga nidra, meditation, mindful breathing, and more
- Navigate the world’s largest conscious media network for a deep mental, physical, and spiritual connection
- Learn the anxiety relief benefits of intermittent fasting, unblocking chakras and other holistic health techniques
Gaia supports healthKit, allowing you to track your Yoga and Meditation activity in the Apple Health app.
Use an existing login or purchase an auto-renewing subscription with your iTunes account to get access to Gaia. We offer a 7-day free trial with our $15.99 monthly plan & $139.99 annual plan, and a Gaia+ streaming plan for $299 annually without a free trial. Prices may vary by region. A single account grants you access to Gaia on supported devices, TVs, and the Web.

bluejetty:00073702:ios.name: Alive by Whitney Simmons
bluejetty:00073702:ios.summary:
It’s a beautiful day to be Alive!
Placing your physical and mental wellness at the forefront, Alive was designed to offer a safe and empowering space for women to build strength, confidence, and lifelong habits.
Created by fitness experts
bluejetty:00073702:ios.description:
It’s a beautiful day to be Alive!
Placing your physical and mental wellness at the forefront, Alive was designed to offer a safe and empowering space for women to build strength, confidence, and lifelong habits.
Created by fitness experts, Alive meets you exactly where you are in your journey and guides you toward becoming your strongest, most confident self from the inside and out
Alive App Features
- Simple, intuitive design focused on your workout experience
- 20+ guided programs to match your goals and fitness level
- 30-day mental & physical wellness challenges
- 200+ daily workouts to mix and match
- Beginner, Intermediate, and advance difficulty levels
- Select between gym and at-home equipment options
Meet the Trainers
- Whitney Simmons - Leads with a well rounded strength training, focused to help maximize strength utilizing progressive overload, and creating a balanced physique.
- Jessica Bickling - Glute dominant programming built on progressive overload and ready to challenge you at all levels.
- Marissa McNamara - Uses her power training systems to build maximum strength, placing an emphasis on compound movements.
- Libby Christensen - Brings your strength to the next level by utilizing progressive overload training adaptions with an emphasis on compound movements
- Madeleine Abeid - Certified classic mat Pilates instructor with experience in sculpt & fusion practice. Bringing mat pilates to Alive in a follow along format.
- Felicia Keathley - Primarily focuses to help you master essential and foundational exercises. Also known for her pregnancy and postpartum programing.
Programs
Choose from over 20 expert-designed programs. Each program guides you through a structured schedule across several week so you can focus less on planning and more on showing up.
Challenges
Our 30-day challenges are where fitness and mindfulness meet with daily journal prompts, mobility sessions, and habits to support your mental and physical well-being.
Daily Workouts
Don’t want a set program? Choose from 200+ daily workouts across categories like HIIT, core, pull, push, and more. Perfect for mixing things up or staying on track when life gets busy.
Your Journey
The path to a fit, healthy life is a journey, not an overnight process. Stay motivated by logging weight, photos, and completed workouts. See your growth over time and earn achievements along the way. Sync with Apple Health for a complete view of your activity.
Alive Premium
Alive is free to download with Premium plans (Monthly or Annual), both with a 7-day free trial. Premium unlocks full access to all programs, challenges, and daily workouts.
Your subscription will be charged to your Apple account and will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. 
You may manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. After purchase, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. You agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions by downloading and subscribing to Alive Premium.
https://aliveapp.co/terms
https://aliveapp.co/privacy

bluejetty:00023039:ios.summary:
FontFlex for Safari – Accessible Reading for Everyone
FontFlex is a powerful Safari extension designed for anyone who struggles with reading online. Whether you have dyslexia, visual impairments, light sensitivity, or simply find default w
bluejetty:00023039:ios.description:
FontFlex for Safari – Accessible Reading for Everyone
FontFlex is a powerful Safari extension designed for anyone who struggles with reading online. Whether you have dyslexia, visual impairments, light sensitivity, or simply find default web fonts uncomfortable, FontFlex puts you in control of your reading experience.
DESIGNED FOR ACCESSIBILITY
FontFlex helps users with:
• Dyslexia – Choose readable fonts like OpenDyslexic, Comic Sans, or custom spacing
• Visual impairments – Increase text size, adjust contrast, and enhance legibility
• Light sensitivity – Customize text and background colors for comfortable reading
• Eye strain – Fine-tune font weight, line height, and letter spacing
• ADHD & neurodivergence – Personalize your browsing environment to reduce distractions
POWERFUL CUSTOMIZATION
Transform any website with:
• 1,900+ Google Fonts including San Francisco, Verdana, Arial, and handwriting styles
• Dynamic text size adjustment with minimum font size protection
• Text and background color customization for optimal contrast
• Advanced typography controls: font weight, line height, kerning
• Profile system to save different settings for different websites
• Instant application – changes apply automatically as you browse
FREE FEATURES
• Customize fonts on any website with the Safari extension
• Adjust text sizes dynamically
• Create multiple reading profiles
• User-friendly interface
• No tracking or data collection
PRO FEATURES – Enhanced Control
Unlock advanced accessibility with Pro:
• Text and background color customization
• Fine-tune font weights for better readability
• Adjust line heights and letter spacing (kerning)
• Unlimited custom profiles for different websites
• Text decoration controls (bold, italic, underline)
• Auto-apply settings on page load
• Family Sharing included
PRIVACY FIRST
FontFlex respects your privacy. We never track your browsing, collect personal data, or use third-party advertising. Your settings stay on your device.
REAL IMPACT
Join thousands of users who have transformed their web reading experience. FontFlex makes the internet more accessible, comfortable, and enjoyable for everyone – regardless of visual abilities or reading preferences.
Whether you're reading articles, studying online, or browsing your favorite sites, FontFlex helps you read with clarity and confidence.
READ EVERY WEBSITE YOUR WAY
Make the font size bigger or smaller on any web page, and it stays that way the next time you visit. Switch to a clean sans serif typeface when a site's default is hard to follow, or choose a serif when you want a calmer, book-like page. Turn on dark mode colors for night reading, or a warm cream background to take the glare out of long articles.
Everything happens inside Safari, because FontFlex is a Safari extension. There is no second browser to learn and nothing to copy or paste - open a page the way you normally would and your typeface, size and colors are already applied.
BUILT FOR EVERY READER
- Low vision and large print readers who need text bigger than a site allows
- Students reading long articles and research pages in the browser
- Older readers who would rather not zoom in on every single page
- Night readers who want a darker page and softer contrast
- Designers and developers checking how a page looks in another typeface
ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
FontFlex is one Safari extension for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Optional iCloud sync keeps your fonts, colors and profiles the same on all three, so a site you set up once reads the way you want everywhere.
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
• Weekly: $4.99 USD
• Yearly: $24.99 USD
Payment charged at confirmation. Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off 24 hours before period ends. Manage in iTunes Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://fontflex.sufiyanyasa.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fontflex.sufiyanyasa.com/privacy
FontFlex – Read better, browse better.

bluejetty:00121200:ios.summary:
Bring your rhythm to the screen. Drum Pad 8 puts a playable drum kit on your iPhone and iPad, with Pop, Rock and Jazz sounds and video practice that fits into your day.
WATCH, PLAY, REPEAT
Video mode now works on iPhone as well as iPad. Ch
bluejetty:00121200:ios.description:
Bring your rhythm to the screen. Drum Pad 8 puts a playable drum kit on your iPhone and iPad, with Pop, Rock and Jazz sounds and video practice that fits into your day.
WATCH, PLAY, REPEAT
Video mode now works on iPhone as well as iPad. Choose your own clips from Photos or Files, or open a compatible video website. Move to the part of a local video you want to practice.
MORE ROOM TO PLAY
Collapse the toolbar to play across the full screen, with the video behind your drum pads. While playing, touches go to the drums. Expand the toolbar to hide the pads and use the website. Set pad opacity from 10% to 100% to keep the video and kit as visible as you like.
FIND YOUR FEEL
Enjoy improvements for faster drum response and choose an audio latency setting that suits your device. Switch between Pop, Rock and Jazz, choose dynamic or loud response, and turn crash/bass-drum sync on or off. The app interface supports 12 languages, selectable in Options.
PLAY WITH YOUR MUSIC
Play along with streaming music from another app or supported local songs. Availability and playback controls depend on the source. Website video playback depends on the provider, content and connection; not every website or video is compatible. Demo videos shown in screenshots are not included.
DRUM PAD 8 PRO
A one-time in-app purchase removes ads and unlocks the AUv3 drum instrument for use in a compatible host.
For a more immediate playing feel, use the built-in speakers or wired audio. Bluetooth can add delay, and actual response depends on your device, audio route and other audio apps.
EXTERNAL MIDI INPUT — DP8 PRO
Play DP8 with a compatible USB or Bluetooth MIDI controller. Use the 16-pad layout, General MIDI, or learn your own note-to-drum mapping. MIDI velocity controls the strength of each hit. Bluetooth MIDI includes a device list and optional automatic reconnection to your remembered controller. External MIDI input is included in the existing one-time Pro in-app purchase; previous Pro purchasers can restore their purchase. A compatible controller and any required USB adapter are not included.

bluejetty:00121940:ios.description:
Play videos backwards and create amazing reverse videos on your iPhone or iPad. Download Reverse Video Editor for free now!
With Reverse Video Editor, you can make an existing video play backwards in just a few steps. Movements suddenly seem to defy gravity, objects put themselves back together, and everyday footage turns into eye-catching Reels, Shorts, Stories, or status videos.
You can select common video formats such as MP4 and MOV from your Photos library and turn them into a new reverse video.
How it works:
1. Download this app (Reverse Video Editor) for free from the App Store and open the app.
2. Select an existing video from your Photos library.
3. Preview the original and choose whether the audio should also play in reverse or the result should be saved without sound.
4. Let the app reverse the video and save it as a new reverse video in the Photos app.
5. Preview the finished result right in the app and share it.
Your original video remains unchanged.
Want to play a video backwards, make a clip run in reverse, or create a reverse-video effect on your iPhone or iPad? This app is made for exactly that—without complicated video-editing software.
Examples of creative reverse-video ideas that others have brought to life with this app:
- A jump into a pool that, when played in reverse, looks as if the person is flying up out of the water.
- A ball thrown onto the ground that appears to bounce back into a hand all by itself.
- A spilled drink that flows back into the glass.
- A torn sheet of paper that seemingly puts itself back together.
- Confetti that flies from the air back into a hand.
Countless other activities look surprising or funny when played backwards. They can become creative video effects, unusual transitions, and entertaining clips for friends, family, and social media.
The entire sequence of images plays backwards. If you enable audio, the soundtrack also plays in reverse. Alternatively, you can save the finished video without sound.
The saved video file contains no visible watermark or app logo. The original resolution is preserved losslessly: 1080p videos stay 1080p, and 4K videos stay 4K. The resolution is not reduced when the reverse video is created.
The video files you select are processed securely and locally on your device. To create the reverse video, the app does not upload them to the cloud or to an external server.
Using the iOS share sheet, you can send your finished reverse video through iMessage, WhatsApp, or other messaging apps, or share it on social media—for example on Instagram Reels, TikTok, Facebook, Snapchat, or YouTube Shorts, as well as in a Story or status update.
Whether it is a funny effect, a creative transition, a little magic video, or a surprising social-media clip, let your creativity run free and impress friends and family with original reverse videos.
Download Reverse Video Editor now!
Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00024519:ios.description:
Train your eyes in just 3 minutes a day, like playing a game.
This vision training and eye care app helps you build a daily habit using the popular “Gabor Patch” method.
Do you spend long hours looking at your smartphone or computer? 
Are you concerned about eye fatigue, difficulty focusing, declining vision, digital eye strain, or age-related near vision changes?
“Eye Recovery Training” is an app that makes it easy to continue visual training, focus training, and vision level checks using Gabor patch images.
You can start with a short session once a day, making it a simple way to support your daily eye care routine.
【Main Features】
■ Game-like Gabor Patch Training
Simply find and tap the Gabor patch that matches the image inside the square.
The rules are simple, so you can enjoy visual training while staying focused.
・Standard Mode: A 3-minute mode for daily training
・Short Mode: A 1-minute mode for quick sessions
・Hard Mode: A higher-difficulty mode for distinguishing similar patterns
■ Viewing Training
Look at Gabor patches displayed across the full screen.
Flowing patterns help you continue daily eye care without complicated steps.
■ Focus Training
Hold the screen about 30 cm away and keep focusing on changing patterns.
By looking at images that blur or change size, you can become more aware of your eye focusing ability.
■ Vision Level Check
Includes a simple check using Landolt rings.
Tap the direction of the opening and record your daily vision level to track changes over time.
■ History and Graphs
Record your correct answers, vision level, and training activity.
Graphs and history make it easy to review your progress and stay motivated.
■ Reminder Notifications
Set a reminder time and receive notifications so you do not forget your daily vision training or eye care.
■ Widget Support
Display Gabor patch images on your Home Screen.
■ Game Center Rankings
Compete with users around the world, or challenge your own past scores.
【Recommended For】
・People interested in vision training using Gabor patches
・People concerned about eye fatigue from smartphones or computers
・People who have started to notice declining vision, nearsightedness, digital eye strain, or age-related near vision changes
・People who want to practice eye focus training
・People who want to continue eye care in a fun, game-like way
・People who want to record daily vision levels and training results
・People looking for a short and simple eye training app
【Premium Features】
With Premium, you can use additional features designed for a more comfortable training experience, including ad removal, access to full history and graphs, Short Mode, Hard Mode, column changes, speed adjustment, and shuffle for full-screen Gabor patches.
【Important Notice】
This app is intended to support vision training and eye care, but it does not guarantee vision improvement or recovery.
If you have concerns about your eyes or vision, please consult a medical professional as needed.
Premium subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at a rate corresponding to the plan selected. You may also make a one-time payment outside of the subscription plan if needed.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the time of purchase confirmation.
Subscriptions will renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current term.
Your account will be billed for renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current term and the cost of renewal will be identified.
Subscriptions are user-controlled and auto-renewals can be turned off after purchase by accessing the user's account settings.

bluejetty:00117654:ios.description:
A new FINAL FANTASY that spans DIMENSIONS.
The latest title of the FINAL FANTASY DIMENSIONS series that has achieved three million downloads worldwide!
------------------------------------------------------------------------
A journey that links the past to the future!
◆◇Game Introduction◇◆
A fascinating cast of characters of different races and eras.
An incredible story that leads you through the past and future to save the world.
Combine your strengths to defeat powerful foes in intense battles.
FINAL FANTASY DIMENSIONS II is an RPG that brings a new legend to the world of FF.
▼A great adventure that transcends time and space
Our hero Morrow and heroine Aemo travel through the present, past, and future and gain allies along the way on their great quest to save the world.
▼Abilities and summon magic
Battle monsters with a simple and strategic active command system!
Select from abilities like magic, skills, and powerful summons to battle terrifying enemies and emerge victorious!
▼Crystals that house the power of the Eidolons
Equip and fight with crystals known as signet stones to acquire new abilities for your characters.
Many of these signet stones possess the powers of summoned beasts from throughout the history of the FF series!
◆◇Story◇◆
The eastern continent of Ajima and the western continent of Westa.
A great disaster caused by human error destroys the civilization of magic that prospered during the Ancient Era and divides the world into east and west, ushering in a long period of conflict between the two.
A young boy named Morrow who lives in Navos, a small island at the center of the world, loses himself listening to tales of Wrieg's travels, a Westan adventurer.
Morrow follows Wrieg after he senses something strange from an odd shooting star and meets a mysterious girl from the future named Aemo.
The world of Eidola exists outside the present, past, future, and beyond.
Say hello and farewell to friends of different eras in a story about a promise for a better future.

bluejetty:00168219:ios.name: FableAI: AI Story & Text RPG
bluejetty:00168219:ios.summary: FableAI is a text RPG where you play the hero and an AI narrator runs the story. Type what your character does or says, and the narrator writes what happens next. The narrator draws anime-style pictures of the scenes as you play, and if you
bluejetty:00168219:ios.description:
FableAI is a text RPG where you play the hero and an AI narrator runs the story. Type what your character does or says, and the narrator writes what happens next. The narrator draws anime-style pictures of the scenes as you play, and if you turn on dice rolls, risky moves get a d20 roll. Pick one of 5,000+ adventures or describe your own world in one sentence, then play alone or with up to 8 players in the same story.
HOW A TURN WORKS
• Choose DO or SAY and type your move. Talk your way past a guard, steal the captain's map, or ask the innkeeper why the town is empty.
• Want a nudge? Tap one of the suggested choices, or ignore them and write your own.
• Turn on dice rolls and the narrator rolls a d20 when a move could go either way. A failed roll is often where things get interesting.
• Not happy with a turn? Retry it, undo it, or tap Continue and let the narrator keep going.
WHAT A TURN LOOKS LIKE
You (DO): I slide the stolen key across the bar and ask the innkeeper who else has a copy.
Narrator: She doesn't pick it up. "Three people had one," she says. "Two of them went missing. The third just sat down behind you."
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Up to 8 players can share one story. Everyone plays their own character, and the narrator works each move into the same scene, so a heist or a rescue goes differently with every group. Run a one-shot on a Friday night or keep a campaign going for weeks.
5,000+ ADVENTURES, OR YOUR OWN WORLD
Fantasy kingdoms, space stations, haunted houses, isekai worlds, heists, detective cases and everyday life. Play adventures other players have built, or type one sentence, like "a kingdom of floating castles guarded by an old dragon", and start playing it right away.
BE ANYONE
Play a knight, a smuggler, a starship pilot, a detective on a night train, or yourself. Nothing is scripted: you decide what your character says and does, and the story goes from there.
MEMORY YOU CAN SEE AND EDIT
Story Cards and Memory Fragments hold the names, places and events the narrator should keep in mind. You can see, edit and delete them, so you decide what it remembers. Some memory features need a paid plan.
FOR TEXT ADVENTURE AND TABLETOP FANS
If you grew up on text adventures and gamebooks, or you run tabletop campaigns, FableAI will feel familiar, with an AI as your game master. Play a short solo adventure on the bus, or a long fantasy campaign with your group.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Each turn uses gems. You get free gems every day and can earn more by watching ads; gem packs and optional subscriptions are available as in-app purchases.
• Pictures don't use gems.
• Safe mode is on by default.
• Questions or feedback: support@fableai.app
Terms and conditions & Privacy policy: https://fableai.app/terms

bluejetty:00174641:ios.description:
The app used by renowned musicians like Fred again.., Richard Devine, Apparat, Weval or Matmos live and in the studio. Samplr introduced a brand new way to make music, only possible on multitouch devices. Samplr is the ideal tool for audio experimentation, music composition and live performance.
USER REVIEWS
“The most profound audio manipulation tool on iOS” 5 stars
“There is NOTHING on the market hardware or software like this” 5 stars
“Stunningly beautiful interface and exceptionally easy to use” 5 stars
“This is the most musical app I've ever used. It's polished, it's musical, it's fun, it's inspiring” 5 stars
