bluejetty:00018481:ios.description:
GIỚI THIỆU TÍNH NĂNG MỚI TRÊN ỨNG DỤNG VNPAY MERCHANT
Nhằm nâng cao chất lượng sản phẩm dịch vụ cũng như tạo sự thuận tiện trong việc quản lý của Quý Đối tác, Công ty Cổ phần Giải pháp Thanh toán Việt Nam (VNPAY) xin trân trọng thông báo: Kể từ ngày 05/04/2023, ứng dụng VNPAY Merchant sẽ có thêm các tiện ích nổi bật bao gồm:
 1. Quản lý công nợ:
Quý Đối tác có thể xem thông tin, quản lý và sử dụng công nợ (là số tiền VNPAY có nghĩa vụ thanh toán cho Quý Đối tác và các ưu đãi/khuyến mại mà Quý Đối tác được hưởng). Các quyền bao gồm:
1.1 Cấp, thay đổi quyền sử dụng liên quan đến công nợ của (các) tài khoản đăng nhập và Công cụ quản lý giao dịch khác
1.2 Quản lý, sử dụng công nợ: 
Rút tiền thanh toán VNPAY-QR, VNPAY POS về tài khoản Ví VNPAY, tài khoản Ngân hàng trong ngày T0 
Sử dụng số dư công nợ để mua dịch vụ tiện ích trên ứng dụng VNPAY Merchant
Các quyền khác liên quan đến công nợ được VNPAY cung cấp trên Công cụ quản lý giao dịch trong từng thời kỳ.
2. Dịch vụ Tiện ích:
Là dịch vụ cho phép Quý Đối tác dùng chính số dư khả dụng tại ứng dụng để mua và thanh toán dịch vụ cho chính mình hoặc cho khách hàng khác với nhiều ưu đãi hấp dẫn.
Các dịch vụ tiện ích bao gồm:
2.1 Thanh toán hoá đơn dịch vụ tiện ích sinh hoạt: điện, nước, truyền hình cáp, internet,...
Mua thẻ điện thoại, nạp tiền trực tiếp vào tài khoản điện thoại
Mua, thanh toán các giao dịch/dịch vụ khác, như: vé máy bay, vé xe, vé tàu, vé sử dụng dịch vụ các khu vui chơi giải trí v.v.
Đặt phòng khách sạn
Gọi và thanh toán tiền taxi
Đặt hoa
Và nhiều dịch vụ hấp dẫn khác
3. Chương trình Điểm thưởng VNPAY:
Điểm thưởng VNPAY là chương trình khách hàng thân thiết dành để tri ân các đối tác đang sử dụng giải pháp thanh toán của VNPAY. 
Theo đó, các đối tác tham gia chương trình sẽ được tích điểm thưởng để đổi thành những phần quà thiết thực và hấp dẫn trên ứng dụng VNPAY Merchant.
Chi tiết về chương trình Khách hàng thân thiết: Quý Đối tác vui lòng xem trực tiếp trên ứng dụng
4. Cách thức đăng ký
Quý Đối tác đã cài đặt ứng dụng trước đó sẽ được tự động được cập nhật phiên bản mới. Với khách hàng mới của VNPAY, Quý Đối tác có thể tải ứng dụng VNPAY Merchant tại chợ ứng dụng. 
Nếu cần cung cấp thêm thông tin, Quý Đối tác vui lòng liên hệ với đầu mối Chăm sóc Khách hàng của VNPAY để được hướng dẫn chi tiết:
Hotline: *3388
Email: hotro@vnpay.vn
Zalo: zalo.me/4134983655549474109
5. Lưu ý:
Đối tác đăng ký thành công sẽ nhận được thông báo chính thức qua email và vui lòng hoàn thiện hồ sơ theo hướng dẫn.
Xin chân thành cảm ơn

bluejetty:00095162:ios.summary:

You already know the shot is the listin
bluejetty:00095162:ios.description:
An empty listing photo is a closed door. Virtual Staging fills the room with furniture, light, and style in under a minute — so buyers stop scrolling past and start picturing themselves living there.
You already know the shot is the listing. A bare room with a wide-angle lens reads as cold, small, and unfinished, and the inquiries you should be getting go to the agent down the street whose photos look lived-in. Hiring a stager runs $2,000–$5,000 and weeks of scheduling for a single property. Pulling furniture from a stock site looks fake the moment a buyer zooms in.
Virtual Staging takes that whole problem off your plate. Snap the empty room, pick a style, and get a photorealistic staged image you can drop straight into the MLS, a brochure, or a social post.
POINT, PICK, POST
- Photograph any empty (or cluttered) room from your phone or camera roll
- Choose from 25 room types — living room, primary bedroom, kitchen, home office, sunroom, even garages and walk-in closets
- Pick a design style from 22 options: modern, Scandinavian, farmhouse, mid-century, industrial, boho, traditional, Mediterranean, Art Deco, and more
- Get a finished, high-resolution staged image in under a minute
DIAL IN THE LOOK
- 10 color palettes from neutral and warm to bold, jewel tones, and coastal blues
- Furniture density from "barely there" to fully styled
- Lighting modes for natural daylight, warm, cool, or studio-neutral light
- Decor add-ons: rugs, plants, wall art, throw pillows, books, candles, mirrors, curtains
- Free-text custom requests when you want something specific ("add a reading nook by the window")
BUILT FOR HOW LISTINGS ACTUALLY GET MARKETED
- Side-by-side before/after slider for instant social and email content
- Every staged image saved to your in-app gallery with the settings you used
- Keeps working in the background — start a stage, lock your phone, come back to a finished image
- Export full-resolution photos straight to Photos, Messages, or your MLS uploader
PERFECT FOR
- Listing agents who need same-day marketing on a vacant property
- Sellers prepping a home that's already been moved out of
- Builders and developers marketing pre-construction or new builds
- Short-term rental hosts testing how a room could be redesigned
- Interior designers showing clients three directions in an afternoon
PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU STAGE
No subscription. No recurring charges. Buy a credit pack once, use the credits whenever a listing comes in, and they never expire. Your first staging is free — try it on a real photo before you spend anything.
Stop apologizing for empty rooms in your listing photos. Stage them in a minute and get back to selling.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00062622:ios.description:

Quiz ministeriali ufficiali 2026: simulazione d’esame con 30 domande in 20 minuti

Font EasyReading, attivabile dalle impostazioni, per una lettura più scorrevole (utile anche per utenti con DSA)
E in più: puoi essere associato all’autoscuola più vicina e farti seguire passo passo nel tuo percorso verso l’esame.
Scarica ora Quiz Patente Ufficiale 2026 e inizia subito ad allenarti con i quiz ministeriali ufficiali.

Access and manage your Dupaco accounts anytime, anywhere with Shine Mobile Banking!
Whether you’re on-the-go or right at home, Shine Mobile helps you keep tabs on your spending, view transactions, transfer funds, pay bills and more — all from your phone or tablet.
Improve your financial well-being
• Find and cancel unnecessary and forgotten subscriptions.
• Get personalized money insights and recommendations.
• Keep tabs on your cash flow, spending trends, and more.
• Create custom savings plans and goals.
• Set and manage budgets.
• Track, monitor and boost your credit score.

• Transfer money between your accounts, from another financial institution or to another Dupaco member.
• Schedule and edit Automatic Transfers.
• Easily search for past transactions by key word or date.
• Take the hassle out of paying bills with Bill Pay.

Help is here
• Find your nearest Dupaco Branch & ATM.
• Have questions? Need help? Send us a secure message from Shine.

bluejetty:00074519:android.description:
Educational games for toddlers are the best way to engage young minds. Let your child learn the alphabet in a fun way with master Pocoyo through different mini learning games for kids.
This ABC app is an interactive alphabet with which the child will learn the different vocabulary while playing. Preschool learning games prepare your child for school with alphabet learning activities that include letter tracing and reading games for kids which will allow children learn the vocabulary in a funny way such as an academy. 
Pocoyo Alphabet ABC, will help to understand and learn the letters and sounds of the phonetic alphabet. The game will allow through effective methods based on learning games, to learn the letters and improve reading and writing with a very attractive and intuitive interface even for young children.
Our preschool and kindergarten learning games feature:
✏️ Fun uppercase and lowercase letter tracing games. Tracing a dotted line, children can draw letters with their fingers, in both uppercase and lowercase, thereby getting started in writing and improving their psychomotor skills.
🐨 Discover animal and fruit names with different letters. Learning while playing and in a visual way is one of the best learning methods for children who are beginning to learn to read, while listening to the phonetics of the different letters and words, associating the sounds to the vocabulary. The child will also discover what words referring to objects and animals begin with the letter selected.
🍏 Interacting with the images. With this mini-game, children will interact with different animations and scenarios with the objective of discovering the hidden word and associating it to the different letters of the alphabet.
Pocoyo Alphabet ABC will allow children:
• Learn and study the alphabet
• Draw the letters, in uppercase and lowercase
• Get started in reading and writing in their education
• Learn words related to a given letter
• Improve spelling
• Letter recognition
• Read and hear letters and words, in English and Spanish phonics
• Develop fine motor and graphomotor skills.
Pocoyo Alphabet ABC contains audios and texts in English and Spanish, so it is also a good tool for learning these languages.
The application features parental controls in order to ensure a safe gaming and learning environment.

bluejetty:00182877:ios.summary:
Hearts Gold is remastered! The classic card game of dodging points, rebuilt with new card rendering, new sound effects and layouts made for every iPhone and iPad. Play against the computer or online against other players.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE I
bluejetty:00182877:ios.description:
Hearts Gold is remastered! The classic card game of dodging points, rebuilt with new card rendering, new sound effects and layouts made for every iPhone and iPad. Play against the computer or online against other players.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Play online against other players, or against computer opponents that never cheat
• Six difficulty levels, from Novice to Legendary
• Normal, Spot hearts, Black Marie and Black Marie (US) rules, solo or in teams
• House rules to play it your way: starting player, a safe first trick, breaking hearts, passing direction, the moon and the sun, card values from the queen of spades to the jack of diamonds, and play to a score or for a number of hands
• Achievements and leaderboards
HOW TO PLAY
Pass three cards, then stay clear of the hearts and the queen of spades. Every heart costs a point and the queen costs 13, and when someone hits 100 the lowest score wins. Feeling brave? Take every heart and the queen to shoot the moon, or every trick to shoot the sun for double.
REMASTERED
• New card rendering, with smoother dealing and card animations
• New sound effects for shuffling, dealing and playing cards
• Redesigned player HUD, score screen and achievement popups
• Layouts rebuilt for phones and tablets
• Cards play when you lift your finger, so you can slide away to change your mind
• Shoot the moon scoring improved
The full version shows no ads. After reinstalling, restore it from Extras > Store > Restore on the main menu.

bluejetty:00166025:ios.description:
The Tamarkoz app provides practices to reduce stress, relax, improve focus, sleep better, and gain a more positive perspective on life.
The Tamarkoz® method is the art of self-knowledge through concentration and meditation, a holistic, practical way to recover and maintain health, happiness, fulfillment, well-being, and discipline in life. This powerful process is unique to M.T.O. Shahmaghsoudi and dates back 1400-years.
The Tamarkoz method is your guide to meditation and relaxation. Enjoy guided breathing as you reduce stress, relax, and more! Access a variety of guided meditation videos. Movazeneh activates, harmonizes, and balances the flow of energy through the body's major electromagnetic centers. Track your progress and mood with the “My Journey” feature to document your path to harmony.
Tamarkoz practice has five key techniques: 
- Mind Relaxation: slow brain waves, halt thoughts, diminish emotional reactions, and prepare mentally and physically for concentration
- Movazeneh: unique to Tamarkoz, created by M.T.O. Sufi Masters, this practice includes specific postures and slow-motion movement exercises that activate and balance the flow of energy of the 13 major electromagnetic centers of the body - a practice distinctive to M.T.O. Shahmaghsoudi.
- Breathing Exercises: Increase respiratory capacity and control the rhythm and duration of breathing for maximal oxygenation, regulation of vital processes, and reducing reactivity
- Deep Relaxation: learn muscular control and means of relieving tension and reducing stress, allowing the body to recuperate and revitalize
- Imagery & Heart Tamarkoz: replace critical, negative thought patterns with positive, healing images which encourage hope, vitality, motivation, and creativity
Download the Tamarkoz app and start watching guided meditation videos today!
TAMARKOZ PRACTICE FEATURES:
Guided Meditation Videos:
- Watch insightful meditation videos to help you create a more positive outlook on life
- Meditation and relaxation videos geared to help you in a holistic way
- Guided mind exercises lead you through the techniques to becoming harmonized
Five Techniques:
- Mind Relaxation: clear your mind for focused concentration
- Movazeneh: practice postures and exercises to balance energy
- Breathing Exercises: control breathing, calm, and regulate vital processes
- Deep Relaxation: learn muscle control, relieve tension, reduce stress, and heal your body
- Imagery & Heart Tamarkoz: change your negative thoughts to positive healing images
My Journey:
- Track your journey through the Tamarkoz techniques
- Detail your mood patterns and show your journey
- Track exercises you have done and how your mood may change over time
- Become more balanced, calm, collected, and harmonized
Guided meditation and the Tamarkoz way are waiting for you - download now!
Subscription pricing and terms:
1. M.T.O. Tamarkoz® App
2. We offer In-App Purchases within the Tamarkoz App with the selection of Monthly and yearly subscriptions.
3. Tamarkoz App offers a Premium auto-renewing monthly subscription at $5.99/month and yearly at $39.99 to provide unlimited access with an active subscription. 
4. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
5. The subscriptions are automatically renewed unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
6. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The renewal cost is as noted in number 3 above.
7. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s own Account Settings after purchase.
Terms and Conditions:
Terms of service: https://tamarkozapp.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://tamarkozapp.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00183704:ios.description:
Pioneer Appalachia FCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Pioneer Appalachia FCU:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Pioneer Appalachia FCU app, you must be enrolled as a Pioneer Appalachia FCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00040941:ios.description:
bondit turns AI character chat into interactive storytelling.
Talk with fictional AI characters, step into original scenarios, and shape what happens through your own words and choices. The same story can unfold in completely different ways depending on what you say, who you trust, and how you respond.
Explore romance, friendship, campus drama, mystery, and unexpected situations, or start with an idea of your own.
■ FEATURES 
Chat Beyond the Script 
Talk naturally with AI characters that respond to what you say, not just preset dialogue. 
Change the Story With Every Reply 
Your words can shift relationships, reveal new sides of characters, and take the story somewhere unexpected. 
Play Original Stories Your Way 
Jump into romance, friendship, campus drama, mystery, and more. Same starting point, completely different conversations. 
Create Your Own Story 
Start with your own idea, build a scenario, and see where the conversation takes you. 
■ RECOMMENDED FOR 
bondit is made for people who enjoy: 
● Love romance, friendship, campus drama, mystery, and character-driven stories 
● Get hooked on “what if” moments, unexpected tension, and alternate outcomes 
● Prefer saying what they want instead of following a fixed script 
● Like seeing how one conversation can change a relationship 
● Enjoy shaping scenarios and stories of their own 
● Want to be part of the story, not just watch it unfold 
■ PRIVACY & SECURITY 
"bondit uses AI-generated responses, which may vary based on the conversation and context.
For information about how bondit collects, uses, stores, and shares data, including data processed to provide AI features, please review our Privacy Policy." 
SUPPORT INFORMATION 
● Support URL: https://bondit.io 
● Customer Service Email: bondit.contact@gmail.com

bluejetty:00180196:ios.description:
SQB MOBILE — Ваш мобильный банк в одном приложении!

Основные функции приложения:
Открытие онлайн-вкладов!
Оформляйте выгодные вклады прямо через приложение. Выбирайте условия, контролируйте процентные начисления и срок вклада без визита в банк.
Управление средствами на карте
Просматривайте баланс и операции по вашим пластиковым картам в реальном времени.
Контролируйте свои расходы, анализируя траты по категориям.
Блокировка карт при необходимости.
В случае потери карты или подозрительных операций вы сможете быстро и безопасно заблокировать карту через приложение.
Переводы между картами
Переводите деньги на любые карты легко и быстро. Достаточно нескольких кликов для мгновенных переводов между вашими картами и картами других пользователей.
Оформление кредитов
Получайте кредитные предложения, соответствующие вашим нуждам, и подавайте заявку на кредит прямо через приложение.
Оплата коммунальных платежей
Оплачивайте счета за коммунальные услуги прямо через SQB MOBILE. Все платежи фиксируются и отображаются в истории операций, что удобно для ведения учета.
Конвертация валюты
Конвертируйте валюту в реальном времени по актуальному курсу. Быстрая и безопасная покупка и продажа валюты без необходимости посещения банка.
Преимущества использования SQB MOBILE:
Удобство — все банковские услуги в вашем кармане, доступные 24/7.
Безопасность — защита ваших данных с помощью современных методов шифрования.
Экономия времени — большинство операций можно выполнить без визита в отделение банка.
Интуитивно понятный интерфейс — легко разобраться и начать пользоваться приложением с первых минут.
С SQB MOBILE управление финансами становится простым и доступным каждому!

 • Daily mode with new islands and missions every day
 • 240 birds to unlock
 • Night mode: play the game at night 
• upgrade your nest by fulfilling tasks
• iPad only: Split screen multiplayer!
• Supports Game Center with 30 tricky achievements
• Supports iCloud syncronization

bluejetty:00045319:ios.name: Indiana IN BMV Permit Test
bluejetty:00045319:ios.summary: Are you applying for the Indiana DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the stat
bluejetty:00045319:ios.description:
Are you applying for the Indiana DMV permit driver’s license test certification? Use this application to study for, improve your score on, and ultimately pass both the CDL driver's license test and the DMV driver's license test for the state of Indiana in order to obtain your permit on the very first attempt. 
This app contains quizzes that are derived from the official Indiana Department of Motor Vehicles state manual. This application will help you in preparing for and practicing for the Car, Motorcycle, and Commercial Driver's License (CDL) tests required by the state of Indiana. All of the practice tests included in this application are based on the most recent editions of the applicable manuals. Therefore, if you are looking for preparation for the DMV driver's license test, this is the ideal DMV driver's license test practice app for you. This application is a handbook manual that may be used to practice and prepare for the Commercial Driver's License (CDL) as well as the DMV Knowledge Test Permit. 
It is developed with the learning requirements of a user who is applying for a driving license and the requirements of the driver's license test, as well as the most effective learning strategies discovered by researchers. The process of studying for the permit test is made to be more engaging and enjoyable as a result. When utilising this application, users report that it is quite simple to provide accurate responses to the questions that appear on the actual DMV permit driver's license test. 
Following is a brief overview of the features provided by the app.
- Practice tests designed especially for you.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- You can keep track of your progress and check the history of each practice test. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Sample tests for obtaining a driver's license for a motorcycle, a car, and a commercial driver's license (CDL). 
- A very extensive bank of sample questions that covers all areas of the written examination for the driver's license. 
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Following test categories are covered in this app : 
- General Knowledge Test
- Hazardous Materials Test
- School Bus Test
- Passenger Vehicle Test
- Air Brakes Test
- Comb. Vehicles Test
- D/T Trailers test
- Tanker Vehicles Test
- Pre-trip Insp. Test

bluejetty:00047723:ios.name: 見積もり・請求書作成 Estilynx｜かんたん書類作成
bluejetty:00047723:ios.summary:
Estilynx（エスティリンクス）は、iPhone・iPadで見積もりや請求書などのビジネス書類を、いつでもかんたんに作成できる買い切り型の書類作成アプリです。
オフィスだけでなく、外出先や営業先、現場などのスキマ時間にも対応。パソコンを使わず、スマートフォンやタブレットから素早く書類を作成できます。
月額料金やアップデート費用は不要。インターネット接続がない環境でも利用でき、個人事業主、フリーランス、営業担当者など、日々の業務で書類を作成する方におすすめです。
◆
bluejetty:00047723:ios.description:
Estilynx（エスティリンクス）は、iPhone・iPadで見積もりや請求書などのビジネス書類を、いつでもかんたんに作成できる買い切り型の書類作成アプリです。
オフィスだけでなく、外出先や営業先、現場などのスキマ時間にも対応。パソコンを使わず、スマートフォンやタブレットから素早く書類を作成できます。
月額料金やアップデート費用は不要。インターネット接続がない環境でも利用でき、個人事業主、フリーランス、営業担当者など、日々の業務で書類を作成する方におすすめです。
◆ 見積もりをすばやく作成
営業先や訪問先で急に見積もりを依頼された場合でも、登録済みの取引先や商品を呼び出してスムーズに入力できます。
入力項目にはテンプレートやカレンダーからの入力を利用できるため、入力の手間を減らし、誤字脱字の防止にも役立ちます。
作成した書類は保存しておけるため、過去のデータを複写して新しい書類を作成することも可能です。
例えば、
見積もり → FAX送付状 → 納品書 → 請求書 → 領収書
というように、一度作成した書類をもとに関連する書類を効率よく作成できます。
◆ 260種類以上の帳票に対応
見積もり、納品書、請求書をはじめ、発注書、注文書、見積依頼書、経費精算書、領収書、FAX送付状、書類送付状など、260種類以上の帳票を利用できます。
90種類の帳票は、一部を除き4色のデザインに対応しています。
◆ 過去の書類もすぐに検索
作成した書類は、件名、取引先名、書類番号、メモ欄から検索できます。
以前作成した見積もりや請求書を確認したいときにも、必要な書類をすばやく見つけられます。
◆ PDF出力・印刷・送付にも対応
作成した書類はPDFファイルとして出力できます。
メールでの送信、コンビニでの印刷、Dropboxなどのクラウドサービスを利用したデータ共有にも対応しています。
さらに、送付状の作成や封筒の宛名印刷にも対応。書類作成から郵送までの業務をまとめて効率化できます。
◆ 印影画像にも対応
担当者印、決裁者印、社印などの印影画像を登録し、作成した書類に配置できます。
◆ iPhone・iPadで快適に入力
ソフトウェアキーボードだけでなく、外付けキーボードにも対応。
iPhoneでもiPadでも、外出先や移動中、ちょっとした空き時間に書類作成を進められます。
◆ 複数の税率に対応
書類単位での消費税設定に加え、明細行ごとに税率を設定できます。
軽減税率など、複数の税率が混在する書類にも対応しています。
◆ iCloud・Dropboxにバックアップ
iCloud、Dropboxへのバックアップに対応。
端末の故障や買い替え、新しいiPhone・iPadへの移行時にも、作成した書類やデータを安心して管理できます。
◆ 買い切り型だから月額料金不要
Estilynxは買い切り型のアプリです。
月額使用料やアップデート費用はかかりません。日々の業務で必要な書類作成機能を、継続的に利用できます。
◆ このような方におすすめ
・個人事業主、フリーランスの方
・外出先や現場で書類を作成したい方
・営業先で急ぎの見積もりに対応したい方
・移動中やスキマ時間を有効活用したい方
・パソコンを使わずiPhoneやiPadで書類を作成したい方
・手書きで書類を作成する手間を減らしたい方
・見積もりから請求までの業務を効率化したい方
・インターネット接続がない環境でも利用したい方
・月額料金のかかるサービスを使いたくない方
◆ 利用できる主な帳票
・見積書（汎用・工事用・英語表記など）
・請求書 / 合計請求書 / 納品請求書
・納品書 / 発注書 / 注文書 / 発注請書 / 注文請書
・見積依頼書 / 経費精算書
・領収書 / FAX送付状 / 書類送付状
・封筒印刷（長型3号）
※ 一部の帳票を除き、各4色を利用できます。
Estilynxで、見積もりから請求、納品、領収まで、日々の書類作成業務をもっとかんたんに、もっと効率的に。
◆ 不具合・ご要望について
不具合をご報告いただく際は、端末の型番、OSのバージョン、発生手順など、公開できる範囲で具体的な情報をお知らせください。
ご要望については、業種や利用目的などをあわせてお知らせいただけると、今後の改善に役立ちます。

Are you an AmeriHealth Caritas member? Are you interested in finding out more about the health plans?
Whether you are a plan member or not, this mobile application provides quick and easy ways to help you manage your health care. For membe
bluejetty:00044435:ios.description:
Are you an AmeriHealth Caritas member? Are you interested in finding out more about the health plans?
Whether you are a plan member or not, this mobile application provides quick and easy ways to help you manage your health care. For members, it puts your AmeriHealth Caritas health plan information at your fingertips, with features that include quick access to your member ID card and provider information. It’s also a useful tool to help make every provider visit valuable. Manage your health, wherever you are.
FEATURES
The AHC mobile app makes every provider visit easier for AmeriHealth Caritas members:
• ID card — Get access to an electronic copy of your member ID card.
• Medicine cabinet — Keep track of your medicines, how to use them, your prescription history, and medication reminders. You can also learn how medicines interact with each other and view medicine warning labels.
• Find a doctor or hospital — Use a quick search tool to help you look for any network provider, hospital, pharmacy, specialist, or urgent care center nearby. You can also get directions to a provider’s office or call for an appointment.
• My Doctors — Get access to your primary care provider (PCP) and your other health care providers.
• Care and program reminders — Get alerts through the app when you are missing a checkup or test.
• Health history — Review up to six months of care team visits and hospital stays.
• Resources — See an overview of the digital and community resources available to you.
• Contact Us — Access a list of important phone numbers for the health plan. 
• Available in English and Spanish.

This app requires the user to buy an in-app subscription on an annual basis.
This subscription enables use of the D1 Baseball app which provides up-to-date scores, standings, and schedules for Division I College Ba
bluejetty:00078930:ios.description:
D1 Baseball Full Season
This app requires the user to buy an in-app subscription on an annual basis.
This subscription enables use of the D1 Baseball app which provides up-to-date scores, standings, and schedules for Division I College Baseball. Once subscribed, you will be able to view information about your favorite Division I College Baseball teams. While viewing team standings, by conference, you can select teams as favorites. Games for your favorite teams will show up first in the scores view. You can also receive alerts, in the form of push notifications, for selected teams.
The subscription lasts for the entire college baseball season, including playoffs through the Division I College World Series. The subscription will remain active until right before the next season begins. An active subscription enables all features of the app.
The price of the annual subscription is $7.99 US. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
To set team preferences, simply tap on a team that's listed in the Standings view. From there you can set a team as a Favorite (gets displayed first in the Scores view) or Notify (gets push notifications sent to you for this team).
For our Terms of Service please visit D1 Baseball.com at https://d1baseball.com/terms-service/
For our Privacy Policy please visit D1 Baseball.com at https://d1baseball.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00068670:ios.summary:
Trouble getting out of bed in the morning? You'll never snooze or oversleep with the Instant Wake Up alarm clock. Develop healthy sleeping habits and a great morning routine. Never fall back asleep again!
GET UP *ON TIME, EVERY TIME*
* Cre
bluejetty:00068670:ios.description:
Trouble getting out of bed in the morning? You'll never snooze or oversleep with the Instant Wake Up alarm clock. Develop healthy sleeping habits and a great morning routine. Never fall back asleep again!
GET UP *ON TIME, EVERY TIME*
* Create sets of wake-up missions to turn off the alarm
* Wake up to ringtones, your favorite music, or both
* Loud ringtones or any text read aloud to you
* Procedural Ringtones¹ to counter auditory adaptation
* Bedtime Reminder helps you prevent sleep deprivation proactively
WAKE-UP WITH A MISSION
Completing wake-up missions shuts off the alarm and leaves you fully awake and alert. They stimulate the higher functions of your brain and they're fun too!
* Solve multiple-choice math puzzles
* Play a memory game
* Shake your phone
* Run to the bathroom to scan the barcode of your toothpaste.
PROTECT YOURSELF FROM YOURSELF
* Preset the alarm volume and make it impossible to mute
* Lock the alarms to prevent yourself from cheating
* Randomize your missions and playlists so your brain won't get used to it
* Use Procedural Ringtones¹ to never sleep through any alarm again
* Sharing a room? The “Don't Wake my Spouse” button will help!
TOTALLY CUSTOMIZABLE
* Choose the clock display, color theme, and even the app icon
* Dark Mode to help you power down at night, but options for pleasantly bright alarms
* Morning Routine lets you set tasks to start your day the right way
WARNING: SLEEP IS NECESSARY
Staying in control of your sleep routine is key to waking up feeling rested and healthy. Sleep deprivation can be dangerous to your health and the health of others. You should always focus on getting enough sleep first. That's why the Instant Wake Up alarm clock also includes Bedtime Reminders and Enforcers.
ARE YOU CRUSHING YOUR SLEEP?
Let us know how you're enjoying the Instant Wake Up alarm clock, or give us your suggestions: support@instantwakeup.com
-----
¹ Procedural Ringtones require iOS 13 or later

bluejetty:00120304:ios.description:
*** Named “Most Innovative iPad App of the Year” by Apple App Store ***
LiquidText offers a fast, natural way to review, gather, and organize information across all your documents and webpages—then apply the results to writing reports, meeting prep, or simply studying. Pull out key facts and connect them together, squeeze a document to compare sections, draw a line to connect ideas in different documents, comment on multiple pages at once, build upon your thoughts, and much more.
► WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING:
* "If you want to experience the power of going beyond paper, you can download LiquidText" – Cult of Mac
* One of Macworld’s Top 24 Apps for iPad Pro
* One of Time Magazine's Ten Best apps for iPad Pro *
* "There's a better way to organize your research, and the app is it." – iMore, Serenity Caldwell
* “All you need for deep research projects.” – Macworld, Jackie Dove
* "The world changed with...LiquidText" – Law360, Paul Kiesel
* "LiquidText may just be *the* app for reviewing and annotating PDFs using Apple's tablet and stylus." – CIO Magazine, James Martin
* “One of the most powerful, original iPad apps I've tried in years” – Federico Viticci, MacStories.net
► LIQUIDTEXT’S COMPLETE FEATURE SET INCLUDES:
(Features with * require a paid upgrade.)
Import
• Create a workspace and import all the documents and web pages you need
• Compatible with PDF, Word, and PowerPoint document types
• Import from Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Box, email, and more
• Import content from webpage or send to LiquidText directly from Safari
• Instant OCR to select text in scanned documents; do a full document-OCR to search as well!*
• Import documents & metadata directly from reference managers (supports Zotero and Mendeley)*
Interact
• Pull excerpts from all the documents in your project into the Workspace area
• Add your own notes (typed or written) to the Workspace area
• Freely draw on your notes, or on the workspace itself*
• Organize excerpts and notes into groups
• Connect anything - draw live “ink links” that span pages, documents, notes, and more*
• Create mind-maps by drawing “ink links” connecting your excerpts/notes to one another *
• Get context - tap notes and excerpts to find original source
Compare
• Pinch a document to compare different distant pages side by side
• Collapse text to see annotated parts side-by-side
• Collapse text to view search results(s) side-by-side
• Import unlimited number of documents into a project, view up to 3 at once*
Annotate
• Freely draw* or highlight on your document, notes, or the workspace itself
• Add margin notes/comments to text, images, notes, and excerpts
• Comment on two or more selections simultaneously
• Replace document with a newer version (and annotations are brought to new doc)*
Search
• Search for keywords across all your LiquidText documents
• Find keywords in title or text of your documents*
• Bulk highlight, tag, or link to your search results*
Realtime Collaboration
• Invite colleagues into your shared projects and work together in near realtime*
• Leave comments and notifications for your collaborators*
• Privacy controls: set whether each workspace & document in your project is shared or private*
Easy Export
• Export your project as a PDF (includes your Workspace and documents)
• Export your project as a Word file (converts your notes/excerpts into a linear document) 
• Send a full LiquidText file for those with the app.
• Send files by email or to Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Zotero, and more*
Sync & Backup*
• Real-time, cross-platform sync
• Continuous cloud backup
• Multi-device display: 
• Use your desktop or tablet as additional display for your other device
• Use your tablet for freehand inking while viewing and keyboarding on your desktop
See our terms of use at https://www.liquidtext.net/terms-of-use 
Learn more at LiquidText.net | Better Than Paper

bluejetty:00128625:ios.summary: AJournal is the all-in-one digital planner built around handwriting and your calendar. Use Apple Pencil to plan, journal, and reflect on pages where events from any connected calendar appear right alongside your notes. Choose from 100+ full
bluejetty:00128625:ios.description:
AJournal is the all-in-one digital planner built around handwriting and your calendar. Use Apple Pencil to plan, journal, and reflect on pages where events from any connected calendar appear right alongside your notes. Choose from 100+ fully customizable templates or design your own to fit exactly how you think.
Combine the mindfulness of handwriting with powerful organization tools — plan days, weeks, and months, set goals, and track habits, projects, and progress, all in one place.
SUPPORTS HANDWRITING, TEXT & IMAGES
- Write/draw with Apple Pencil or finger
- Text input with Scribble or keyboard, with complete formatting support like fonts, colors, etc
- Save links to a website or another planner page
- Add images and resize, rotate, or object crop
- Choose among over 2500 stickers to make your journal/planner fun and personal
- Save your own images as stickers for easier access
DIGITAL CALENDARS
- Connect any digital calendar so all events will show up in daily/weekly planners
- Write/Scribble/Type alongside the events from the digital calendars
REMINDERS
- Apple Reminders are integrated into daily planners
STAY ORGANIZED
- Navigate effortlessly through journals/planners by dates, weeks, months, and projects
- Search function for inputted texts makes it easier to find a journal/planner
OVER 100 TEMPLATES TO CHOOSE FROM & FULL CUSTOMIZATION
- Over 100 templates with minimalist design and cover every need: daily/weekly/monthly planners, project planners, finance planners, meal/fitness/habit trackers, ATracker, etc
- The templates are fully customizable, simply add/remove/rearrange/configure elements and set colors/headers
- Personalize a page with your writing/drawing and save it as a template
Aesthetic Backgrounds & Color Themes
- Choose from over 100 backgrounds with different textures, styles, and seasonal themes.
- Select from various tints and foregrounds.
INTEGRATION WITH ATRACKER (OPTIONAL)
- With over 2 million downloads, ATracker is a time tracking tool trusted by users worldwide. 
- Combined with task/goal tracking in ATracker, you can follow up on your progress in AJournal in real time.
EXPORT & BACKUP
- Export your journals/planner as PDFs to read in other tools or for keepsake
- Create backups to keep your data safe 
SPLIT VIEW & SLIDE OVER
ICLOUD SYNC
- You can now use AJournal on your iPhone
- AJournal data can be synced via iCloud (Active subscription needed)
SUBSCRIPTION
AJournal supports unlimited pages per day/week/month/year and projects with a subscription. This add-on is optional.
• AJournal subscriptions purchased in-app renew monthly or yearly, depending on your plan. Plan pricing may vary by country.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Users can try out AJournal without any limitation with a 7-day free trial.
SUPPORT
Visit http://Ajournal.pro or contact us at support@Ajournal.pro.
Terms of Service: http://Ajournal.pro/TOS.html
Privacy Policy: http://Ajournal.pro/policy.html
AJournal - Organize your thoughts, keep track of your goals

bluejetty:00023407:ios.developer: European Society for Medical Oncology - ESMO
bluejetty:00023407:ios.summary: The European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) guidelines are developed by experts. They are concise, practical and offer users treatment recommendations that are based on the latest scientific research. This application uses interactive
bluejetty:00023407:ios.description:
The European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) guidelines are developed by experts. They are concise, practical and offer users treatment recommendations that are based on the latest scientific research. This application uses interactive tools to support decision making and help the user navigate the guidelines easily, so they can access the information they require quickly. 
Each guideline offers best practice recommendations for screening, diagnosis, staging, treatment and follow up. The ESMO Interactive Guidelines application ensures the user has the highest standard of information at their figure tips. A variety of interactive treatment algorithms, tables, calculators and scores can be utilised to assist the treating doctor. The user can also perform key word searches, bookmark useful pages, add notes and email pages to colleagues or patients. 
The app features news and push notifications.
Disclaimer:
The app is intended to assist healthcare professionals and allied healthcare professionals as an educational tool to provide information that may support them in providing care to patients. Patients or other community members using this app shall do so only after consultation with a health professional and shall not mistake these guidelines as professional medical advice. These guidelines must not substitute seeking professional medical and health advice from a health professional.
These guidelines may not apply to all situations and shall be interpreted in the light of specific clinical situations and resource availability. It is up to every clinician to adapt these guidelines to local regulations and to each patient’s individual circumstances and needs. The app contains information obtained from authentic and highly regarded sources (http://www.esmo.org). Although every effort has been made to ensure that treatment and other information are presented accurately in this publication, the ultimate responsibility rests with the prescribing physician.This application is updated regularly with more tumour types, guidelines and interactive tools.

Maps3D – Explore the world in true 3D
Plan, discover, and navigate your next outdoor adventure with maps that reveal the landscape as it really is. Unlike traditional flat maps, Maps3D lets you explore mountains, valleys, trails, and terrain in stunning 3D, making it easier to understand the world before you set out.
Whether you're hiking, cycling, trail running, or simply exploring new places, Maps3D helps you plan smarter, stay oriented, and enjoy every adventure.
Built on an all-new map engine

• Beautiful high-resolution 3D terrain 
• Fast, compact offline maps

• Smooth, crisp Retina graphics 
• Infinite zoom for maximum detail 
• Display multiple tracks simultaneously

Explore offline
Download maps before your trip and continue exploring without a mobile connection.
• Worldwide offline maps

• Search maps even when offline 
• Reliable navigation in remote areas
Import and share
Bring your existing adventures into Maps3D or share new ones with others.
• Import GPX tracks from many sources 
• Export recorded routes 
• Share adventures with friends and fellow explorers
Explore with confidence
For over a decade, Maps3D has helped more than 2.5 million outdoor enthusiasts explore the world in stunning 3D. Whether you're planning your next hike or discovering a new cycling route, Maps3D is built to help you get the most out of every adventure.

bluejetty:00016088:ios.description:
The Bose app lets you easily control all your Bose products in one place. Bose app (formerly Bose Music app) compatible speakers, soundbars, amplifiers, headphones, earbuds, OpenAudio products, and portable PA systems are designed to work together seamlessly to enhance your listening experience.
GET THE MOST OUT OF YOUR HEADPHONES AND EARBUDS
Personalize your environment with controllable noise cancellation on our QuietComfort products. With Modes on QuietComfort products, you decide how much of the world to let in. Choose Quiet Mode for full noise cancelling, or Aware Mode to hear your surroundings and your music at the same time. Select products offer Aware Mode with ActiveSense technology, which brings the sounds around you down to a more comfortable level. The result is hearing everything you need to, but at a much more pleasant and balanced volume. 
All the QuietComfort and OpenAudio features, like Immersive Audio from the Ultra line, are made readily available for you. Fully customize your experience by balancing the EQ settings, picking your on-product shortcuts, and more all within the app.
EASY SETUP AND TOTAL CONTROL 
Easily set up your products and get right to listening. Play the same content throughout your home or listen to different content in different areas—it’s up to you. The Bose app lets you control all your Bose products from any room.
ONE-TOUCH ACCESS 
One touch and your home is filled with the music you love most. The Bose app makes it easy to set your favorite playlists or stations as presets. Then you can access them effortlessly on your app, the buttons on your speaker, or soundbar remote.

[Location]
Location access is not required to use the Bose app. The app does not collect location data through your device's location services.

Microphone access is optional and is used only for CustomTune, which uses audio measurements to personalize your listening experience. If you do not use CustomTune, you can decline microphone access and continue to use the rest of the app.

Nearby devices access is required to find, connect to, and communicate with supported Bose Bluetooth products.

Notification access is optional. You can decline notification access and continue to use the app.

bluejetty:00096367:ios.description:
Lower your handicap in half the time with AI-powered shot selection, swing analysis, and expert-designed golf lessons, all in one app.
Scratch AI combines an intelligent on-course caddy, a swing analyzer, and a personalized lesson program built by a Top Coach in America, giving you everything you need to improve your game on the course, at the range, and at home.
AI CADDY
Your AI Caddy analyzes your play style, course conditions, and real-time variables to deliver personalized recommendations when it matters most.
AI Shot Advisor: Get real-time club and shot recommendations based on your actual abilities.
Pre-Round Strategy: Plan each hole with personalized club selections and approach angles before you tee off.
Instant Caddy Mode: Ask for contextually relevant advice anytime during your round and get answers in seconds.
Course Intelligence: Access detailed insights for 40,000+ international courses with elevation, weather, and other factors built into every recommendation.
APPLE WATCH
Bring your AI Caddy to your wrist during every round. Scratch AI for Apple Watch gives you quick access to live yardages, club recommendations, and scoring tools without needing to pull out your phone. View front, middle, and back green distances, check wind-adjusted shot guidance, and keep your round moving with simple on-wrist controls built for the course.
GOLF LESSONS FROM A TOP-RANKED COACH
Scratch AI's lesson content is designed by Brian Phelps, PGA, ranked as a Golf Digest Top Coach in America. Your Swing Improvement Roadmap delivers a personalized practice plan based on your swing assessment, with targeted drills you can do anywhere: at home, at the range, or on the course. Every four weeks, your roadmap refreshes based on updated swing data so your plan always evolves with your game. Daily streaks and progress tracking keep you consistent and accountable between rounds.
WHY SCRATCH AI IS DIFFERENT
Most golf apps give you a GPS or a stat tracker. Scratch AI was built by golf professionals and data scientists to deliver a complete improvement system. The AI Caddy makes you smarter on the course. The Roadmap tells you how to fix it with lessons from a nationally ranked coach. The system continuously adapts, learning from every shot and every swing to keep your plan aligned with your evolving game. 
Elevate your game. Eliminate guesswork. Experience golf as it should be played - intelligently.
AI CADDY ANALYSIS AND GENERAL IOS AND WATCHOS ACCESS TO SCRATCH AI REQUIRE A SUBSCRIPTION.

This information may include details about how you have accessed and interacted with the purchased content. The purpose of sharing this data is to help Apple make an informed decision regarding refund requests. We ensure that such data sharing is done in compliance with Apple's policies and only as necessary to process your requests.

bluejetty:00022756:ios.description:
Tile Wonder: A Relaxing Tile Matching Puzzle
Welcome to Tile Wonder, the ultimate tile match-2 puzzle game that will keep you captivated for hours! Your goal is to eliminate all the tiles in each level, but with a twist – you must make groups of two hexa tiles to clear them.
How to Play Tile Wonder:
* Begin with a board full of hexa tiles with different shapes drawn on them.
* Tap on a tile in the puzzle to move it to the board at the bottom, which can hold upto 6 tiles.
* Match two tiles of the same image in that area to make them disappear, creating room for more tiles.
* Be strategic and don’t tap on tiles at random, or you’ll run out of space to add more tiles.
Tile Wonder Features:
* Unique twist on classic mahjong puzzles
* Challenging gameplay with six tiles
* Pleasing puzzle with beautiful tile designs
* Relaxing and brain-training experience
* Thousands of layouts for endless fun
* Powerful boosters to help you clear challenging levels
With 1000+ of matching games levels for adults & relaxing puzzle game, never run out of new tile match 2 puzzle challenges. With new tile match levels added to the tile matching game regularly, our matching game always has something new
Join Tile Wonder’s club of tile matching enthusiasts and master a zen-like experience with hexa tiles. With over thousands of relaxing puzzle game levels, you’ll never run out of new challenges. Whether you’re a casual player or a mahjong puzzle master, Tile Wonder provides hours of fun. So, focus on tile matching and enjoy the relaxing game.

bluejetty:00156959:ios.description:
FallCall Lite was the FIRST medical alert app for Apple Watch with subscription access to an emergency call center.
Important: FallCall Lite DOES NOT DETECT FALLS unless connected to FallCall Pendant with fall detection. 
Our premium app, FallCall Detect, has the features of FallCall Lite + our patented Smart Fall Detection on Apple Watch, Kwikset Connect, connected accessories & Apple Crash Detection.
***
Today’s older adults are more active and independent than ever. Unfortunately, injuries continue to disrupt their lives. 
FallCall Solutions has radically changed safety tech through innovation that is accessible, affordable & non-stigmatizing. 
Welcome to simplified personal emergency response!
24/7 Emergency Monitoring
Call center with trained emergency medical dispatchers to provide customer service help and emergency help when needed.
Kwik-Unlock
Reduce emergency entry delays & eliminate the fear of EMS "breaking down the door" for false alarms. Pair FallCall with your Kwikset® Halo lock app so when an ambulance is dispatched, your designated door will unlock. 
Connected Pendant Compatible
Looking for a safety with style? Add a Trelawear* gemstone jewelry pendant or FallCall Pendant** jewelry-inspired medical alert with fall detection.
FallCall Wristband
Discreet safety on your wrist. Change bands to match your style.
Standard features:
•Siri® activated Help Calls
•Elders can connect 5 Caregivers
•Caregivers can pair 2 Elders
•Integrates with Health App
•Elder GPS location & heart rate relayed to Caregivers during Help Calls***
•Elder Apple Watch Battery level updates to Caregivers
•Works over cellular/Wi-fi/Bluetooth® for appropriately equipped iPhone & Apple Watch devices
•Works on iPhone with or without Apple Watch
Subscription 24/7 Monitoring Service:
•Staffed by trained Emergency Medical Dispatchers
•When a Help Call is triggered, the monitor will reach out to you and/or your Care Group
•Real-time text updates are sent to all Care Group members during an event(US Only)
•PSAP(Public Service Answering Point) technology
•Subscription half the cost of most medical alert systems
US connectivity subscriptions: 
1) 24/7 Monitoring for iPhone and Apple Watch: $14.99/mo
2) Trelawear or FallCall Pendant, Caregroup ONLY Help Calls: $9.99/mo 
3) Trelawear or FallCall Pendant, Caregroup + 24/7 Monitor Help Calls: $19.99/mo
4) QVC/Trelawear Caregiver + 24/7 Monitoring Offer: 6 Months Free, then 119.00 every 6 months thereafter
5) Other 6 Month Subscription offers!
Subscription details:
Your Subscription Service starts when it is activated through the FallCall Lite App. Service will remain in effect for a minimum of one (1) month from the date of activation after which it may be terminated by either you or FallCall Solutions for any reason. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
For more information, see "Terms of Service" for details: https://www.fallcall.com/Docs/FallCallLite-Terms-and-Conditions
*Trelawear connected jewelry available at Trelawear.com
**FallCall connected jewelry and pendants available at www.fallcall.com
***As with all location-based services, it may not always be possible to determine your location. Multi-level buildings, parking garages, & even dense urban areas can make it difficult for satellites and cell phone towers to locate your exact location. FallCall Lite is intended for use only in the 50 United States. 
FallCall lite is not a replacement for 9-1-1. If 9-1-1 is necessary, FallCall Solutions recommends contacting 9-1-1 directly.
The Bluetooth® word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by FallCall Solutions is under license. Other trademarks and trade names are those of their respective owners.

Burger Shop 2, the sequel to the wildly successful food making game, Burger Shop, is now available!
In Burger Shop, you successfully created a universal chain of restaurants and found fame and fortune... Until one day, you found yourself in a dumpster with a bump on your head, your diner boarded up, and no memory of how any of it happened.
Now in Burger Shop 2 you must rebuild your restaurant empire, adding new twists to your menu to entice new customers while uncovering the truth about what happened to your original hamburger chain. Use your time management skills cooking and serving food for hungry customers. Upgrade your kitchen to provide your customers with different types of food like hamburgers, cheese burgers, chicken sandwiches, French fries, onion rings, salads, pizza, donuts, waffles, pancakes, pasta, steak, cakes, pies, ice cream sundaes and much, much more! Can you dash around serving hungry customers tasty food and discover the truth of what happened to your original burger chain?
Join the Burger Shop 2 craze and grab ingredients from the BurgerTron 2000 to create tasty food items to serve hungry customers in this fast-paced food shop game!
GAME FEATURES:
• 120 Story Levels and 120 Expert Levels!
• Challenge Modes and Relax Modes!
• Serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner!
• Over 100 different food items!
• Over 100 trophies to collect!
• Unlimited play!
Burger Shop 2 offers endless play with four different game modes!
GAME MODES:
• Story Mode - Rebuild your restaurant empire, and solve the mystery of who or what destroyed your original burger chain.
• Challenge Mode - Play fever-pitched, fast one-minute rounds - but don't lose a customer or it's all over! It's Burger Mania!
• Relax Mode - Serve food without any pressure or stress. Customers are infinitely patient.
• Expert Mode - So, you think you are the Burger Master Chef? Put your food-making skills to the test! 
Available in 11 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Swedish, Indonesian, Russian, and Japanese.
